sources.sql: WITH DnsOrderRangeTop10 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT s.name AS subnet_name, MAX(d.`ORDER`) - MIN(d.`ORDER`) AS order_range, VARIANCE(d.`ORDER`) AS order_variance FROM `subnets` AS s JOIN `dnsnameservers` AS d ON s.id = d.subnet_id WHERE s.ip_version = 4 GROUP BY s.name ORDER BY order_range DESC) SELECT i.subnet_name, i.order_range, i.order_variance, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT d2.address) > 0 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_dns_nameservers FROM inner_cte AS i LEFT JOIN `subnets` AS s2 ON s2.name = i.subnet_name LEFT JOIN `dnsnameservers` AS d2 ON d2.subnet_id = s2.id GROUP BY i.subnet_name, i.order_range, i.order_variance ORDER BY i.order_range DESC LIMIT 10), SubnetAllocationPoolMinFirstIp AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT s.NAME, s.TENANT_ID, s.NETWORK_ID, s.IP_VERSION, s.CIDR, s.GATEWAY_IP, s.ENABLE_DHCP, p.FIRST_IP, p.LAST_IP, MAX(s.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER (ORDER BY s.ID ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_standard_attr_id_next2 FROM `subnets` AS s JOIN `ipallocationpools` AS p ON s.ID = p.SUBNET_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4) SELECT i.NAME, i.TENANT_ID, i.NETWORK_ID, i.IP_VERSION, i.CIDR, i.GATEWAY_IP, i.ENABLE_DHCP, i.FIRST_IP, i.LAST_IP, i.max_standard_attr_id_next2 FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN `subnets` AS s2 ON s2.TENANT_ID = i.TENANT_ID JOIN `ipallocationpools` AS p2 ON p2.SUBNET_ID = s2.ID WHERE i.FIRST_IP = (SELECT MIN(p3.FIRST_IP) FROM `ipallocationpools` AS p3 WHERE p3.SUBNET_ID = s2.ID)) SELECT sap.NAME AS subnet_name, sap.TENANT_ID, sap.NETWORK_ID, sap.IP_VERSION, sap.CIDR, sap.GATEWAY_IP, sap.ENABLE_DHCP, sap.FIRST_IP AS allocation_pool_first_ip, sap.LAST_IP AS allocation_pool_last_ip, sap.max_standard_attr_id_next2, dor.order_range, dor.order_variance, dor.has_dns_nameservers FROM SubnetAllocationPoolMinFirstIp AS sap JOIN DnsOrderRangeTop10 AS dor ON dor.subnet_name = sap.NAME WHERE dor.has_dns_nameservers = 'Yes' ORDER BY dor.order_range DESC, sap.NAME

sources.sql: WITH CoeffVariationSubnets AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT s.name AS subnet_name, STDDEV(d.`ORDER`) / NULLIF(AVG(d.`ORDER`), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM `subnets` AS s JOIN `dnsnameservers` AS d ON d.subnet_id = s.id JOIN `ipallocationpools` AS p ON p.subnet_id = s.id WHERE s.ip_version = 4 GROUP BY s.name HAVING AVG(d.`ORDER`) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC), AvgCoeff AS (SELECT AVG(coefficient_of_variation) AS avg_coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte) SELECT i.subnet_name, i.coefficient_of_variation, a.avg_coefficient_of_variation AS benchmark, CASE WHEN i.coefficient_of_variation > a.avg_coefficient_of_variation * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_VARIATION' WHEN i.coefficient_of_variation < a.avg_coefficient_of_variation * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_VARIATION' ELSE 'AVERAGE_VARIATION' END AS variation_category FROM inner_cte AS i CROSS JOIN AvgCoeff AS a ORDER BY i.coefficient_of_variation DESC), HighRangeSubnets AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT s.name AS subnet_name, MAX(d.`ORDER`) - MIN(d.`ORDER`) AS order_range, VARIANCE(d.`ORDER`) AS order_variance FROM `subnets` AS s JOIN `dnsnameservers` AS d ON s.id = d.subnet_id WHERE s.ip_version = 4 GROUP BY s.name ORDER BY order_range DESC) SELECT subnet_name, order_range, order_variance FROM inner_cte WHERE order_range > (SELECT AVG(order_range) FROM inner_cte) ORDER BY order_range DESC), CombinedSubnetFindings AS (SELECT subnet_name, 'High Coefficient of Variation vs Benchmark' AS reason FROM CoeffVariationSubnets WHERE variation_category = 'HIGH_VARIATION' UNION ALL SELECT subnet_name, 'Order Range Above IPv4 Average' AS reason FROM HighRangeSubnets) SELECT subnet_name, reason FROM CombinedSubnetFindings ORDER BY subnet_name, reason

WITH q1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT s.name AS subnet_name, MAX(d.`ORDER`) - MIN(d.`ORDER`) AS order_range, VARIANCE(d.`ORDER`) AS order_variance FROM `subnets` AS s JOIN `dnsnameservers` AS d ON s.id = d.subnet_id WHERE s.ip_version = 4 GROUP BY s.name ORDER BY order_range DESC) SELECT subnet_name, order_range, order_variance FROM inner_cte WHERE order_range > (SELECT AVG(order_range) FROM inner_cte) ORDER BY order_range DESC), q2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT s.name AS subnet_name, STDDEV(d.`ORDER`) / NULLIF(AVG(d.`ORDER`), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM `subnets` AS s JOIN `dnsnameservers` AS d ON d.subnet_id = s.id JOIN `ipallocationpools` AS p ON p.subnet_id = s.id WHERE s.ip_version = 4 GROUP BY s.name HAVING AVG(d.`ORDER`) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC), avg_cte AS (SELECT AVG(coefficient_of_variation) AS avg_coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte) SELECT i.subnet_name, i.coefficient_of_variation, (i.coefficient_of_variation - a.avg_coefficient_of_variation) AS deviation_from_avg FROM inner_cte AS i CROSS JOIN avg_cte AS a ORDER BY deviation_from_avg DESC) SELECT q1.subnet_name, q1.order_range, q1.order_variance, q2.coefficient_of_variation, q2.deviation_from_avg FROM q1 JOIN q2 ON q1.subnet_name = q2.subnet_name ORDER BY q1.order_range DESC, q2.deviation_from_avg DESC

WITH q1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT s.name AS subnet_name, STDDEV(d.`order`) / NULLIF(AVG(d.`order`), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM `subnets` AS s JOIN `dnsnameservers` AS d ON d.subnet_id = s.id JOIN `ipallocationpools` AS p ON p.subnet_id = s.id JOIN `networks` AS n ON n.id = s.network_id WHERE s.ip_version = 4 AND NOT n.id IN (SELECT r.object_id FROM `networkrbacs` AS r WHERE r.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (r.target_tenant = '*' OR r.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b')) GROUP BY s.name HAVING AVG(d.`order`) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC) SELECT inner_cte.subnet_name, inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation, avg_cv.avg_coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte JOIN (SELECT AVG(coefficient_of_variation) AS avg_coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte) AS avg_cv ON 1 = 1 ORDER BY inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation DESC), q2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT s.name AS subnet_name, STDDEV(d.`order`) / NULLIF(AVG(d.`order`), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM `subnets` AS s JOIN `dnsnameservers` AS d ON d.subnet_id = s.id JOIN `ipallocationpools` AS p ON p.subnet_id = s.id JOIN `networks` AS n ON n.id = s.network_id WHERE s.ip_version = 4 AND NOT n.id IN (SELECT r.object_id FROM `networkrbacs` AS r WHERE r.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (r.target_tenant = '*' OR r.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b')) GROUP BY s.name HAVING AVG(d.`order`) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC) SELECT i.subnet_name, i.coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN `subnets` AS s ON s.name = i.subnet_name WHERE i.coefficient_of_variation > (SELECT AVG(coefficient_of_variation) FROM inner_cte) ORDER BY i.coefficient_of_variation DESC) SELECT q1.subnet_name, q1.coefficient_of_variation, q1.avg_coefficient_of_variation, q2.coefficient_of_variation AS above_avg_coefficient_of_variation FROM q1 LEFT JOIN q2 ON q2.subnet_name = q1.subnet_name ORDER BY q1.coefficient_of_variation DESC

WITH SubnetRbacWindowAndDeviation AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT s.NAME AS subnet_name, s.CIDR AS subnet_cidr, n.TARGET_TENANT AS rbac_target_tenant, SUM(s.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER (PARTITION BY s.IP_VERSION ORDER BY s.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) AS window_column FROM `subnets` AS s JOIN `networkrbacs` AS n ON n.OBJECT_ID = s.NETWORK_ID WHERE n.ACTION = 'access_as_shared' AND n.TARGET_TENANT IN ('1ee6b5b4fe8c45cfa16c3ecdbb8ee02b')), AvgStdAttr AS (SELECT AVG(s.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) AS avg_standard_attr_id FROM `subnets` AS s JOIN `networkrbacs` AS n ON n.OBJECT_ID = s.NETWORK_ID WHERE n.ACTION = 'access_as_shared' AND n.TARGET_TENANT IN ('1ee6b5b4fe8c45cfa16c3ecdbb8ee02b')) SELECT i.subnet_name, i.subnet_cidr, i.rbac_target_tenant, i.window_column, (s.STANDARD_ATTR_ID - a.avg_standard_attr_id) AS deviation_from_avg_standard_attr_id FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN `subnets` AS s ON s.NAME = i.subnet_name AND s.CIDR = i.subnet_cidr CROSS JOIN AvgStdAttr AS a), SubnetDnsCvAboveAvg AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT s.name AS subnet_name, STDDEV(d.`order`) / NULLIF(AVG(d.`order`), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM `subnets` AS s JOIN `dnsnameservers` AS d ON d.subnet_id = s.id JOIN `ipallocationpools` AS p ON p.subnet_id = s.id JOIN `networks` AS n ON n.id = s.network_id WHERE s.ip_version = 4 AND NOT n.id IN (SELECT r.object_id FROM `networkrbacs` AS r WHERE r.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (r.target_tenant = '*' OR r.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b')) GROUP BY s.name HAVING AVG(d.`order`) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC) SELECT i.subnet_name, i.coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN `subnets` AS s ON s.name = i.subnet_name WHERE i.coefficient_of_variation > (SELECT AVG(coefficient_of_variation) FROM inner_cte) ORDER BY i.coefficient_of_variation DESC) SELECT s1.subnet_name, s1.subnet_cidr, s1.rbac_target_tenant, s1.window_column, s1.deviation_from_avg_standard_attr_id, s2.coefficient_of_variation FROM SubnetRbacWindowAndDeviation AS s1 JOIN SubnetDnsCvAboveAvg AS s2 ON s2.subnet_name = s1.subnet_name WHERE s1.rbac_target_tenant IN ('1ee6b5b4fe8c45cfa16c3ecdbb8ee02b') ORDER BY s2.coefficient_of_variation DESC

WITH q1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT s.name AS subnet_name, MAX(d.`ORDER`) - MIN(d.`ORDER`) AS order_range, VARIANCE(d.`ORDER`) AS order_variance FROM `subnets` AS s JOIN `dnsnameservers` AS d ON s.id = d.subnet_id WHERE s.ip_version = 4 GROUP BY s.name ORDER BY order_range DESC) SELECT subnet_name, order_range, order_variance FROM inner_cte WHERE order_range > (SELECT AVG(order_range) FROM inner_cte) ORDER BY order_range DESC), q2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT s.name AS subnet_name, STDDEV(d.`ORDER`) / NULLIF(AVG(d.`ORDER`), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM `subnets` AS s JOIN `dnsnameservers` AS d ON d.subnet_id = s.id JOIN `ipallocationpools` AS p ON p.subnet_id = s.id WHERE s.ip_version = 4 GROUP BY s.name HAVING AVG(d.`ORDER`) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC), avg_cte AS (SELECT AVG(coefficient_of_variation) AS avg_coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte) SELECT i.subnet_name, i.coefficient_of_variation, (i.coefficient_of_variation - a.avg_coefficient_of_variation) AS deviation_from_avg FROM inner_cte AS i CROSS JOIN avg_cte AS a ORDER BY deviation_from_avg DESC) SELECT q1.subnet_name, q1.order_range, q1.order_variance, q2.coefficient_of_variation, q2.deviation_from_avg FROM q1 JOIN q2 ON q1.subnet_name = q2.subnet_name ORDER BY q1.order_range DESC, q2.deviation_from_avg DESC

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT s.name AS subnet_name, STDDEV(d.`ORDER`) / NULLIF(AVG(d.`ORDER`), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM `subnets` AS s JOIN `dnsnameservers` AS d ON d.subnet_id = s.id JOIN `ipallocationpools` AS p ON p.subnet_id = s.id WHERE s.ip_version = 4 GROUP BY s.name HAVING AVG(d.`ORDER`) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC) SELECT inner_cte.subnet_name, inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS ip_allocation_pool_count FROM inner_cte JOIN `subnets` AS s ON s.name = inner_cte.subnet_name JOIN `ipallocationpools` AS p ON p.subnet_id = s.id WHERE inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation > 0.5 GROUP BY inner_cte.subnet_name, inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation ORDER BY inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation DESC

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT s.NAME AS subnet_name, AVG(d.`ORDER`) AS avg_dns_order, VARIANCE(d.`ORDER`) AS dns_order_variance FROM `subnets` AS s JOIN `dnsnameservers` AS d ON s.ID = d.SUBNET_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4 GROUP BY s.NAME ORDER BY dns_order_variance DESC) SELECT inner_cte.subnet_name, inner_cte.avg_dns_order, inner_cte.dns_order_variance, overall_avg.avg_of_subnet_avg_dns_order FROM inner_cte, (SELECT AVG(avg_dns_order) AS avg_of_subnet_avg_dns_order FROM inner_cte) AS overall_avg ORDER BY inner_cte.dns_order_variance DESC

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT s.name AS subnet_name, STDDEV(d.`ORDER`) / NULLIF(AVG(d.`ORDER`), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM `subnets` AS s JOIN `dnsnameservers` AS d ON d.subnet_id = s.id JOIN `ipallocationpools` AS p ON p.subnet_id = s.id WHERE s.ip_version = 4 GROUP BY s.name HAVING AVG(d.`ORDER`) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC), avg_cte AS (SELECT AVG(coefficient_of_variation) AS avg_coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte) SELECT i.subnet_name, i.coefficient_of_variation, (i.coefficient_of_variation - a.avg_coefficient_of_variation) AS deviation_from_avg FROM inner_cte AS i CROSS JOIN avg_cte AS a ORDER BY deviation_from_avg DESC

WITH sq1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT n.NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY r.ACTION ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column FROM `externalnetworks` AS e JOIN `networks` AS n ON e.NETWORK_ID = n.ID JOIN `networkrbacs` AS r ON n.ID = r.OBJECT_ID WHERE e.IS_DEFAULT = 0 AND r.ACTION = 'access_as_external') SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(inner_cte.NAME) OVER (ORDER BY inner_cte.NAME, r.TENANT_ID) = inner_cte.NAME THEN NULL ELSE inner_cte.NAME END AS name, inner_cte.window_column, r.TENANT_ID AS rbac_tenant_id, r.TARGET_TENANT AS rbac_target_tenant FROM inner_cte JOIN `networks` AS n ON n.NAME = inner_cte.NAME JOIN `networkrbacs` AS r ON r.OBJECT_ID = n.ID AND r.ACTION = 'access_as_external' ORDER BY inner_cte.NAME, r.TENANT_ID), sq2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT n.NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY r.ACTION ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column FROM `externalnetworks` AS e JOIN `networks` AS n ON e.NETWORK_ID = n.ID JOIN `networkrbacs` AS r ON n.ID = r.OBJECT_ID WHERE e.IS_DEFAULT = 0 AND r.ACTION = 'access_as_external'), tenant_counts AS (SELECT n.TENANT_ID, COUNT(*) AS tenant_network_count FROM `externalnetworks` AS e JOIN `networks` AS n ON e.NETWORK_ID = n.ID JOIN `networkrbacs` AS r ON n.ID = r.OBJECT_ID WHERE e.IS_DEFAULT = 0 AND r.ACTION = 'access_as_external' GROUP BY n.TENANT_ID), avg_counts AS (SELECT AVG(tenant_network_count) AS avg_networks_per_tenant FROM tenant_counts) SELECT inner_cte.NAME, inner_cte.window_column, totals.total_matching_networks, avg_counts.avg_networks_per_tenant FROM inner_cte JOIN (SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_matching_networks FROM `externalnetworks` AS e JOIN `networks` AS n ON e.NETWORK_ID = n.ID JOIN `networkrbacs` AS r ON n.ID = r.OBJECT_ID WHERE e.IS_DEFAULT = 0 AND r.ACTION = 'access_as_external') AS totals ON 1 = 1 JOIN avg_counts ON 1 = 1) SELECT sq1.name, sq1.window_column, sq1.rbac_tenant_id, sq1.rbac_target_tenant, sq2.total_matching_networks, sq2.avg_networks_per_tenant, ROUND(sq2.total_matching_networks / NULLIF(sq2.avg_networks_per_tenant, 0), 2) AS total_to_avg_ratio FROM sq1 JOIN sq2 ON sq2.NAME = sq1.name AND sq2.window_column = sq1.window_column ORDER BY sq1.name, sq1.rbac_tenant_id

sources.sql: WITH TopTenantsExternalAccess AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT n.NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY r.ACTION ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column FROM `externalnetworks` AS e JOIN `networks` AS n ON e.NETWORK_ID = n.ID JOIN `networkrbacs` AS r ON n.ID = r.OBJECT_ID WHERE e.IS_DEFAULT = 0 AND r.ACTION = 'access_as_external') SELECT n.tenant_id, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id) AS total_qualifying_networks, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN r.target_tenant <> '*' THEN r.id END) > 0 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_targeted_rbac FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN `networks` AS n ON n.name = i.name JOIN `externalnetworks` AS e ON e.network_id = n.id JOIN `networkrbacs` AS r ON r.object_id = n.id WHERE e.is_default = 0 AND r.action = 'access_as_external' GROUP BY n.tenant_id ORDER BY total_qualifying_networks DESC LIMIT 10), TenantStatusRollup AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT e.NETWORK_ID, e.IS_DEFAULT, n.TENANT_ID, n.NAME, n.STATUS, n.ADMIN_STATE_UP, n.MTU, n.STANDARD_ATTR_ID, MIN(n.MTU) OVER (PARTITION BY n.TENANT_ID ORDER BY n.TENANT_ID) AS window_column FROM `externalnetworks` AS e JOIN `networks` AS n ON e.NETWORK_ID = n.ID WHERE e.IS_DEFAULT = 0 AND NOT n.ID IN (SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM `networkrbacs` WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b'))), TenantStatusCounts AS (SELECT i.tenant_id, i.status, COUNT(DISTINCT i.network_id) AS total_networks FROM inner_cte AS i GROUP BY i.tenant_id, i.status) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(tenant_id) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE tenant_id END AS tenant_id, CASE WHEN GROUPING(status) = 1 AND GROUPING(tenant_id) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' ELSE status END AS status, SUM(total_networks) AS total_networks FROM TenantStatusCounts GROUP BY tenant_id, status WITH ROLLUP) SELECT t.tenant_id, t.total_qualifying_networks, t.has_targeted_rbac, r.status, r.total_networks FROM TopTenantsExternalAccess AS t JOIN TenantStatusRollup AS r ON r.tenant_id = t.tenant_id WHERE r.status <> 'SUBTOTAL' AND r.tenant_id <> 'GRAND TOTAL' ORDER BY t.total_qualifying_networks DESC, r.status

sources.sql: WITH q1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT e.NETWORK_ID, e.IS_DEFAULT, n.TENANT_ID, n.NAME, n.STATUS, n.ADMIN_STATE_UP, n.MTU, n.STANDARD_ATTR_ID, MIN(n.MTU) OVER (PARTITION BY n.TENANT_ID ORDER BY n.TENANT_ID) AS window_column FROM `externalnetworks` AS e JOIN `networks` AS n ON e.NETWORK_ID = n.ID WHERE e.IS_DEFAULT = 0 AND NOT n.ID IN (SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM `networkrbacs` WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b'))), TenantStatusCounts AS (SELECT i.tenant_id, i.status, COUNT(DISTINCT i.network_id) AS total_networks FROM inner_cte AS i GROUP BY i.tenant_id, i.status) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(tenant_id) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE tenant_id END AS tenant_id, CASE WHEN GROUPING(status) = 1 AND GROUPING(tenant_id) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' ELSE status END AS status, SUM(total_networks) AS total_networks FROM TenantStatusCounts GROUP BY tenant_id, status WITH ROLLUP), q2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT p.STATUS AS port_status, p.DEVICE_OWNER AS device_owner, COUNT(p.ID) AS port_count, MIN(sa.UPDATED_AT) AS earliest_standard_attr_update FROM `ports` AS p JOIN `standardattributes` AS sa ON sa.ID = p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE sa.RESOURCE_TYPE = 'ports' AND NOT p.NETWORK_ID IN (SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM `networkrbacs` WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b')) GROUP BY p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER), avg_cte AS (SELECT AVG(port_count) AS avg_port_count FROM inner_cte) SELECT i.port_status, i.device_owner, i.port_count, i.earliest_standard_attr_update, a.avg_port_count AS benchmark, CASE WHEN i.port_count > a.avg_port_count * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_VOLUME' WHEN i.port_count < a.avg_port_count * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_VOLUME' ELSE 'AVERAGE_VOLUME' END AS volume_category FROM inner_cte AS i CROSS JOIN avg_cte AS a), TenantPortCounts AS (SELECT p.TENANT_ID AS tenant_id, COUNT(p.ID) AS tenant_port_count FROM `ports` AS p JOIN `standardattributes` AS sa ON sa.ID = p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE sa.RESOURCE_TYPE = 'ports' AND NOT p.NETWORK_ID IN (SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM `networkrbacs` WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b')) GROUP BY p.TENANT_ID) SELECT q1.tenant_id, q1.status AS network_status, q1.total_networks, tpc.tenant_port_count, ROUND(tpc.tenant_port_count / NULLIF(q1.total_networks, 0), 2) AS ports_per_default_external_network, q2.port_status, q2.device_owner, q2.port_count, q2.benchmark, q2.volume_category, q2.earliest_standard_attr_update FROM q1 JOIN TenantPortCounts AS tpc ON tpc.tenant_id = q1.tenant_id CROSS JOIN q2 WHERE NOT q1.tenant_id IN ('GRAND TOTAL', 'SUBTOTAL') ORDER BY ports_per_default_external_network DESC, q1.tenant_id, q1.status, q2.port_count DESC

JOIN `standardattributes` AS sa ON sa.ID = s.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4 AND s.ID IN ('012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48')) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(subnet_name) OVER (ORDER BY subnet_name_sort, subnet_name, window_column), top_subnets_by_routes AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT r.DESTINATION, r.NEXTHOP, s.NAME AS subnet_name, s.CIDR AS subnet_cidr, p.FIRST_IP, p.LAST_IP, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.SUBNET_ID ORDER BY r.SUBNET_ID) AS window_column FROM `subnetroutes` AS r JOIN `subnets` AS s ON r.SUBNET_ID = s.ID JOIN `ipallocationpools` AS p ON s.ID = p.SUBNET_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4 AND s.ID IN ('012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48')) SELECT s.ID AS subnet_id, s.NAME AS subnet_name, s.CIDR AS subnet_cidr, COUNT(DISTINCT r.DESTINATION) AS top_subnets_by_routes AS ts JOIN subnet_attr_dense_ranks AS sar ON sar.subnet_name = ts.subnet_name ORDER BY ts.total_routes DESC, ts.subnet_name, sar.window_column

AS pool_count_stddev FROM `subnets` AS s JOIN `dnsnameservers` AS d ON d.subnet_id = s.id JOIN (SELECT s2.id AS subnet_id, COUNT(*) AS pool_count FROM `subnets` AS s2 JOIN `ipallocationpools` AS p ON JOIN `dnsnameservers` AS d ON d.subnet_id = s.id) SELECT sd.NAME AS subnet_name, sd.TENANT_ID, sd.NETWORK_ID, sd.IP_VERSION, sd.CIDR, sd.GATEWAY_IP, sd.ENABLE_DHCP, sd.FIRST_IP, sd.LAST_IP, sd.max_standard_attr_id_next2, sp.pool_count_range, sp.pool_count_variance, sp.pool_count_stddev FROM SubnetDetailsWithWindowMax AS sd JOIN SubnetPoolStatsByName AS sp ON sd.NAME = sp.subnet_name JOIN DnsSubnetNames AS dn ON sd.NAME = dn.subnet_name ORDER BY sp.pool_count_range DESC, sd.NAME), NetworkMaxPoolRange AS (SELECT s.network_id, MAX(ic.pool_count_range) AS max_pool_count_range_in_network NetworkMaxPoolRange AS nmr ON nmr.network_id = ic.network_id ORDER BY nmr.max_pool_count_range_in_network DESC, ic.pool_count_range DESC, ic.subnet_name

WITH SubnetPoolStatsByName AS (SELECT s.name AS subnet_name, MAX(pool_count) - MIN(pool_count) AS pool_count_range, VARIANCE(pool_count) AS pool_count_variance, STDDEV(pool_count) AS pool_count_stddev FROM `subnets` AS s JOIN `dnsnameservers` AS d ON d.subnet_id = s.id JOIN (SELECT s2.id AS subnet_id, COUNT(*) AS pool_count FROM `subnets` AS s2 JOIN `ipallocationpools` AS p ON p.subnet_id = s2.id GROUP BY s2.id, p.id) AS pool_stats ON pool_stats.subnet_id = s.id GROUP BY s.name ORDER BY pool_count_range DESC), SubnetDetailsWithWindowMax AS (SELECT s.NAME, s.TENANT_ID, s.NETWORK_ID, s.IP_VERSION, s.CIDR, s.GATEWAY_IP, s.ENABLE_DHCP, p.FIRST_IP, p.LAST_IP, MAX(s.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER (ORDER BY s.ID ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_standard_attr_id_next2 FROM `subnets` AS s JOIN `ipallocationpools` AS p ON s.ID = p.SUBNET_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4), DnsSubnetNames AS (SELECT DISTINCT s.name AS subnet_name FROM `subnets` AS s JOIN `dnsnameservers` AS d ON d.subnet_id = s.id) SELECT sd.NAME AS subnet_name, sd.TENANT_ID, sd.NETWORK_ID, sd.IP_VERSION, sd.CIDR, sd.GATEWAY_IP, sd.ENABLE_DHCP, sd.FIRST_IP, sd.LAST_IP, sd.max_standard_attr_id_next2, sp.pool_count_range, sp.pool_count_variance, sp.pool_count_stddev FROM SubnetDetailsWithWindowMax AS sd JOIN SubnetPoolStatsByName AS sp ON sd.NAME = sp.subnet_name JOIN DnsSubnetNames AS dn ON sd.NAME = dn.subnet_name ORDER BY sp.pool_count_range DESC, sd.NAME

WITH subnet_details AS (SELECT s.NAME, s.TENANT_ID, s.NETWORK_ID, s.IP_VERSION, s.CIDR, s.GATEWAY_IP, s.ENABLE_DHCP, p.FIRST_IP, p.LAST_IP, MAX(s.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER (ORDER BY s.ID ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_standard_attr_id_next2 FROM `subnets` AS s JOIN `ipallocationpools` AS p ON s.ID = p.SUBNET_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4 AND s.ID IN ('012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48')), subnet_routes AS (SELECT r.DESTINATION, r.NEXTHOP, s.NAME AS subnet_name, s.CIDR AS subnet_cidr, p.FIRST_IP, p.LAST_IP, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.SUBNET_ID ORDER BY r.SUBNET_ID) AS window_column FROM `subnetroutes` AS r JOIN `subnets` AS s ON r.SUBNET_ID = s.ID JOIN `ipallocationpools` AS p ON s.ID = p.SUBNET_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4 AND s.ID IN ('012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48')) SELECT sd.NAME, sd.TENANT_ID, sd.NETWORK_ID, sd.IP_VERSION, sd.CIDR, sd.GATEWAY_IP, sd.ENABLE_DHCP, sd.FIRST_IP AS allocation_first_ip, sd.LAST_IP AS allocation_last_ip, sd.max_standard_attr_id_next2, sr.DESTINATION AS route_destination, sr.NEXTHOP AS route_nexthop, sr.window_column AS route_dense_rank_within_subnet FROM subnet_details AS sd JOIN subnet_routes AS sr ON sd.NAME = sr.subnet_name AND sd.CIDR = sr.subnet_cidr AND sd.FIRST_IP = sr.FIRST_IP AND sd.LAST_IP = sr.LAST_IP

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT lb.name AS loadbalancer_name, MAX(lb.admin_state_up) AS max_admin_state_up, lb.operating_status FROM `lbaas_loadbalancers` AS lb JOIN `providerresourceassociations` AS pra ON lb.id = pra.resource_id WHERE pra.provider_name = 'haproxy' GROUP BY lb.name, lb.operating_status HAVING MAX(lb.admin_state_up) = 1) SELECT lb.tenant_id, COUNT(DISTINCT lb.id) AS total_qualifying_loadbalancers, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN inner_cte.operating_status = 'ONLINE' THEN lb.id END) > 0 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_any_online FROM inner_cte JOIN `lbaas_loadbalancers` AS lb ON lb.name = inner_cte.loadbalancer_name AND lb.operating_status = inner_cte.operating_status GROUP BY lb.tenant_id ORDER BY total_qualifying_loadbalancers DESC LIMIT 10

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT lb.NAME, lb.ID, lb.VIP_ADDRESS, lb.PROVISIONING_STATUS, lb.OPERATING_STATUS, AVG(lb.ID) OVER (PARTITION BY pra.PROVIDER_NAME ORDER BY lb.NAME) AS window_column FROM `lbaas_loadbalancers` AS lb JOIN `providerresourceassociations` AS pra ON lb.ID = pra.RESOURCE_ID WHERE pra.PROVIDER_NAME = 'haproxy') SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(provider_name) OVER (ORDER BY provider_name_sort, lb_name) = provider_name THEN NULL ELSE provider_name END AS provider_name, lb_name, lb_id, vip_address, provisioning_status, operating_status, window_column FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(pra.PROVIDER_NAME) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE pra.PROVIDER_NAME END AS provider_name_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(pra.PROVIDER_NAME) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE pra.PROVIDER_NAME END AS provider_name, inner_cte.NAME AS lb_name, inner_cte.ID AS lb_id, inner_cte.VIP_ADDRESS AS vip_address, inner_cte.PROVISIONING_STATUS AS provisioning_status, inner_cte.OPERATING_STATUS AS operating_status, inner_cte.window_column AS window_column FROM inner_cte JOIN `providerresourceassociations` AS pra ON inner_cte.ID = pra.RESOURCE_ID GROUP BY pra.PROVIDER_NAME, inner_cte.NAME, inner_cte.ID, inner_cte.VIP_ADDRESS, inner_cte.PROVISIONING_STATUS, inner_cte.OPERATING_STATUS, inner_cte.window_column WITH ROLLUP) AS tbltmp ORDER BY provider_name_sort, lb_name

sources.sql: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH subq1 AS (SELECT lb.NAME, lb.ID, lb.VIP_ADDRESS, lb.PROVISIONING_STATUS, lb.OPERATING_STATUS, AVG(lb.ID) OVER (PARTITION BY pra.PROVIDER_NAME ORDER BY lb.NAME) AS window_column FROM `lbaas_loadbalancers` AS lb JOIN `providerresourceassociations` AS pra ON lb.ID = pra.RESOURCE_ID WHERE pra.PROVIDER_NAME = 'haproxy'), subq2 AS (SELECT lb.ID AS loadbalancer_id, lb.NAME AS loadbalancer_name, pra.PROVIDER_NAME AS provider_name, lb.VIP_ADDRESS AS vip_address, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pra.PROVIDER_NAME ORDER BY stats.TOTAL_CONNECTIONS) AS window_column FROM `lbaas_loadbalancer_statistics` AS stats JOIN `lbaas_loadbalancers` AS lb ON stats.LOADBALANCER_ID = lb.ID JOIN `providerresourceassociations` AS pra ON lb.ID = pra.RESOURCE_ID WHERE lb.OPERATING_STATUS = 'ONLINE') SELECT s1.NAME AS load_balancer_name, s1.ID AS load_balancer_id, s1.VIP_ADDRESS AS vip_address, s1.PROVISIONING_STATUS AS provisioning_status, s1.OPERATING_STATUS AS operating_status, s1.window_column AS running_avg_loadbalancer_id_within_provider_ordered_by_name, s2.provider_name, s2.window_column AS rank_within_provider_by_total_connections FROM subq1 AS s1 JOIN subq2 AS s2 ON s1.ID = s2.loadbalancer_id ORDER BY s1.NAME), AvgConnections AS (SELECT AVG(stats.TOTAL_CONNECTIONS) AS avg_total_connections FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN `lbaas_loadbalancer_statistics` AS stats ON stats.LOADBALANCER_ID = i.load_balancer_id) SELECT i.load_balancer_name, i.load_balancer_id, i.vip_address, i.provisioning_status, i.operating_status, i.running_avg_loadbalancer_id_within_provider_ordered_by_name, i.provider_name, i.rank_within_provider_by_total_connections, stats.TOTAL_CONNECTIONS AS total_connections, (stats.TOTAL_CONNECTIONS - ac.avg_total_connections) AS deviation_from_avg_total_connections FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN `lbaas_loadbalancer_statistics` AS stats ON stats.LOADBALANCER_ID = i.load_balancer_id CROSS JOIN AvgConnections AS ac ORDER BY i.load_balancer_name

sources.sql: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH HapLoadBalancers AS (SELECT lb.NAME, lb.ID, lb.VIP_ADDRESS, lb.PROVISIONING_STATUS, lb.OPERATING_STATUS, AVG(lb.ID) OVER (PARTITION BY pra.PROVIDER_NAME ORDER BY lb.NAME) AS window_column FROM `lbaas_loadbalancers` AS lb JOIN `providerresourceassociations` AS pra ON lb.ID = pra.RESOURCE_ID WHERE pra.PROVIDER_NAME = 'haproxy'), OperatingStatusBytesIn AS (SELECT lb.OPERATING_STATUS, SUM(s.BYTES_IN) AS total_bytes_in FROM `lbaas_loadbalancers` AS lb JOIN `lbaas_loadbalancer_statistics` AS s ON lb.ID = s.LOADBALANCER_ID WHERE lb.PROVISIONING_STATUS = 'ACTIVE' GROUP BY lb.OPERATING_STATUS HAVING SUM(s.BYTES_IN) > 1000000) SELECT hlb.NAME, hlb.ID, hlb.VIP_ADDRESS, hlb.PROVISIONING_STATUS, hlb.OPERATING_STATUS, hlb.window_column, osbi.total_bytes_in FROM HapLoadBalancers AS hlb JOIN OperatingStatusBytesIn AS osbi ON hlb.OPERATING_STATUS = osbi.OPERATING_STATUS WHERE hlb.PROVISIONING_STATUS = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY hlb.NAME), AvgBytesInBenchmark AS (SELECT AVG(total_bytes_in) AS avg_total_bytes_in FROM (SELECT lb.OPERATING_STATUS, SUM(s.BYTES_IN) AS total_bytes_in FROM `lbaas_loadbalancers` AS lb JOIN `lbaas_loadbalancer_statistics` AS s ON lb.ID = s.LOADBALANCER_ID WHERE lb.PROVISIONING_STATUS = 'ACTIVE' GROUP BY lb.OPERATING_STATUS HAVING SUM(s.BYTES_IN) > 1000000) AS t) SELECT i.NAME, i.ID, i.VIP_ADDRESS, i.PROVISIONING_STATUS, i.OPERATING_STATUS, i.window_column, i.total_bytes_in, a.avg_total_bytes_in AS benchmark, CASE WHEN i.total_bytes_in > a.avg_total_bytes_in * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_BYTES_IN' WHEN i.total_bytes_in < a.avg_total_bytes_in * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_BYTES_IN' ELSE 'AVERAGE_BYTES_IN' END AS bytes_in_category FROM inner_cte AS i CROSS JOIN AvgBytesInBenchmark AS a

sources.sql: WITH TopTenTenants AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT lb.name AS loadbalancer_name, MAX(lb.admin_state_up) AS max_admin_state_up, lb.operating_status FROM `lbaas_loadbalancers` AS lb JOIN `providerresourceassociations` AS pra ON lb.id = pra.resource_id WHERE pra.provider_name = 'haproxy' GROUP BY lb.name, lb.operating_status HAVING MAX(lb.admin_state_up) = 1) SELECT lb.tenant_id, COUNT(DISTINCT lb.id) AS total_qualifying_loadbalancers, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN inner_cte.operating_status = 'ONLINE' THEN lb.id END) > 0 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_any_online FROM inner_cte JOIN `lbaas_loadbalancers` AS lb ON lb.name = inner_cte.loadbalancer_name AND lb.operating_status = inner_cte.operating_status GROUP BY lb.tenant_id ORDER BY total_qualifying_loadbalancers DESC LIMIT 10), TenantHaproxyCountsAndAverage AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT lb.name AS loadbalancer_name, MAX(lb.admin_state_up) AS max_admin_state_up, lb.operating_status FROM `lbaas_loadbalancers` AS lb JOIN `providerresourceassociations` AS pra ON lb.id = pra.resource_id WHERE pra.provider_name = 'haproxy' GROUP BY lb.name, lb.operating_status HAVING MAX(lb.admin_state_up) = 1) SELECT lb.tenant_id AS tenant_id, COUNT(inner_cte.loadbalancer_name) AS total_haproxy_loadbalancers, avg_counts.avg_lb_count FROM inner_cte JOIN `lbaas_loadbalancers` AS lb ON lb.name = inner_cte.loadbalancer_name AND lb.operating_status = inner_cte.operating_status, (SELECT AVG(lb_count) AS avg_lb_count FROM (SELECT lb2.tenant_id, COUNT(*) AS lb_count FROM (SELECT lb.name AS loadbalancer_name, MAX(lb.admin_state_up) AS max_admin_state_up, lb.operating_status FROM `lbaas_loadbalancers` AS lb JOIN `providerresourceassociations` AS pra ON lb.id = pra.resource_id WHERE pra.provider_name = 'haproxy' GROUP BY lb.name, lb.operating_status HAVING MAX(lb.admin_state_up) = 1) AS inner2 JOIN `lbaas_loadbalancers` AS lb2 ON lb2.name = inner2.loadbalancer_name AND lb2.operating_status = inner2.operating_status GROUP BY lb2.tenant_id) AS sub) AS avg_counts GROUP BY lb.tenant_id, avg_counts.avg_lb_count) SELECT ttt.tenant_id, ttt.total_qualifying_loadbalancers, tha.avg_lb_count, ttt.has_any_online FROM TopTenTenants AS ttt JOIN TenantHaproxyCountsAndAverage AS tha ON ttt.tenant_id = tha.tenant_id WHERE ttt.total_qualifying_loadbalancers > tha.avg_lb_count ORDER BY ttt.total_qualifying_loadbalancers DESC

WITH ActiveStatusBytes AS (SELECT lb.OPERATING_STATUS, SUM(s.BYTES_IN) AS total_bytes_in FROM `lbaas_loadbalancers` AS lb JOIN `lbaas_loadbalancer_statistics` AS s ON lb.ID = s.LOADBALANCER_ID WHERE lb.PROVISIONING_STATUS = 'ACTIVE' GROUP BY lb.OPERATING_STATUS HAVING SUM(s.BYTES_IN) > 1000000), HaproxyAdminUpLoadBalancers AS (SELECT lb.name AS loadbalancer_name, MAX(lb.admin_state_up) AS max_admin_state_up, lb.operating_status FROM `lbaas_loadbalancers` AS lb JOIN `providerresourceassociations` AS pra ON lb.id = pra.resource_id WHERE pra.provider_name = 'haproxy' GROUP BY lb.name, lb.operating_status HAVING MAX(lb.admin_state_up) = 1) SELECT h.loadbalancer_name, h.operating_status, a.total_bytes_in FROM HaproxyAdminUpLoadBalancers AS h JOIN ActiveStatusBytes AS a ON h.operating_status = a.OPERATING_STATUS ORDER BY h.operating_status, h.loadbalancer_name

WITH ActiveTenantNetworks AS (SELECT n.ID AS network_id, n.NAME AS network_name, n.TENANT_ID AS tenant_id, n.ADMIN_STATE_UP AS admin_state_up, n.MTU AS mtu, sa.UPDATED_AT AS standard_attr_updated_at, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.TENANT_ID ORDER BY n.NAME) AS window_column FROM `networks` AS n JOIN `standardattributes` AS sa ON sa.ID = n.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE n.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND n.TENANT_ID IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57')), AdminUpTenantPorts AS (SELECT b.PORT_ID, b.HOST, b.VIF_TYPE, b.VNIC_TYPE, p.TENANT_ID, p.NETWORK_ID, p.MAC_ADDRESS, p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER, AVG(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER (PARTITION BY b.VIF_TYPE ORDER BY p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM `ml2_port_bindings` AS b JOIN `ports` AS p ON b.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN `portsecuritybindings` AS psb ON p.ID = psb.PORT_ID WHERE p.ADMIN_STATE_UP = 1 AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57')) SELECT n.network_id, n.network_name, n.tenant_id, n.admin_state_up AS network_admin_state_up, n.mtu, n.standard_attr_updated_at AS network_standard_attr_updated_at, n.window_column AS network_row_number_within_tenant, p.PORT_ID AS port_id, p.HOST AS port_host, p.VIF_TYPE AS port_vif_type, p.VNIC_TYPE AS port_vnic_type, p.MAC_ADDRESS AS port_mac_address, p.STATUS AS port_status, p.DEVICE_OWNER AS port_device_owner, p.window_column AS port_avg_standard_attr_id_window FROM ActiveTenantNetworks AS n JOIN AdminUpTenantPorts AS p ON p.NETWORK_ID = n.network_id AND p.TENANT_ID = n.tenant_id ORDER BY n.network_name, p.PORT_ID

WITH admin_up_ports AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT b.PORT_ID, b.HOST, b.VIF_TYPE, b.VNIC_TYPE, p.TENANT_ID, p.NETWORK_ID, p.MAC_ADDRESS, p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER, AVG(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER (PARTITION BY b.VIF_TYPE ORDER BY p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM `ml2_port_bindings` AS b JOIN `ports` AS p ON b.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN `portsecuritybindings` AS psb ON p.ID = psb.PORT_ID WHERE p.ADMIN_STATE_UP = 1 AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57')), VifTypeCounts AS (SELECT VIF_TYPE, COUNT(*) AS ports_in_vif_type FROM inner_cte GROUP BY VIF_TYPE), OverallWindowAvg AS (SELECT AVG(window_column) AS overall_avg_window_column FROM inner_cte) SELECT i.PORT_ID, i.HOST, i.VIF_TYPE, i.VNIC_TYPE, i.TENANT_ID, i.NETWORK_ID, i.MAC_ADDRESS, i.STATUS, i.DEVICE_OWNER, i.window_column, vtc.ports_in_vif_type, (i.window_column - owa.overall_avg_window_column) AS deviation_from_overall_window_avg FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN VifTypeCounts AS vtc ON i.VIF_TYPE = vtc.VIF_TYPE CROSS JOIN OverallWindowAvg AS owa), down_ports AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address, sgpb.security_group_id, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY sgpb.security_group_id ORDER BY p.id) AS window_column FROM `securitygroupportbindings` AS sgpb JOIN `ports` AS p ON sgpb.port_id = p.id JOIN `portsecuritybindings` AS psb ON p.id = psb.port_id WHERE p.status = 'DOWN' AND p.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57')) SELECT inner_cte.port_id, inner_cte.tenant_id, inner_cte.mac_address, inner_cte.security_group_id, inner_cte.window_column, tenant_down.total_down_ports_for_tenant, avg_down.avg_down_ports_per_tenant FROM inner_cte JOIN (SELECT tenant_id, COUNT(*) AS total_down_ports_for_tenant FROM `ports` WHERE status = 'DOWN' GROUP BY tenant_id) AS tenant_down ON inner_cte.tenant_id = tenant_down.tenant_id JOIN (SELECT AVG(down_port_count) AS avg_down_ports_per_tenant FROM (SELECT tenant_id, COUNT(*) AS down_port_count FROM `ports` WHERE status = 'DOWN' GROUP BY tenant_id) AS sub) AS avg_down ON 1 = 1) SELECT aup.PORT_ID AS admin_up_port_id, aup.HOST, aup.VIF_TYPE, aup.VNIC_TYPE, aup.TENANT_ID, aup.NETWORK_ID, aup.MAC_ADDRESS, aup.STATUS AS admin_up_port_status, aup.DEVICE_OWNER, aup.window_column AS admin_up_window_avg_standard_attr_id, aup.ports_in_vif_type, aup.deviation_from_overall_window_avg, dp.security_group_id, dp.window_column AS down_port_rank_within_security_group, dp.total_down_ports_for_tenant, dp.avg_down_ports_per_tenant FROM admin_up_ports AS aup JOIN down_ports AS dp ON aup.TENANT_ID = dp.tenant_id AND aup.MAC_ADDRESS = dp.mac_address

i.VIF_TYPE = vtc.VIF_TYPE CROSS JOIN OverallWindowAvg AS owa) SELECT a.PORT_ID, a.TENANT_ID, a.NETWORK_ID, a.MAC_ADDRESS, a.HOST, a.VIF_TYPE, a.VNIC_TYPE, a.STATUS, a.DEVICE_OWNER, a.window_column AS admin_up_windowed_avg_standard_attr_id, a.ports_in_vif_type, a.deviation_from_overall_window_avg, d.security_group_id, d.port_rank_within_security_group, d.total_down_ports_in_security_group, d.benchmark AS down_ports_benchmark_avg_per_security_group, d.user_category AS security_group_down_port_user_category FROM admin_up_ports_by_vif AS a JOIN down_ports_by_sg AS d ON a.TENANT_ID = `ml2_port_bindings` AS b JOIN `ports` AS p ON b.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN `portsecuritybindings` AS psb ON p.ID = psb.PORT_ID WHERE p.ADMIN_STATE_UP = 1 AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57')), VifTypeCounts AS (SELECT VIF_TYPE, COUNT(*) AS total_ports FROM inner_cte GROUP BY VIF_TYPE), AverageVifTypePorts AS (SELECT AVG(total_ports) AS avg_ports FROM VifTypeCounts) SELECT i.PORT_ID, i.HOST, i.VIF_TYPE, i.VNIC_TYPE, i.TENANT_ID, i.NETWORK_ID, i.MAC_ADDRESS, i.STATUS, i.DEVICE_OWNER, i.window_column, vtc.total_ports, avp.avg_ports AS benchmark, CASE AS vtc ON i.VIF_TYPE = vtc.VIF_TYPE CROSS JOIN AverageVifTypePorts AS avp) SELECT nmd.network_id, nmd.network_name, nmd.tenant_id, nmd.admin_state_up, nmd.mtu, nmd.standard_attr_updated_at, nmd.window_column AS network_row_number_within_tenant, nmd.benchmark_mtu, nmd.mtu_category, pvd.PORT_ID, pvd.HOST, pvd.VIF_TYPE, pvd.VNIC_TYPE, pvd.MAC_ADDRESS, pvd.STATUS AS port_status, WITH down_ports AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT p.ID AS port_id, p.TENANT_ID AS tenant_id, p.MAC_ADDRESS AS mac_address, SUM(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER (PARTITION BY sgpb.SECURITY_GROUP_ID ORDER BY p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) AS window_column FROM `securitygroupportbindings` AS sgpb JOIN `ports` AS p ON sgpb.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN `portsecuritybindings` AS psb ON p.ID = psb.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57')) SELECT port_id, tenant_id, mac_address, window_column FROM inner_cte WHERE window_column > (SELECT AVG(window_column) FROM inner_cte)), admin_up_ports AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT b.PORT_ID, b.HOST, b.VIF_TYPE, b.VNIC_TYPE, p.TENANT_ID, p.NETWORK_ID, p.MAC_ADDRESS, p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER, AVG(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER (PARTITION BY b.VIF_TYPE ORDER BY p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM `ml2_port_bindings` AS b JOIN `ports` AS p ON b.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN `portsecuritybindings` AS psb ON p.ID = psb.PORT_ID WHERE p.ADMIN_STATE_UP = 1 AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57')), VifTypeAverages AS (SELECT VIF_TYPE, AVG(window_column) AS avg_window_column FROM inner_cte GROUP BY VIF_TYPE) SELECT i.PORT_ID, i.HOST, i.VIF_TYPE, i.VNIC_TYPE, i.TENANT_ID, i.NETWORK_ID, i.MAC_ADDRESS, i.STATUS, i.DEVICE_OWNER, i.window_column FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN VifTypeAverages AS v ON v.VIF_TYPE = i.VIF_TYPE WHERE i.window_column > v.avg_window_column) SELECT a.PORT_ID, a.HOST, a.VIF_TYPE, a.VNIC_TYPE, a.TENANT_ID, a.NETWORK_ID, a.MAC_ADDRESS, a.STATUS, a.DEVICE_OWNER, a.window_column AS admin_up_windowed_avg_standard_attr_id, d.window_column AS down_running_sum_standard_attr_id FROM admin_up_ports AS a JOIN down_ports AS d ON d.port_id = a.PORT_ID ORDER BY a.window_column DESC, d.window_column DESC

WITH up_ports AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT b.PORT_ID, b.HOST, b.VIF_TYPE, b.VNIC_TYPE, p.TENANT_ID, p.NETWORK_ID, p.MAC_ADDRESS, p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER, AVG(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER (PARTITION BY b.VIF_TYPE ORDER BY p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM `ml2_port_bindings` AS b JOIN `ports` AS p ON b.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN `portsecuritybindings` AS psb ON p.ID = psb.PORT_ID WHERE p.ADMIN_STATE_UP = 1 AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57')), VifTypeCounts AS (SELECT VIF_TYPE, COUNT(*) AS ports_in_vif_type FROM inner_cte GROUP BY VIF_TYPE), OverallWindowAvg AS (SELECT AVG(window_column) AS overall_avg_window_column FROM inner_cte) SELECT i.PORT_ID, i.HOST, i.VIF_TYPE, i.VNIC_TYPE, i.TENANT_ID, i.NETWORK_ID, i.MAC_ADDRESS, i.STATUS, i.DEVICE_OWNER, i.window_column, vtc.ports_in_vif_type, (i.window_column - owa.overall_avg_window_column) AS deviation_from_overall_window_avg FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN VifTypeCounts AS vtc ON i.VIF_TYPE = vtc.VIF_TYPE CROSS JOIN OverallWindowAvg AS owa), down_ports AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address, sgpb.security_group_id, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY sgpb.security_group_id ORDER BY p.id) AS window_column FROM `securitygroupportbindings` AS sgpb JOIN `ports` AS p ON sgpb.port_id = p.id JOIN `portsecuritybindings` AS psb ON p.id = psb.port_id WHERE p.status = 'DOWN' AND p.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57')), avg_rank_cte AS (SELECT AVG(window_column) AS avg_rank FROM inner_cte) SELECT i.port_id, i.tenant_id, i.mac_address, i.security_group_id, i.window_column AS rank_within_security_group, (i.window_column - a.avg_rank) AS deviation_from_avg_rank FROM inner_cte AS i CROSS JOIN avg_rank_cte AS a) SELECT u.PORT_ID, u.HOST, u.VIF_TYPE, u.VNIC_TYPE, u.TENANT_ID, u.NETWORK_ID, u.MAC_ADDRESS, u.STATUS, u.DEVICE_OWNER, u.window_column AS up_ports_window_avg_standard_attr_id, u.ports_in_vif_type, u.deviation_from_overall_window_avg, d.security_group_id, d.rank_within_security_group, d.deviation_from_avg_rank FROM up_ports AS u JOIN down_ports AS d ON u.PORT_ID = d.port_id ORDER BY u.VIF_TYPE, u.PORT_ID

WITH q1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT b.PORT_ID, b.HOST, b.VIF_TYPE, b.VNIC_TYPE, p.TENANT_ID, p.NETWORK_ID, p.MAC_ADDRESS, p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER, AVG(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER (PARTITION BY ON p.ID = psb.PORT_ID WHERE p.ADMIN_STATE_UP = 1 AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57')), VifTypeCounts AS (SELECT VIF_TYPE, COUNT(*) AS total_ports FROM inner_cte GROUP BY VIF_TYPE), `ports` AS p2 ON p2.status = i.status JOIN `ml2_port_bindings` AS b2 ON p2.id = b2.port_id WHERE b2.vif_type = 'ovs' AND p2.device_id IN ('da811c75-0f9b-462c-b020-8ea55f6ca7c7') GROUP BY i.status, i.min_admin_state_up, i.avg_standard_attr_id ORDER BY total_ports DESC LIMIT 10) SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT q1.PORT_ID) AS tenant_98333_admin_up_ports_count, COUNT(DISTINCT q2.status) AS WITH networks_subq AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT n.ID AS network_id, n.NAME AS network_name, n.TENANT_ID AS tenant_id, n.ADMIN_STATE_UP AS admin_state_up, n.MTU AS mtu, sa.UPDATED_AT AS standard_attr_updated_at, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.TENANT_ID ORDER BY n.NAME) AS window_column FROM `networks` AS n JOIN `standardattributes` AS sa ON sa.ID = n.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE n.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND n.TENANT_ID IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57')), avg_mtu_cte AS (SELECT AVG(mtu) AS avg_mtu FROM inner_cte) SELECT i.network_id, i.network_name, i.tenant_id, i.admin_state_up, i.mtu, i.standard_attr_updated_at, i.window_column, (i.mtu - a.avg_mtu) AS deviation_from_avg_mtu FROM inner_cte AS i CROSS JOIN avg_mtu_cte AS a), ports_subq AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT b.PORT_ID, b.HOST, b.VIF_TYPE, b.VNIC_TYPE, p.TENANT_ID, p.NETWORK_ID, p.MAC_ADDRESS, p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER, AVG(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER (PARTITION BY b.VIF_TYPE ORDER BY p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM `ml2_port_bindings` AS b JOIN `ports` AS p ON b.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN `portsecuritybindings` AS psb ON p.ID = psb.PORT_ID WHERE p.ADMIN_STATE_UP = 1 AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57')), VifTypeCounts AS (SELECT VIF_TYPE, COUNT(*) AS ports_in_vif_type FROM inner_cte GROUP BY VIF_TYPE), OverallWindowAvg AS (SELECT AVG(window_column) AS overall_avg_window_column FROM inner_cte) SELECT i.PORT_ID, i.HOST, i.VIF_TYPE, i.VNIC_TYPE, i.TENANT_ID, i.NETWORK_ID, i.MAC_ADDRESS, i.STATUS, i.DEVICE_OWNER, i.window_column, vtc.ports_in_vif_type, (i.window_column - owa.overall_avg_window_column) AS deviation_from_overall_window_avg FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN VifTypeCounts AS vtc ON i.VIF_TYPE = vtc.VIF_TYPE CROSS JOIN OverallWindowAvg AS owa) SELECT n.network_id, n.network_name, n.tenant_id, n.admin_state_up AS network_admin_state_up, n.mtu, n.standard_attr_updated_at, n.window_column AS network_row_number_within_tenant, n.deviation_from_avg_mtu, p.PORT_ID, p.HOST, p.VIF_TYPE, p.VNIC_TYPE, p.MAC_ADDRESS, p.STATUS AS port_status, p.DEVICE_OWNER, p.window_column AS port_windowed_avg_standard_attr_id, p.ports_in_vif_type, p.deviation_from_overall_window_avg FROM networks_subq AS n JOIN ports_subq AS p ON p.NETWORK_ID = n.network_id AND p.TENANT_ID = n.tenant_id

WITH q1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT n.ID AS network_id, n.NAME AS network_name, n.TENANT_ID AS tenant_id, n.ADMIN_STATE_UP AS admin_state_up, n.MTU AS mtu, sa.UPDATED_AT AS standard_attr_updated_at, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.TENANT_ID ORDER BY n.NAME) AS window_column FROM `networks` AS n JOIN `standardattributes` AS sa ON sa.ID = n.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE n.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND n.TENANT_ID IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57')) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(admin_state_up) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE CAST(admin_state_up AS CHAR) END AS admin_state_up, COUNT(DISTINCT network_id) AS total_networks, MAX(standard_attr_updated_at) AS max_standard_attr_updated_at FROM inner_cte GROUP BY admin_state_up WITH ROLLUP), q2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT s.name, MAX(s.ip_version) AS max_ip_version, s.gateway_ip FROM `networkrbacs` AS n JOIN `subnets` AS s ON n.object_id = s.network_id WHERE n.action = 'access_as_shared' AND n.target_tenant = '*' GROUP BY s.name, s.gateway_ip HAVING MAX(s.ip_version) > 3) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(name) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE name END AS name, CASE WHEN GROUPING(gateway_ip) = 1 AND GROUPING(name) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(gateway_ip) = 1 AND GROUPING(name) = 1 THEN 'ALL' ELSE gateway_ip END AS gateway_ip, MAX(max_ip_version) AS max_ip_version, COUNT(*) AS total_groups FROM inner_cte GROUP BY name, gateway_ip WITH ROLLUP) SELECT q1.admin_state_up, q1.total_networks, q1.max_standard_attr_updated_at, q2.name AS subnet_name, q2.gateway_ip, q2.max_ip_version, q2.total_groups FROM q1 CROSS JOIN q2 ORDER BY q1.admin_state_up, q2.name, q2.gateway_ip

WITH q1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT n.name, n.status, n.admin_state_up, r.action, r.target_tenant, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.id ORDER BY n.id) AS window_column FROM `networksecuritybindings` AS b JOIN `networks` AS n ON b.network_id = n.id JOIN `networkrbacs` AS r ON n.id = r.object_id WHERE n.status = 'ACTIVE' AND NOT n.id IN (SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM `networkrbacs` WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b'))), ActionExternalSummary AS (SELECT i.action, CASE WHEN NOT en.network_id IS NULL THEN 'External' ELSE 'Internal' END AS external_status, COUNT(*) AS total_rows FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN `networks` AS n ON n.name = i.name AND n.status = i.status AND n.admin_state_up = i.admin_state_up LEFT JOIN `externalnetworks` AS en ON n.id = en.network_id GROUP BY i.action, external_status) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(action) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE action END AS action, CASE WHEN GROUPING(external_status) = 1 AND GROUPING(action) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' ELSE external_status END AS external_status, SUM(total_rows) AS total_rows FROM ActionExternalSummary GROUP BY action, external_status WITH ROLLUP), q2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT n.ACTION, AVG(s.IP_VERSION) AS avg_ip_version, VARIANCE(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_variance, STDDEV(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_stddev FROM `networkrbacs` AS n JOIN `subnets` AS s ON n.OBJECT_ID = s.NETWORK_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4 AND n.ACTION = 'access_as_shared' GROUP BY n.ACTION ORDER BY ip_version_variance DESC) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(action) OVER (ORDER BY action_sort, action) = action THEN NULL ELSE action END AS action, avg_ip_version, ip_version_variance, ip_version_stddev FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.action) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE i.action END AS action_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.action) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE i.action END AS action, AVG(i.avg_ip_version) AS avg_ip_version, AVG(i.ip_version_variance) AS ip_version_variance, AVG(i.ip_version_stddev) AS ip_version_stddev FROM inner_cte AS i GROUP BY i.action WITH ROLLUP) AS tbltmp ORDER BY action_sort) SELECT q1.action, q1.external_status, q1.total_rows, q2.avg_ip_version, q2.ip_version_variance, q2.ip_version_stddev, ROUND(q1.total_rows / NULLIF(SUM(q1.total_rows) OVER (PARTITION BY q1.action), 0), 4) AS pct_of_action_total FROM q1 LEFT JOIN q2 ON q2.action = q1.action ORDER BY CASE WHEN q1.action = 'GRAND TOTAL' THEN 2 ELSE 1 END, q1.action, CASE WHEN q1.external_status = 'SUBTOTAL' THEN 2 ELSE 1 END, q1.external_status

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS active_shared_rbac_networks FROM `networks` AS n JOIN `networkrbacs` AS r ON n.ID = r.OBJECT_ID WHERE n.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND r.ACTION = 'access_as_shared') SELECT n.tenant_id, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id) AS total_active_shared_networks, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN r.target_tenant <> '*' THEN r.id END) > 0 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_specific_target_tenant_share FROM `networks` AS n JOIN `networkrbacs` AS r ON n.ID = r.OBJECT_ID CROSS JOIN inner_cte WHERE n.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND r.ACTION = 'access_as_shared' GROUP BY n.tenant_id ORDER BY total_active_shared_networks DESC LIMIT 10

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT n.name, n.status, n.admin_state_up, r.action, r.target_tenant, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.id ORDER BY n.id) AS window_column FROM `networksecuritybindings` AS b JOIN `networks` AS n ON b.network_id = n.id JOIN `networkrbacs` AS r ON n.id = r.object_id WHERE n.status = 'ACTIVE'), NetworkRbacCounts AS (SELECT n.id AS network_id, COUNT(r.id) AS total_rbacs FROM `networks` AS n JOIN `networkrbacs` AS r ON n.id = r.object_id WHERE n.status = 'ACTIVE' GROUP BY n.id) SELECT i.name, i.status, i.admin_state_up, i.action, i.target_tenant, i.window_column FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN `networks` AS n ON n.name = i.name AND n.status = i.status AND n.admin_state_up = i.admin_state_up JOIN NetworkRbacCounts AS c ON c.network_id = n.id WHERE c.total_rbacs > (SELECT AVG(total_rbacs) FROM NetworkRbacCounts)

WITH q1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT n.name, n.status, n.admin_state_up, r.action, r.target_tenant, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.id ORDER BY n.id) AS window_column FROM `networksecuritybindings` AS b JOIN `networks` AS n ON b.network_id = n.id JOIN `networkrbacs` AS r ON n.id = r.object_id WHERE n.status = 'ACTIVE'), NetworkRbacCounts AS (SELECT n.id AS network_id, COUNT(r.id) AS total_rbacs FROM `networks` AS n JOIN `networkrbacs` AS r ON n.id = r.object_id WHERE n.status = 'ACTIVE' GROUP BY n.id) SELECT i.name, i.status, i.admin_state_up, i.action, i.target_tenant, i.window_column FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN `networks` AS n ON n.name = i.name AND n.status = i.status AND n.admin_state_up = i.admin_state_up JOIN NetworkRbacCounts AS c ON c.network_id = n.id WHERE c.total_rbacs > (SELECT AVG(total_rbacs) FROM NetworkRbacCounts)), q2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT n.name, n.status, n.admin_state_up, r.action, r.target_tenant, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.id ORDER BY n.id) AS window_column FROM `networksecuritybindings` AS b JOIN `networks` AS n ON b.network_id = n.id JOIN `networkrbacs` AS r ON n.id = r.object_id WHERE n.status = 'ACTIVE'), rbac_counts AS (SELECT n.id AS network_id, COUNT(DISTINCT r.target_tenant) AS distinct_target_tenants FROM `networksecuritybindings` AS b JOIN `networks` AS n ON b.network_id = n.id JOIN `networkrbacs` AS r ON n.id = r.object_id WHERE n.status = 'ACTIVE' GROUP BY n.id) SELECT i.name, i.status, i.admin_state_up, i.action, i.target_tenant, c.distinct_target_tenants, i.window_column FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN rbac_counts AS c ON c.network_id = (SELECT n2.id FROM `networks` AS n2 WHERE n2.name = i.name AND n2.status = i.status AND n2.admin_state_up = i.admin_state_up LIMIT 1)) SELECT q1.name, q1.status, q1.admin_state_up, q1.action, q1.target_tenant, q2.distinct_target_tenants, q1.window_column FROM q1 JOIN q2 ON q1.name = q2.name AND q1.status = q2.status AND q1.admin_state_up = q2.admin_state_up AND q1.action = q2.action AND q1.target_tenant = q2.target_tenant AND q1.window_column = q2.window_column

SELECT MIN(t0.ID) AS min_rbac_id, AVG(t1.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) AS avg_standard_attr_id FROM `networkrbacs` AS t0 JOIN `subnets` AS t1 ON t0.OBJECT_ID = t1.NETWORK_ID WHERE t0.ACTION = 'access_as_shared' AND t0.TARGET_TENANT = '*' GROUP BY t1.NETWORK_ID

WITH inner_cte AS (WITH NetworkStatusSecurityStats AS (SELECT n.STATUS AS network_status, VARIANCE(nsb.PORT_SECURITY_ENABLED) AS port_security_enabled_variance, STDDEV(nsb.PORT_SECURITY_ENABLED) AS port_security_enabled_stddev FROM `networks` AS n JOIN `networksecuritybindings` AS nsb ON n.ID = nsb.NETWORK_ID WHERE NOT n.ID IN (SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM `networkrbacs` WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b')) GROUP BY n.STATUS ORDER BY port_security_enabled_variance DESC), ActiveNetworkRbacDetails AS (SELECT n.name, n.status, n.admin_state_up, r.action, r.target_tenant, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.id ORDER BY n.id) AS window_column FROM `networksecuritybindings` AS b JOIN `networks` AS n ON b.network_id = n.id JOIN `networkrbacs` AS r ON n.id = r.object_id WHERE n.status = 'ACTIVE' AND NOT n.id IN (SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM `networkrbacs` WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b'))), ActiveNetworkCountsByStatus AS (SELECT status AS network_status, COUNT(DISTINCT name) AS active_network_count FROM ActiveNetworkRbacDetails GROUP BY status) SELECT nsss.network_status, anc.active_network_count, nsss.port_security_enabled_variance, nsss.port_security_enabled_stddev FROM NetworkStatusSecurityStats AS nsss JOIN ActiveNetworkCountsByStatus AS anc ON nsss.network_status = anc.network_status ORDER BY anc.active_network_count DESC, nsss.port_security_enabled_variance DESC), tenant_active_networks AS (SELECT n.tenant_id, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id) AS total_active_networks FROM `networks` AS n WHERE n.status = 'ACTIVE' AND NOT n.id IN (SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM `networkrbacs` WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b')) GROUP BY n.tenant_id), tenant_rbac_presence AS (SELECT n.tenant_id, COUNT(DISTINCT r.id) AS total_rbac_rows FROM `networks` AS n LEFT JOIN `networkrbacs` AS r ON r.object_id = n.id WHERE n.status = 'ACTIVE' AND NOT n.id IN (SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM `networkrbacs` WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b')) GROUP BY n.tenant_id) SELECT tan.tenant_id, tan.total_active_networks, CASE WHEN trp.total_rbac_rows > 0 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_any_network_rbac, COUNT(DISTINCT ic.network_status) AS statuses_covered_in_inner_cte FROM tenant_active_networks AS tan LEFT JOIN tenant_rbac_presence AS trp ON trp.tenant_id = tan.tenant_id LEFT JOIN `networks` AS n ON n.tenant_id = tan.tenant_id LEFT JOIN inner_cte AS ic ON ic.network_status = n.status GROUP BY tan.tenant_id, tan.total_active_networks, trp.total_rbac_rows ORDER BY tan.total_active_networks DESC LIMIT 10

WITH SubnetDNSOrderVariation AS (SELECT s.name AS subnet_name, STDDEV(d.`order`) / NULLIF(AVG(d.`order`), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM `subnets` AS s JOIN `dnsnameservers` AS d ON d.subnet_id = s.id JOIN `ipallocationpools` AS p ON p.subnet_id = s.id JOIN `networks` AS n ON n.id = s.network_id WHERE s.ip_version = 4 AND NOT n.id IN (SELECT r.object_id FROM `networkrbacs` AS r WHERE r.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (r.target_tenant = '*' OR r.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b')) GROUP BY s.name HAVING AVG(d.`order`) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC), SharedSubnetWindowedAttrs AS (SELECT s.NAME AS subnet_name, s.CIDR AS subnet_cidr, n.TARGET_TENANT AS rbac_target_tenant, SUM(s.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER (PARTITION BY s.IP_VERSION ORDER BY s.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) AS window_column FROM `subnets` AS s JOIN `networkrbacs` AS n ON n.OBJECT_ID = s.NETWORK_ID WHERE n.ACTION = 'access_as_shared' AND n.TARGET_TENANT IN ('1ee6b5b4fe8c45cfa16c3ecdbb8ee02b')) SELECT sswa.subnet_name, sswa.subnet_cidr, sswa.rbac_target_tenant, sswa.window_column, sdo.coefficient_of_variation FROM SharedSubnetWindowedAttrs AS sswa JOIN SubnetDNSOrderVariation AS sdo ON sswa.subnet_name = sdo.subnet_name WHERE sdo.coefficient_of_variation > 0 ORDER BY sdo.coefficient_of_variation DESC

WITH subq1 AS (SELECT n.ACTION, STDDEV(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_stddev FROM `networkrbacs` AS n JOIN `subnets` AS s ON n.OBJECT_ID = s.NETWORK_ID WHERE s.ENABLE_DHCP = 1 AND NOT s.NETWORK_ID IN (SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM `networkrbacs` WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b')) GROUP BY n.ACTION HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY ip_version_stddev DESC), subq2 AS (SELECT n.ACTION AS rbac_action, AVG(s.IP_VERSION) AS avg_ip_version, MAX(s.IP_VERSION) - MIN(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_range, VARIANCE(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_variance FROM `networkrbacs` AS n JOIN `subnets` AS s ON n.OBJECT_ID = s.NETWORK_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION IN (4, 6) AND n.ACTION = 'access_as_shared' GROUP BY n.ACTION ORDER BY ip_version_range DESC) SELECT subq1.ACTION AS action, subq1.ip_version_stddev, subq2.avg_ip_version, subq2.ip_version_range, subq2.ip_version_variance FROM subq1 JOIN subq2 ON subq1.ACTION = subq2.rbac_action ORDER BY subq1.ip_version_stddev DESC

WITH down_ports AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT p.ID AS port_id, p.TENANT_ID AS tenant_id, p.NAME AS port_name, p.NETWORK_ID AS network_id, p.MAC_ADDRESS AS mac_address, p.DEVICE_OWNER AS device_owner, ia.IP_ADDRESS AS ip_address, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p.NETWORK_ID ORDER BY p.ID) AS window_column FROM `ports` AS p JOIN `ipallocations` AS ia ON p.ID = ia.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN'), NetworkDownAllocations AS (SELECT network_id, COUNT(DISTINCT ip_address) AS down_allocated_ips FROM inner_cte GROUP BY network_id), AverageNetworkDownAllocations AS (SELECT AVG(down_allocated_ips) AS avg_down_allocated_ips FROM NetworkDownAllocations) SELECT i.port_id, i.tenant_id, i.port_name, i.network_id, i.mac_address, i.device_owner, i.ip_address, i.window_column, nda.down_allocated_ips, (nda.down_allocated_ips - anda.avg_down_allocated_ips) AS deviation_from_avg FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN NetworkDownAllocations AS nda ON i.network_id = nda.network_id CROSS JOIN AverageNetworkDownAllocations AS anda), active_networks AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT n.ID AS network_id, n.NAME AS network_name, n.TENANT_ID AS tenant_id, n.ADMIN_STATE_UP AS admin_state_up, n.MTU AS mtu, sa.UPDATED_AT AS standard_attr_updated_at, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.TENANT_ID ORDER BY n.NAME) AS window_column FROM `networks` AS n JOIN `standardattributes` AS sa ON sa.ID = n.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE n.STATUS = 'ACTIVE'), AvgMtu AS (SELECT AVG(mtu) AS avg_mtu FROM inner_cte) SELECT i.network_id, i.network_name, i.tenant_id, i.admin_state_up, i.mtu, i.standard_attr_updated_at, i.window_column, a.avg_mtu AS benchmark_avg_mtu, CASE WHEN i.mtu > a.avg_mtu THEN 'ABOVE_AVG_MTU' WHEN i.mtu < a.avg_mtu THEN 'BELOW_AVG_MTU' ELSE 'AT_AVG_MTU' END AS mtu_category FROM inner_cte AS i CROSS JOIN AvgMtu AS a) SELECT dp.port_id, dp.tenant_id AS port_tenant_id, dp.port_name, dp.network_id, an.network_name, an.tenant_id AS network_tenant_id, an.admin_state_up, an.mtu, an.standard_attr_updated_at, an.window_column AS network_rownum_within_tenant, an.benchmark_avg_mtu, an.mtu_category, dp.mac_address, dp.device_owner, dp.ip_address, dp.window_column AS port_rownum_within_network, dp.down_allocated_ips, dp.deviation_from_avg FROM down_ports AS dp JOIN active_networks AS an ON dp.network_id = an.network_id

WITH port_security_by_port AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address, COUNT(psb.port_id) AS binding_count, SUM(CASE WHEN psb.port_security_enabled THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS port_security_enabled_total FROM `ports` AS p JOIN `portsecuritybindings` AS psb ON p.id = psb.port_id WHERE p.admin_state_up = 1 AND p.tenant_id IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') GROUP BY p.id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(port_id) OVER (ORDER BY port_id_sort, port_id) = port_id THEN NULL ELSE port_id END AS port_id, tenant_id, mac_address, binding_count, port_security_enabled_total FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.port_id) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE i.port_id END AS port_id_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.port_id) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE i.port_id END AS port_id, MAX(i.tenant_id) AS tenant_id, MAX(i.mac_address) AS mac_address, SUM(i.binding_count) AS binding_count, SUM(i.port_security_enabled_total) AS port_security_enabled_total FROM inner_cte AS i GROUP BY i.port_id WITH ROLLUP) AS tbltmp ORDER BY port_id_sort), active_networks_by_tenant AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT n.ID AS network_id, n.NAME AS network_name, n.TENANT_ID AS tenant_id, n.ADMIN_STATE_UP AS admin_state_up, n.MTU AS mtu, sa.UPDATED_AT AS standard_attr_updated_at, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.TENANT_ID ORDER BY n.NAME) AS window_column FROM `networks` AS n JOIN `standardattributes` AS sa ON sa.ID = n.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE n.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND n.TENANT_ID IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57')) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(tenant_id) OVER (ORDER BY tenant_id_sort, tenant_id, network_name) = tenant_id THEN NULL ELSE tenant_id END AS tenant_id, network_id, network_name, admin_state_up, mtu, standard_attr_updated_at, window_column, total_networks FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(tenant_id) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE tenant_id END AS tenant_id_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(tenant_id) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE tenant_id END AS tenant_id, CASE WHEN GROUPING(tenant_id) = 1 THEN NULL ELSE network_id END AS network_id, CASE WHEN GROUPING(tenant_id) = 1 THEN NULL ELSE network_name END AS network_name, CASE WHEN GROUPING(tenant_id) = 1 THEN NULL ELSE admin_state_up END AS admin_state_up, CASE WHEN GROUPING(tenant_id) = 1 THEN NULL ELSE mtu END AS mtu, CASE WHEN GROUPING(tenant_id) = 1 THEN NULL ELSE standard_attr_updated_at END AS standard_attr_updated_at, CASE WHEN GROUPING(tenant_id) = 1 THEN NULL ELSE window_column END AS window_column, COUNT(*) AS total_networks FROM inner_cte GROUP BY tenant_id, network_id, network_name, admin_state_up, mtu, standard_attr_updated_at, window_column WITH ROLLUP) AS tbltmp ORDER BY tenant_id_sort, tenant_id, network_name) SELECT ps.port_id, ps.tenant_id AS port_tenant_id, ps.mac_address, ps.binding_count, ps.port_security_enabled_total, an.tenant_id AS network_tenant_id, an.network_id, an.network_name, an.admin_state_up AS network_admin_state_up, an.mtu, an.standard_attr_updated_at, an.window_column, an.total_networks FROM port_security_by_port AS ps CROSS JOIN active_networks_by_tenant AS an

WITH networks_mtu_detail AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT n.ID AS network_id, n.NAME AS network_name, n.TENANT_ID AS tenant_id, n.ADMIN_STATE_UP AS admin_state_up, n.MTU AS mtu, sa.UPDATED_AT AS standard_attr_updated_at, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.TENANT_ID ORDER BY n.NAME) AS window_column FROM `networks` AS n JOIN `standardattributes` AS sa ON sa.ID = n.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE n.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND n.TENANT_ID IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57')), avg_mtu_cte AS (SELECT AVG(mtu) AS avg_mtu FROM inner_cte) SELECT i.network_id, i.network_name, i.tenant_id, i.admin_state_up, i.mtu, i.standard_attr_updated_at, i.window_column, (i.mtu - a.avg_mtu) AS deviation_from_avg_mtu FROM inner_cte AS i CROSS JOIN avg_mtu_cte AS a), ports_sg_ranked AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address, sgpb.security_group_id, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY sgpb.security_group_id ORDER BY p.id) AS window_column FROM `securitygroupportbindings` AS sgpb JOIN `ports` AS p ON sgpb.port_id = p.id JOIN `portsecuritybindings` AS psb ON p.id = psb.port_id WHERE p.status = 'DOWN' AND p.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57')), SecurityGroupAverages AS (SELECT AVG(sg_port_count) AS avg_ports_per_sg FROM (SELECT sgpb2.security_group_id, COUNT(*) AS sg_port_count FROM `securitygroupportbindings` AS sgpb2 JOIN `ports` AS p2 ON sgpb2.port_id = p2.id JOIN `portsecuritybindings` AS psb2 ON p2.id = psb2.port_id GROUP BY sgpb2.security_group_id) AS sg_counts) SELECT i.port_id, i.tenant_id, i.mac_address, i.security_group_id, i.window_column FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN (SELECT sgpb3.security_group_id, COUNT(*) AS total_ports_in_sg FROM `securitygroupportbindings` AS sgpb3 JOIN `ports` AS p3 ON sgpb3.port_id = p3.id JOIN `portsecuritybindings` AS psb3 ON p3.id = psb3.port_id GROUP BY sgpb3.security_group_id) AS sg_totals ON sg_totals.security_group_id = i.security_group_id WHERE sg_totals.total_ports_in_sg > (SELECT avg_ports_per_sg FROM SecurityGroupAverages)) SELECT nmd.network_id, nmd.network_name, nmd.tenant_id, nmd.admin_state_up AS network_admin_state_up, nmd.mtu, nmd.standard_attr_updated_at AS network_standard_attr_updated_at, nmd.window_column AS network_row_number_within_tenant, nmd.deviation_from_avg_mtu, psr.port_id, psr.mac_address, psr.security_group_id, psr.window_column AS port_rank_within_security_group FROM networks_mtu_detail AS nmd JOIN `ports` AS p ON p.network_id = nmd.network_id AND p.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') JOIN ports_sg_ranked AS psr ON psr.port_id = p.id AND psr.tenant_id = p.tenant_id ORDER BY nmd.network_name, psr.security_group_id, psr.port_id

list port ids in security group
find ports associated with a security group
get the port identifier for a security group binding
which security groups are ports bound to
list security group ids for a port
find security group associated with a port
get the security group identifier for a port binding
count distinct security groups per port

sources.sql: WITH PortDnsAndSg AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.tenant_id, p.name AS port_name, COUNT(sgpb.security_group_id) AS security_group_binding_count, SUM(CASE WHEN pd.port_id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) AS dns_record_count FROM `securitygroupportbindings` AS sgpb JOIN `ports` AS p ON sgpb.port_id = p.id LEFT JOIN `portdnses` AS pd ON p.id = pd.port_id WHERE p.admin_state_up = 1 AND p.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') GROUP BY p.id, p.tenant_id, p.name), AverageDns AS (SELECT AVG(dns_record_count) AS avg_dns_records FROM inner_cte) SELECT ic.port_id, ic.tenant_id, ic.port_name, ic.security_group_binding_count, ic.dns_record_count, ad.avg_dns_records AS benchmark, CASE WHEN ic.dns_record_count > ad.avg_dns_records * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_DNS' WHEN ic.dns_record_count < ad.avg_dns_records * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_DNS' ELSE 'AVERAGE_DNS' END AS dns_category FROM inner_cte AS ic CROSS JOIN AverageDns AS ad), ActiveNetworksMtu AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT n.ID AS network_id, n.NAME AS network_name, n.TENANT_ID AS tenant_id, n.ADMIN_STATE_UP AS admin_state_up, n.MTU AS mtu, sa.UPDATED_AT AS standard_attr_updated_at, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.TENANT_ID ORDER BY n.NAME) AS window_column FROM `networks` AS n JOIN `standardattributes` AS sa ON sa.ID = n.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE n.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND n.TENANT_ID IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57')), avg_mtu_cte AS (SELECT AVG(mtu) AS avg_mtu FROM inner_cte) SELECT i.network_id, i.network_name, i.tenant_id, i.admin_state_up, i.mtu, i.standard_attr_updated_at, i.window_column, (i.mtu - a.avg_mtu) AS deviation_from_avg_mtu FROM inner_cte AS i CROSS JOIN avg_mtu_cte AS a) SELECT an.network_id, an.network_name, an.tenant_id, an.admin_state_up AS network_admin_state_up, an.mtu, an.standard_attr_updated_at, an.window_column, an.deviation_from_avg_mtu, COUNT(DISTINCT pds.port_id) AS admin_up_sg_bound_port_count, AVG(pds.dns_record_count) AS avg_dns_records_per_port, SUM(CASE WHEN pds.dns_category = 'HIGH_DNS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_dns_port_count, SUM(CASE WHEN pds.dns_category = 'LOW_DNS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS low_dns_port_count, SUM(CASE WHEN pds.dns_category = 'AVERAGE_DNS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS average_dns_port_count FROM ActiveNetworksMtu AS an JOIN `ports` AS p ON p.network_id = an.network_id AND p.tenant_id = an.tenant_id AND p.admin_state_up = 1 JOIN PortDnsAndSg AS pds ON pds.port_id = p.id AND pds.tenant_id = an.tenant_id GROUP BY an.network_id, an.network_name, an.tenant_id, an.admin_state_up, an.mtu, an.standard_attr_updated_at, an.window_column, an.deviation_from_avg_mtu ORDER BY an.tenant_id, an.network_name

roles: which port does this dns record belong to
find dns records for port id
join port dns with ports table

sources.sql: WITH PortStatusDns_rollup AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.tenant_id, p.name AS port_name, COUNT(sgpb.security_group_id) AS security_group_binding_count, SUM(CASE WHEN pd.port_id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) AS dns_record_count FROM `securitygroupportbindings` AS sgpb JOIN `ports` AS p ON sgpb.port_id = p.id LEFT JOIN `portdnses` AS pd ON p.id = pd.port_id WHERE p.admin_state_up = 1 AND p.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') GROUP BY p.id, p.tenant_id, p.name), PortStatusDns AS (SELECT p.status, CASE WHEN inner_cte.dns_record_count > 0 THEN 'Has DNS' ELSE 'No DNS' END AS dns_presence, COUNT(DISTINCT inner_cte.port_id) AS total_ports FROM inner_cte JOIN `ports` AS p ON inner_cte.port_id = p.id GROUP BY p.status, dns_presence) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(status) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE status END AS status, CASE WHEN GROUPING(dns_presence) = 1 AND GROUPING(status) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' ELSE dns_presence END AS dns_presence, SUM(total_ports) n.ADMIN_STATE_UP AS admin_state_up, n.MTU AS mtu, sa.UPDATED_AT AS standard_attr_updated_at, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.TENANT_ID ORDER BY n.NAME) AS window_column FROM `networks` AS n JOIN
