target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH HostPortMaxAttr AS (SELECT b.HOST, MAX(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) AS max_standard_attr_id, p.STATUS FROM `ml2_port_bindings` AS b JOIN `ports` AS p ON b.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN `allowedaddresspairs` AS a ON p.ID = a.PORT_ID WHERE a.IP_ADDRESS = '10.232.210.41/8' GROUP BY b.HOST, p.STATUS HAVING MAX(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) > 1), StatusAttrVariance AS (SELECT p.STATUS, VARIANCE(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) AS standard_attr_id_variance FROM `ports` AS p JOIN `ipallocations` AS ia ON p.ID = ia.PORT_ID WHERE NOT p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID IS NULL GROUP BY p.STATUS ORDER BY standard_attr_id_variance DESC) SELECT hpma.HOST, hpma.STATUS, hpma.max_standard_attr_id, sav.standard_attr_id_variance FROM HostPortMaxAttr AS hpma JOIN StatusAttrVariance AS sav ON hpma.STATUS = sav.STATUS) SELECT i.HOST, i.STATUS, i.max_standard_attr_id, i.standard_attr_id_variance, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT ia.PORT_ID) > 0 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_ip_allocation_in_group FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN `ml2_port_bindings` AS b ON i.HOST = b.HOST JOIN `ports` AS p ON b.PORT_ID = p.ID AND p.STATUS = i.STATUS LEFT JOIN `ipallocations` AS ia ON p.ID = ia.PORT_ID GROUP BY i.HOST, i.STATUS, i.max_standard_attr_id, i.standard_attr_id_variance

target_disjoint_workload.question: For each host and port status where the port has an allowed address pair with IP address 10.232.210.41/8 and the highest port standard attribute ID in that host/status group is greater than 1, return the host name, the port status, that maximum standard attribute ID, and the variance of standard attribute IDs for that same status across ports that have an IP allocation. Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH HostPortMaxAttr AS (SELECT b.HOST, MAX(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) AS max_standard_attr_id, p.STATUS FROM `ml2_port_bindings` AS b JOIN `ports` AS p ON b.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN `allowedaddresspairs` AS a ON p.ID = a.PORT_ID WHERE a.IP_ADDRESS = '10.232.210.41/8' GROUP BY b.HOST, p.STATUS HAVING MAX(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) > 1), StatusAttrVariance AS (SELECT p.STATUS, VARIANCE(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) AS standard_attr_id_variance FROM `ports` AS p JOIN `ipallocations` AS ia ON p.ID = ia.PORT_ID WHERE NOT p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID IS NULL GROUP BY p.STATUS ORDER BY standard_attr_id_variance DESC) SELECT hpma.HOST, hpma.STATUS, hpma.max_standard_attr_id, sav.standard_attr_id_variance FROM HostPortMaxAttr AS hpma JOIN StatusAttrVariance AS sav ON hpma.STATUS = sav.STATUS

target_disjoint_workload.question: For each subnet name, report the minimum DNS nameserver order and the average IP version (considering only subnets where the IP version is 4 and the DNS nameserver address is 10.107.23.242/8), and also include the overall average of these per-subnet minimum DNS orders across all such subnets. Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT MIN(t2.`ORDER`) AS min_dns_order, AVG(t1.IP_VERSION) AS avg_ip_version FROM `subnetroutes` AS t0 JOIN `subnets` AS t1 ON t0.SUBNET_ID = t1.ID JOIN `dnsnameservers` AS t2 ON t1.ID = t2.SUBNET_ID WHERE t1.IP_VERSION = 4 AND t2.ADDRESS = '10.107.23.242/8' GROUP BY t1.NAME) SELECT inner_cte.min_dns_order, inner_cte.avg_ip_version, overall_avg.avg_min_dns_order FROM inner_cte JOIN (SELECT AVG(min_dns_order) AS avg_min_dns_order FROM inner_cte) AS overall_avg ON 1 = 1

target_disjoint_workload.question: For each subnet name, considering only subnets where the IP version is 4 and the DNS nameserver address is 10.107.23.242/8, list the subnet name along with the minimum DNS nameserver order and average IP version, but only include subnet names whose minimum DNS nameserver order is greater than 0. Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT MIN(t2.`ORDER`) AS min_dns_order, AVG(t1.IP_VERSION) AS avg_ip_version FROM `subnetroutes` AS t0 JOIN `subnets` AS t1 ON t0.SUBNET_ID = t1.ID JOIN `dnsnameservers` AS t2 ON t1.ID = t2.SUBNET_ID WHERE t1.IP_VERSION = 4 AND t2.ADDRESS = '10.107.23.242/8' GROUP BY t1.NAME) SELECT min_dns_order, avg_ip_version FROM inner_cte WHERE min_dns_order > 0

target_disjoint_workload.question: For IPv4 subnets that are in the top 10 by DNS nameserver order range and that have DNS nameservers configured, return the subnet name, tenant ID, network ID, IP version, CIDR, gateway IP, DHCP enabled flag, the allocation pool’s first and last IP (only where the first IP is the minimum for that subnet), the maximum subnet standard attribute ID over the current row and next 2 rows by subnet ID, plus the DNS nameserver order range and order variance. Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH DnsOrderRangeTop10 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT s.name AS subnet_name, MAX(d.`ORDER`) - MIN(d.`ORDER`) AS order_range, VARIANCE(d.`ORDER`) AS order_variance FROM `subnets` AS s JOIN `dnsnameservers` AS d ON s.id = d.subnet_id WHERE s.ip_version = 4 GROUP BY s.name ORDER BY order_range DESC) SELECT i.subnet_name, i.order_range, i.order_variance, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT d2.address) > 0 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_dns_nameservers FROM inner_cte AS i LEFT JOIN `subnets` AS s2 ON s2.name = i.subnet_name LEFT JOIN `dnsnameservers` AS d2 ON d2.subnet_id = s2.id GROUP BY i.subnet_name, i.order_range, i.order_variance ORDER BY i.order_range DESC LIMIT 10), SubnetAllocationPoolMinFirstIp AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT s.NAME, s.TENANT_ID, s.NETWORK_ID, s.IP_VERSION, s.CIDR, s.GATEWAY_IP, s.ENABLE_DHCP, p.FIRST_IP, p.LAST_IP, MAX(s.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER (ORDER BY s.ID ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_standard_attr_id_next2 FROM `subnets` AS s JOIN `ipallocationpools` AS p ON s.ID = p.SUBNET_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4) SELECT i.NAME, i.TENANT_ID, i.NETWORK_ID, i.IP_VERSION, i.CIDR, i.GATEWAY_IP, i.ENABLE_DHCP, i.FIRST_IP, i.LAST_IP, i.max_standard_attr_id_next2 FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN `subnets` AS s2 ON s2.TENANT_ID = i.TENANT_ID JOIN `ipallocationpools` AS p2 ON p2.SUBNET_ID = s2.ID WHERE i.FIRST_IP = (SELECT MIN(p3.FIRST_IP) FROM `ipallocationpools` AS p3 WHERE p3.SUBNET_ID = s2.ID)) SELECT sap.NAME AS subnet_name, sap.TENANT_ID, sap.NETWORK_ID, sap.IP_VERSION, sap.CIDR, sap.GATEWAY_IP, sap.ENABLE_DHCP, sap.FIRST_IP AS allocation_pool_first_ip, sap.LAST_IP AS allocation_pool_last_ip, sap.max_standard_attr_id_next2, dor.order_range, dor.order_variance, dor.has_dns_nameservers FROM SubnetAllocationPoolMinFirstIp AS sap JOIN DnsOrderRangeTop10 AS dor ON dor.subnet_name = sap.NAME WHERE dor.has_dns_nameservers = 'Yes' ORDER BY dor.order_range DESC, sap.NAME

target_disjoint_workload.question: For each subnet that has DHCP enabled and whose subnet id is one of ('012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48', '0807c5b3-aa6c-4108-8884-7b4948a19178', '0814cd95-6c95-4669-8415-e555344bb15b', '16eaae8c-1920-4b8b-8765-f149dde8a1a6', '1e360a1e-339a-4dc7-a250-28c31fcd905a', '2019039a-089f-408c-b080-201a0c5cbe6f', '25a309b3-7334-44b7-99b5-85a874d28475', '25e390e6-3a89-42d7-a5e8-c4da22edc587', '26a23140-1cb7-4ccd-b2d7-50611eb82663', '2f08159a-e945-4ba2-a583-431d1f8078d9'), list the subnet name, tenant id, network id, IP version, CIDR, gateway IP, the DNS nameserver address and its order, the allocation pool first and last IP, and the maximum DNS nameserver order considering the current row and the next 2 rows when ordered by subnet id and DNS nameserver order. Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: SELECT s.name AS subnet_name, s.tenant_id, s.network_id, s.ip_version, s.cidr, s.gateway_ip, d.address AS dns_address, d.`ORDER` AS dns_order, p.first_ip, p.last_ip, MAX(d.`ORDER`) OVER (ORDER BY s.id, d.`ORDER` ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_dns_order_next_2 FROM `subnets` AS s JOIN `dnsnameservers` AS d ON d.subnet_id = s.id JOIN `ipallocationpools` AS p ON p.subnet_id = s.id WHERE s.enable_dhcp = 1 AND s.id IN ('012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48', '0807c5b3-aa6c-4108-8884-7b4948a19178', '0814cd95-6c95-4669-8415-e555344bb15b', '16eaae8c-1920-4b8b-8765-f149dde8a1a6', '1e360a1e-339a-4dc7-a250-28c31fcd905a', '2019039a-089f-408c-b080-201a0c5cbe6f', '25a309b3-7334-44b7-99b5-85a874d28475', '25e390e6-3a89-42d7-a5e8-c4da22edc587', '26a23140-1cb7-4ccd-b2d7-50611eb82663', '2f08159a-e945-4ba2-a583-431d1f8078d9')

target_disjoint_workload.question: List the IPv4 subnet names that either have a DNS nameserver order coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) categorized as HIGH_VARIATION relative to the overall IPv4 benchmark, or have a DNS nameserver order range greater than the average order range across all IPv4 subnets, along with the reason for inclusion. Do not return any rounded answers. Categorize each subnet as 'HIGH_VARIATION' (at least 50% higher than the benchmark), 'LOW_VARIATION' (at least 50% lower than the benchmark), or 'AVERAGE_VARIATION'.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH CoeffVariationSubnets AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT s.name AS subnet_name, STDDEV(d.`ORDER`) / NULLIF(AVG(d.`ORDER`), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM `subnets` AS s JOIN `dnsnameservers` AS d ON d.subnet_id = s.id JOIN `ipallocationpools` AS p ON p.subnet_id = s.id WHERE s.ip_version = 4 GROUP BY s.name HAVING AVG(d.`ORDER`) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC), AvgCoeff AS (SELECT AVG(coefficient_of_variation) AS avg_coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte) SELECT i.subnet_name, i.coefficient_of_variation, a.avg_coefficient_of_variation AS benchmark, CASE WHEN i.coefficient_of_variation > a.avg_coefficient_of_variation * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_VARIATION' WHEN i.coefficient_of_variation < a.avg_coefficient_of_variation * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_VARIATION' ELSE 'AVERAGE_VARIATION' END AS variation_category FROM inner_cte AS i CROSS JOIN AvgCoeff AS a ORDER BY i.coefficient_of_variation DESC), HighRangeSubnets AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT s.name AS subnet_name, MAX(d.`ORDER`) - MIN(d.`ORDER`) AS order_range, VARIANCE(d.`ORDER`) AS order_variance FROM `subnets` AS s JOIN `dnsnameservers` AS d ON s.id = d.subnet_id WHERE s.ip_version = 4 GROUP BY s.name ORDER BY order_range DESC) SELECT subnet_name, order_range, order_variance FROM inner_cte WHERE order_range > (SELECT AVG(order_range) FROM inner_cte) ORDER BY order_range DESC), CombinedSubnetFindings AS (SELECT subnet_name, 'High Coefficient of Variation vs Benchmark' AS reason FROM CoeffVariationSubnets WHERE variation_category = 'HIGH_VARIATION' UNION ALL SELECT subnet_name, 'Order Range Above IPv4 Average' AS reason FROM HighRangeSubnets) SELECT subnet_name, reason FROM CombinedSubnetFindings ORDER BY subnet_name, reason

target_disjoint_workload.question: For IPv4 subnets whose DNS nameserver order range is greater than the average order range across all IPv4 subnets, list each subnet name along with its DNS nameserver order range and variance, plus the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the order values and how far that coefficient deviates from the average coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) across all IPv4 subnets. Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH q1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT s.name AS subnet_name, MAX(d.`ORDER`) - MIN(d.`ORDER`) AS order_range, VARIANCE(d.`ORDER`) AS order_variance FROM `subnets` AS s JOIN `dnsnameservers` AS d ON s.id = d.subnet_id WHERE s.ip_version = 4 GROUP BY s.name ORDER BY order_range DESC) SELECT subnet_name, order_range, order_variance FROM inner_cte WHERE order_range > (SELECT AVG(order_range) FROM inner_cte) ORDER BY order_range DESC), q2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT s.name AS subnet_name, STDDEV(d.`ORDER`) / NULLIF(AVG(d.`ORDER`), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM `subnets` AS s JOIN `dnsnameservers` AS d ON d.subnet_id = s.id JOIN `ipallocationpools` AS p ON p.subnet_id = s.id WHERE s.ip_version = 4 GROUP BY s.name HAVING AVG(d.`ORDER`) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC), avg_cte AS (SELECT AVG(coefficient_of_variation) AS avg_coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte) SELECT i.subnet_name, i.coefficient_of_variation, (i.coefficient_of_variation - a.avg_coefficient_of_variation) AS deviation_from_avg FROM inner_cte AS i CROSS JOIN avg_cte AS a ORDER BY deviation_from_avg DESC) SELECT q1.subnet_name, q1.order_range, q1.order_variance, q2.coefficient_of_variation, q2.deviation_from_avg FROM q1 JOIN q2 ON q1.subnet_name = q2.subnet_name ORDER BY q1.order_range DESC, q2.deviation_from_avg DESC

target_disjoint_workload.question: For each IPv4 subnet (by subnet name) that is not on a network shared via `access_as_shared` to `*` or to tenant `9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b`, return the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of DNS nameserver order values, the overall average coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) across all such subnets, and (when applicable) the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) for only those subnets whose coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) is above that overall average. Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH q1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT s.name AS subnet_name, STDDEV(d.`order`) / NULLIF(AVG(d.`order`), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM `subnets` AS s JOIN `dnsnameservers` AS d ON d.subnet_id = s.id JOIN `ipallocationpools` AS p ON p.subnet_id = s.id JOIN `networks` AS n ON n.id = s.network_id WHERE s.ip_version = 4 AND NOT n.id IN (SELECT r.object_id FROM `networkrbacs` AS r WHERE r.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (r.target_tenant = '*' OR r.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b')) GROUP BY s.name HAVING AVG(d.`order`) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC) SELECT inner_cte.subnet_name, inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation, avg_cv.avg_coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte JOIN (SELECT AVG(coefficient_of_variation) AS avg_coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte) AS avg_cv ON 1 = 1 ORDER BY inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation DESC), q2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT s.name AS subnet_name, STDDEV(d.`order`) / NULLIF(AVG(d.`order`), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM `subnets` AS s JOIN `dnsnameservers` AS d ON d.subnet_id = s.id JOIN `ipallocationpools` AS p ON p.subnet_id = s.id JOIN `networks` AS n ON n.id = s.network_id WHERE s.ip_version = 4 AND NOT n.id IN (SELECT r.object_id FROM `networkrbacs` AS r WHERE r.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (r.target_tenant = '*' OR r.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b')) GROUP BY s.name HAVING AVG(d.`order`) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC) SELECT i.subnet_name, i.coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN `subnets` AS s ON s.name = i.subnet_name WHERE i.coefficient_of_variation > (SELECT AVG(coefficient_of_variation) FROM inner_cte) ORDER BY i.coefficient_of_variation DESC) SELECT q1.subnet_name, q1.coefficient_of_variation, q1.avg_coefficient_of_variation, q2.coefficient_of_variation AS above_avg_coefficient_of_variation FROM q1 LEFT JOIN q2 ON q2.subnet_name = q1.subnet_name ORDER BY q1.coefficient_of_variation DESC

target_disjoint_workload.question: For subnets on networks shared via RBAC with action `access_as_shared` to target tenant `1ee6b5b4fe8c45cfa16c3ecdbb8ee02b`, return only those subnets (matched by subnet name) whose IPv4 DNS nameserver order coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) is above the overall average (excluding subnets on networks shared to `*` or tenant `9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b`), and list the subnet name, CIDR, RBAC target tenant, the running sum of standard attribute IDs within each IP version ordered by standard attribute ID, the deviation of each subnet’s standard attribute ID from the filtered-subnet average, and the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP). Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH SubnetRbacWindowAndDeviation AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT s.NAME AS subnet_name, s.CIDR AS subnet_cidr, n.TARGET_TENANT AS rbac_target_tenant, SUM(s.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER (PARTITION BY s.IP_VERSION ORDER BY s.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) AS window_column FROM `subnets` AS s JOIN `networkrbacs` AS n ON n.OBJECT_ID = s.NETWORK_ID WHERE n.ACTION = 'access_as_shared' AND n.TARGET_TENANT IN ('1ee6b5b4fe8c45cfa16c3ecdbb8ee02b')), AvgStdAttr AS (SELECT AVG(s.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) AS avg_standard_attr_id FROM `subnets` AS s JOIN `networkrbacs` AS n ON n.OBJECT_ID = s.NETWORK_ID WHERE n.ACTION = 'access_as_shared' AND n.TARGET_TENANT IN ('1ee6b5b4fe8c45cfa16c3ecdbb8ee02b')) SELECT i.subnet_name, i.subnet_cidr, i.rbac_target_tenant, i.window_column, (s.STANDARD_ATTR_ID - a.avg_standard_attr_id) AS deviation_from_avg_standard_attr_id FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN `subnets` AS s ON s.NAME = i.subnet_name AND s.CIDR = i.subnet_cidr CROSS JOIN AvgStdAttr AS a), SubnetDnsCvAboveAvg AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT s.name AS subnet_name, STDDEV(d.`order`) / NULLIF(AVG(d.`order`), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM `subnets` AS s JOIN `dnsnameservers` AS d ON d.subnet_id = s.id JOIN `ipallocationpools` AS p ON p.subnet_id = s.id JOIN `networks` AS n ON n.id = s.network_id WHERE s.ip_version = 4 AND NOT n.id IN (SELECT r.object_id FROM `networkrbacs` AS r WHERE r.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (r.target_tenant = '*' OR r.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b')) GROUP BY s.name HAVING AVG(d.`order`) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC) SELECT i.subnet_name, i.coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN `subnets` AS s ON s.name = i.subnet_name WHERE i.coefficient_of_variation > (SELECT AVG(coefficient_of_variation) FROM inner_cte) ORDER BY i.coefficient_of_variation DESC) SELECT s1.subnet_name, s1.subnet_cidr, s1.rbac_target_tenant, s1.window_column, s1.deviation_from_avg_standard_attr_id, s2.coefficient_of_variation FROM SubnetRbacWindowAndDeviation AS s1 JOIN SubnetDnsCvAboveAvg AS s2 ON s2.subnet_name = s1.subnet_name WHERE s1.rbac_target_tenant IN ('1ee6b5b4fe8c45cfa16c3ecdbb8ee02b') ORDER BY s2.coefficient_of_variation DESC

target_disjoint_workload.question: For IPv4 subnets whose DNS nameserver order range is greater than the average order range across all IPv4 subnets, list each subnet name along with its DNS nameserver order range, order variance, coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the order values, and the deviation of that coefficient from the average coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) across all IPv4 subnets. Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH q1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT s.name AS subnet_name, MAX(d.`ORDER`) - MIN(d.`ORDER`) AS order_range, VARIANCE(d.`ORDER`) AS order_variance FROM `subnets` AS s JOIN `dnsnameservers` AS d ON s.id = d.subnet_id WHERE s.ip_version = 4 GROUP BY s.name ORDER BY order_range DESC) SELECT subnet_name, order_range, order_variance FROM inner_cte WHERE order_range > (SELECT AVG(order_range) FROM inner_cte) ORDER BY order_range DESC), q2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT s.name AS subnet_name, STDDEV(d.`ORDER`) / NULLIF(AVG(d.`ORDER`), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM `subnets` AS s JOIN `dnsnameservers` AS d ON d.subnet_id = s.id JOIN `ipallocationpools` AS p ON p.subnet_id = s.id WHERE s.ip_version = 4 GROUP BY s.name HAVING AVG(d.`ORDER`) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC), avg_cte AS (SELECT AVG(coefficient_of_variation) AS avg_coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte) SELECT i.subnet_name, i.coefficient_of_variation, (i.coefficient_of_variation - a.avg_coefficient_of_variation) AS deviation_from_avg FROM inner_cte AS i CROSS JOIN avg_cte AS a ORDER BY deviation_from_avg DESC) SELECT q1.subnet_name, q1.order_range, q1.order_variance, q2.coefficient_of_variation, q2.deviation_from_avg FROM q1 JOIN q2 ON q1.subnet_name = q2.subnet_name ORDER BY q1.order_range DESC, q2.deviation_from_avg DESC

target_disjoint_workload.question: For IPv4 subnets whose DNS nameserver order values are highly variable (coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) greater than 0.5), list the subnet name, the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of DNS nameserver order values, and the number of IP allocation pools on that subnet. Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT s.name AS subnet_name, STDDEV(d.`ORDER`) / NULLIF(AVG(d.`ORDER`), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM `subnets` AS s JOIN `dnsnameservers` AS d ON d.subnet_id = s.id JOIN `ipallocationpools` AS p ON p.subnet_id = s.id WHERE s.ip_version = 4 GROUP BY s.name HAVING AVG(d.`ORDER`) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC) SELECT inner_cte.subnet_name, inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS ip_allocation_pool_count FROM inner_cte JOIN `subnets` AS s ON s.name = inner_cte.subnet_name JOIN `ipallocationpools` AS p ON p.subnet_id = s.id WHERE inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation > 0.5 GROUP BY inner_cte.subnet_name, inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation ORDER BY inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation DESC

target_disjoint_workload.question: For each IPv4 subnet (by subnet name), show the subnet name, the average and variance of its DNS nameserver order values, along with the overall average of these per-subnet average DNS order values across all IPv4 subnets. Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT s.NAME AS subnet_name, AVG(d.`ORDER`) AS avg_dns_order, VARIANCE(d.`ORDER`) AS dns_order_variance FROM `subnets` AS s JOIN `dnsnameservers` AS d ON s.ID = d.SUBNET_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4 GROUP BY s.NAME ORDER BY dns_order_variance DESC) SELECT inner_cte.subnet_name, inner_cte.avg_dns_order, inner_cte.dns_order_variance, overall_avg.avg_of_subnet_avg_dns_order FROM inner_cte, (SELECT AVG(avg_dns_order) AS avg_of_subnet_avg_dns_order FROM inner_cte) AS overall_avg ORDER BY inner_cte.dns_order_variance DESC

target_disjoint_workload.question: For each IPv4 subnet (by subnet name), return the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the DNS nameserver order values across all DNS nameservers on that subnet, along with the deviation of that coefficient from the average coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) across all IPv4 subnets. Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT s.name AS subnet_name, STDDEV(d.`ORDER`) / NULLIF(AVG(d.`ORDER`), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM `subnets` AS s JOIN `dnsnameservers` AS d ON d.subnet_id = s.id JOIN `ipallocationpools` AS p ON p.subnet_id = s.id WHERE s.ip_version = 4 GROUP BY s.name HAVING AVG(d.`ORDER`) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC), avg_cte AS (SELECT AVG(coefficient_of_variation) AS avg_coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte) SELECT i.subnet_name, i.coefficient_of_variation, (i.coefficient_of_variation - a.avg_coefficient_of_variation) AS deviation_from_avg FROM inner_cte AS i CROSS JOIN avg_cte AS a ORDER BY deviation_from_avg DESC

target_disjoint_workload.question: For networks that are marked as default external networks (IS_DEFAULT = 0) and have the RBAC permission action set to 'access_as_external', list the (non-repeated) network name, its dense rank (ordered by the RBAC action using a window frame of the current row and the 2 preceding rows), the RBAC tenant ID and target tenant, the total number of matching networks, the average number of matching networks per tenant, and the ratio of total matching networks to the average per tenant (rounded to 2 decimals).
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH sq1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT n.NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY r.ACTION ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column FROM `externalnetworks` AS e JOIN `networks` AS n ON e.NETWORK_ID = n.ID JOIN `networkrbacs` AS r ON n.ID = r.OBJECT_ID WHERE e.IS_DEFAULT = 0 AND r.ACTION = 'access_as_external') SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(inner_cte.NAME) OVER (ORDER BY inner_cte.NAME, r.TENANT_ID) = inner_cte.NAME THEN NULL ELSE inner_cte.NAME END AS name, inner_cte.window_column, r.TENANT_ID AS rbac_tenant_id, r.TARGET_TENANT AS rbac_target_tenant FROM inner_cte JOIN `networks` AS n ON n.NAME = inner_cte.NAME JOIN `networkrbacs` AS r ON r.OBJECT_ID = n.ID AND r.ACTION = 'access_as_external' ORDER BY inner_cte.NAME, r.TENANT_ID), sq2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT n.NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY r.ACTION ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column FROM `externalnetworks` AS e JOIN `networks` AS n ON e.NETWORK_ID = n.ID JOIN `networkrbacs` AS r ON n.ID = r.OBJECT_ID WHERE e.IS_DEFAULT = 0 AND r.ACTION = 'access_as_external'), tenant_counts AS (SELECT n.TENANT_ID, COUNT(*) AS tenant_network_count FROM `externalnetworks` AS e JOIN `networks` AS n ON e.NETWORK_ID = n.ID JOIN `networkrbacs` AS r ON n.ID = r.OBJECT_ID WHERE e.IS_DEFAULT = 0 AND r.ACTION = 'access_as_external' GROUP BY n.TENANT_ID), avg_counts AS (SELECT AVG(tenant_network_count) AS avg_networks_per_tenant FROM tenant_counts) SELECT inner_cte.NAME, inner_cte.window_column, totals.total_matching_networks, avg_counts.avg_networks_per_tenant FROM inner_cte JOIN (SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_matching_networks FROM `externalnetworks` AS e JOIN `networks` AS n ON e.NETWORK_ID = n.ID JOIN `networkrbacs` AS r ON n.ID = r.OBJECT_ID WHERE e.IS_DEFAULT = 0 AND r.ACTION = 'access_as_external') AS totals ON 1 = 1 JOIN avg_counts ON 1 = 1) SELECT sq1.name, sq1.window_column, sq1.rbac_tenant_id, sq1.rbac_target_tenant, sq2.total_matching_networks, sq2.avg_networks_per_tenant, ROUND(sq2.total_matching_networks / NULLIF(sq2.avg_networks_per_tenant, 0), 2) AS total_to_avg_ratio FROM sq1 JOIN sq2 ON sq2.NAME = sq1.name AND sq2.window_column = sq1.window_column ORDER BY sq1.name, sq1.rbac_tenant_id

target_disjoint_workload.question: For default external networks (IS_DEFAULT = 0), identify the top 10 tenants by how many of their networks have an RBAC action of 'access_as_external', and for each of those tenants show: the tenant ID, the total number of qualifying networks, whether any of those networks have a targeted RBAC entry (TARGET_TENANT is not '*'), and a breakdown of how many default external networks they have in each network status after excluding networks shared via RBAC (action = 'access_as_shared' with TARGET_TENANT = '*' or '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b'). Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH TopTenantsExternalAccess AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT n.NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY r.ACTION ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column FROM `externalnetworks` AS e JOIN `networks` AS n ON e.NETWORK_ID = n.ID JOIN `networkrbacs` AS r ON n.ID = r.OBJECT_ID WHERE e.IS_DEFAULT = 0 AND r.ACTION = 'access_as_external') SELECT n.tenant_id, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id) AS total_qualifying_networks, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN r.target_tenant <> '*' THEN r.id END) > 0 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_targeted_rbac FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN `networks` AS n ON n.name = i.name JOIN `externalnetworks` AS e ON e.network_id = n.id JOIN `networkrbacs` AS r ON r.object_id = n.id WHERE e.is_default = 0 AND r.action = 'access_as_external' GROUP BY n.tenant_id ORDER BY total_qualifying_networks DESC LIMIT 10), TenantStatusRollup AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT e.NETWORK_ID, e.IS_DEFAULT, n.TENANT_ID, n.NAME, n.STATUS, n.ADMIN_STATE_UP, n.MTU, n.STANDARD_ATTR_ID, MIN(n.MTU) OVER (PARTITION BY n.TENANT_ID ORDER BY n.TENANT_ID) AS window_column FROM `externalnetworks` AS e JOIN `networks` AS n ON e.NETWORK_ID = n.ID WHERE e.IS_DEFAULT = 0 AND NOT n.ID IN (SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM `networkrbacs` WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b'))), TenantStatusCounts AS (SELECT i.tenant_id, i.status, COUNT(DISTINCT i.network_id) AS total_networks FROM inner_cte AS i GROUP BY i.tenant_id, i.status) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(tenant_id) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE tenant_id END AS tenant_id, CASE WHEN GROUPING(status) = 1 AND GROUPING(tenant_id) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' ELSE status END AS status, SUM(total_networks) AS total_networks FROM TenantStatusCounts GROUP BY tenant_id, status WITH ROLLUP) SELECT t.tenant_id, t.total_qualifying_networks, t.has_targeted_rbac, r.status, r.total_networks FROM TopTenantsExternalAccess AS t JOIN TenantStatusRollup AS r ON r.tenant_id = t.tenant_id WHERE r.status <> 'SUBTOTAL' AND r.tenant_id <> 'GRAND TOTAL' ORDER BY t.total_qualifying_networks DESC, r.status

target_disjoint_workload.question: For each tenant (excluding the subtotal and grand total rollup rows) and each network status, among non-shared networks that are marked as default external networks (excluding networks whose IDs appear in networkrbacs with action = 'access_as_shared' and target_tenant = '*' or '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b'), list the tenant ID, network status, and the count of such networks; also compute the tenant’s total port count under the same non-shared network filter and show the derived ports-per-default-external-network ratio. Alongside this, include the overall port volume benchmark analysis by (port status, device owner)—port count, benchmark average, volume category, and earliest standard attribute updated timestamp—using the same non-shared network filtering rules. Categorize each group as 'HIGH_VOLUME' (at least 50% above average), 'LOW_VOLUME' (at least 50% below average), or 'AVERAGE_VOLUME'.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH q1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT e.NETWORK_ID, e.IS_DEFAULT, n.TENANT_ID, n.NAME, n.STATUS, n.ADMIN_STATE_UP, n.MTU, n.STANDARD_ATTR_ID, MIN(n.MTU) OVER (PARTITION BY n.TENANT_ID ORDER BY n.TENANT_ID) AS window_column FROM `externalnetworks` AS e JOIN `networks` AS n ON e.NETWORK_ID = n.ID WHERE e.IS_DEFAULT = 0 AND NOT n.ID IN (SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM `networkrbacs` WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b'))), TenantStatusCounts AS (SELECT i.tenant_id, i.status, COUNT(DISTINCT i.network_id) AS total_networks FROM inner_cte AS i GROUP BY i.tenant_id, i.status) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(tenant_id) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE tenant_id END AS tenant_id, CASE WHEN GROUPING(status) = 1 AND GROUPING(tenant_id) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' ELSE status END AS status, SUM(total_networks) AS total_networks FROM TenantStatusCounts GROUP BY tenant_id, status WITH ROLLUP), q2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT p.STATUS AS port_status, p.DEVICE_OWNER AS device_owner, COUNT(p.ID) AS port_count, MIN(sa.UPDATED_AT) AS earliest_standard_attr_update FROM `ports` AS p JOIN `standardattributes` AS sa ON sa.ID = p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE sa.RESOURCE_TYPE = 'ports' AND NOT p.NETWORK_ID IN (SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM `networkrbacs` WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b')) GROUP BY p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER), avg_cte AS (SELECT AVG(port_count) AS avg_port_count FROM inner_cte) SELECT i.port_status, i.device_owner, i.port_count, i.earliest_standard_attr_update, a.avg_port_count AS benchmark, CASE WHEN i.port_count > a.avg_port_count * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_VOLUME' WHEN i.port_count < a.avg_port_count * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_VOLUME' ELSE 'AVERAGE_VOLUME' END AS volume_category FROM inner_cte AS i CROSS JOIN avg_cte AS a), TenantPortCounts AS (SELECT p.TENANT_ID AS tenant_id, COUNT(p.ID) AS tenant_port_count FROM `ports` AS p JOIN `standardattributes` AS sa ON sa.ID = p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE sa.RESOURCE_TYPE = 'ports' AND NOT p.NETWORK_ID IN (SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM `networkrbacs` WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b')) GROUP BY p.TENANT_ID) SELECT q1.tenant_id, q1.status AS network_status, q1.total_networks, tpc.tenant_port_count, ROUND(tpc.tenant_port_count / NULLIF(q1.total_networks, 0), 2) AS ports_per_default_external_network, q2.port_status, q2.device_owner, q2.port_count, q2.benchmark, q2.volume_category, q2.earliest_standard_attr_update FROM q1 JOIN TenantPortCounts AS tpc ON tpc.tenant_id = q1.tenant_id CROSS JOIN q2 WHERE NOT q1.tenant_id IN ('GRAND TOTAL', 'SUBTOTAL') ORDER BY ports_per_default_external_network DESC, q1.tenant_id, q1.status, q2.port_count DESC

target_disjoint_workload.question: For each tenant and network status (excluding shared networks whose IDs appear in networkrbacs with action = 'access_as_shared' and target_tenant = '*' or '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') among networks marked as default external networks, list the tenant ID, the network status, the number of such networks, and—restricted to statuses that are in the top 10 by distinct non-shared networks with at least one security binding—the total number of networks with a security binding plus the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of PORT_SECURITY_ENABLED for that status. Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH q1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT n.STATUS AS network_status, VARIANCE(nsb.PORT_SECURITY_ENABLED) AS port_security_enabled_variance, STDDEV(nsb.PORT_SECURITY_ENABLED) AS port_security_enabled_stddev FROM `networks` AS n JOIN `networksecuritybindings` AS nsb ON n.ID = nsb.NETWORK_ID WHERE NOT n.ID IN (SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM `networkrbacs` WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b')) GROUP BY n.STATUS ORDER BY port_security_enabled_variance DESC) SELECT n.STATUS AS network_status, COUNT(DISTINCT n.ID) AS total_networks_with_security_binding, inner_cte.port_security_enabled_variance, inner_cte.port_security_enabled_stddev FROM `networks` AS n JOIN `networksecuritybindings` AS nsb ON n.ID = nsb.NETWORK_ID JOIN inner_cte ON n.STATUS = inner_cte.network_status WHERE NOT n.ID IN (SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM `networkrbacs` WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b')) GROUP BY n.STATUS, inner_cte.port_security_enabled_variance, inner_cte.port_security_enabled_stddev ORDER BY total_networks_with_security_binding DESC LIMIT 10), q2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT e.NETWORK_ID, e.IS_DEFAULT, n.TENANT_ID, n.NAME, n.STATUS, n.ADMIN_STATE_UP, n.MTU, n.STANDARD_ATTR_ID, MIN(n.MTU) OVER (PARTITION BY n.TENANT_ID ORDER BY n.TENANT_ID) AS window_column FROM `externalnetworks` AS e JOIN `networks` AS n ON e.NETWORK_ID = n.ID WHERE e.IS_DEFAULT = 0 AND NOT n.ID IN (SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM `networkrbacs` WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b'))), TenantStatusCounts AS (SELECT i.tenant_id, i.status, COUNT(DISTINCT i.network_id) AS total_networks FROM inner_cte AS i GROUP BY i.tenant_id, i.status) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(tenant_id) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE tenant_id END AS tenant_id, CASE WHEN GROUPING(status) = 1 AND GROUPING(tenant_id) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' ELSE status END AS status, SUM(total_networks) AS total_networks FROM TenantStatusCounts GROUP BY tenant_id, status WITH ROLLUP) SELECT q2.tenant_id, q2.status, q2.total_networks AS total_default_external_networks, q1.total_networks_with_security_binding, q1.port_security_enabled_variance, q1.port_security_enabled_stddev FROM q2 JOIN q1 ON q2.status = q1.network_status WHERE NOT q2.tenant_id IN ('GRAND TOTAL') AND NOT q2.status IN ('SUBTOTAL') AND q1.total_networks_with_security_binding > 0 ORDER BY q2.total_networks DESC, q2.tenant_id, q2.status

target_disjoint_workload.question: For networks that are marked as default external networks (IS_DEFAULT = 0), return only those networks whose computed dense rank (ordered by the RBAC action, using a window frame of the current row and the 2 preceding rows) is greater than the average dense rank across all such networks; list the network name and its dense rank. Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT n.NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY r.ACTION ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column FROM `externalnetworks` AS e JOIN `networks` AS n ON e.NETWORK_ID = n.ID JOIN `networkrbacs` AS r ON n.ID = r.OBJECT_ID WHERE e.IS_DEFAULT = 0) SELECT NAME, window_column FROM inner_cte WHERE window_column > (SELECT AVG(window_column) FROM inner_cte)

target_disjoint_workload.question: For networks that are marked as default external networks (IS_DEFAULT = 0), list each network name and its dense rank when ordered by the RBAC action (using a window frame of the current row and the 2 preceding rows), along with the total number of such networks and the average number of such networks per RBAC action. Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT n.NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY r.ACTION ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column FROM `externalnetworks` AS e JOIN `networks` AS n ON e.NETWORK_ID = n.ID JOIN `networkrbacs` AS r ON n.ID = r.OBJECT_ID WHERE e.IS_DEFAULT = 0) SELECT inner_cte.NAME, inner_cte.window_column, COUNT(*) AS total_networks, avg_counts.avg_networks_per_action FROM inner_cte JOIN (SELECT AVG(action_count) AS avg_networks_per_action FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS action_count FROM inner_cte GROUP BY window_column) AS sub) AS avg_counts ON 1 = 1 GROUP BY inner_cte.NAME, inner_cte.window_column, avg_counts.avg_networks_per_action

target_disjoint_workload.question: For external networks that are marked as default (IS_DEFAULT = 0), list each network’s ID, name, status, and ADMIN_STATE_UP, along with (1) the per-status average ADMIN_STATE_UP computed as a window over networks ordered by name, (2) the overall average of those per-status averages across all statuses, and (3) the overall benchmark ADMIN_STATE_UP across all such external networks and a category showing whether each network is ABOVE_BENCHMARK, BELOW_BENCHMARK, or AT_BENCHMARK versus that benchmark. Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH q1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT e.NETWORK_ID, n.NAME, n.STATUS, n.ADMIN_STATE_UP, AVG(n.ADMIN_STATE_UP) OVER (PARTITION BY n.STATUS ORDER BY n.NAME) AS window_column FROM `externalnetworks` AS e JOIN `networks` AS n ON e.NETWORK_ID = n.ID WHERE e.IS_DEFAULT = 0) SELECT inner_cte.NETWORK_ID, inner_cte.NAME, inner_cte.STATUS, inner_cte.ADMIN_STATE_UP, inner_cte.window_column, overall_avg.avg_of_status_avg_admin_state_up FROM inner_cte, (SELECT AVG(status_avg_admin_state_up) AS avg_of_status_avg_admin_state_up FROM (SELECT STATUS, AVG(ADMIN_STATE_UP) AS status_avg_admin_state_up FROM inner_cte GROUP BY STATUS) AS sub) AS overall_avg ORDER BY inner_cte.NAME), q2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT e.NETWORK_ID, n.NAME, n.STATUS, n.ADMIN_STATE_UP, AVG(n.ADMIN_STATE_UP) OVER (PARTITION BY n.STATUS ORDER BY n.NAME) AS window_column FROM `externalnetworks` AS e JOIN `networks` AS n ON e.NETWORK_ID = n.ID WHERE e.IS_DEFAULT = 0), benchmark_cte AS (SELECT AVG(ADMIN_STATE_UP) AS benchmark_admin_state_up FROM inner_cte) SELECT i.NETWORK_ID, i.NAME, i.STATUS, i.ADMIN_STATE_UP, i.window_column, b.benchmark_admin_state_up AS benchmark, CASE WHEN i.ADMIN_STATE_UP > b.benchmark_admin_state_up THEN 'ABOVE_BENCHMARK' WHEN i.ADMIN_STATE_UP < b.benchmark_admin_state_up THEN 'BELOW_BENCHMARK' ELSE 'AT_BENCHMARK' END AS benchmark_category FROM inner_cte AS i CROSS JOIN benchmark_cte AS b ORDER BY i.NAME) SELECT q1.NETWORK_ID, q1.NAME, q1.STATUS, q1.ADMIN_STATE_UP, q1.window_column AS avg_admin_state_up_within_status_ordered_by_name, q1.avg_of_status_avg_admin_state_up AS overall_avg_of_per_status_avgs, q2.benchmark AS overall_benchmark_admin_state_up, q2.benchmark_category FROM q1 JOIN q2 ON q1.NETWORK_ID = q2.NETWORK_ID ORDER BY q1.NAME

target_disjoint_workload.question: For each tenant and network status among networks that are marked as default external networks (excluding shared networks whose IDs appear in networkrbacs with action = 'access_as_shared' and target_tenant = '*' or '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b'), list the tenant ID, network status, and the number of such networks. Include subtotals per tenant and a grand total. Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT e.NETWORK_ID, e.IS_DEFAULT, n.TENANT_ID, n.NAME, n.STATUS, n.ADMIN_STATE_UP, n.MTU, n.STANDARD_ATTR_ID, MIN(n.MTU) OVER (PARTITION BY n.TENANT_ID ORDER BY n.TENANT_ID) AS window_column FROM `externalnetworks` AS e JOIN `networks` AS n ON e.NETWORK_ID = n.ID WHERE e.IS_DEFAULT = 0 AND NOT n.ID IN (SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM `networkrbacs` WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b'))), TenantStatusCounts AS (SELECT i.tenant_id, i.status, COUNT(DISTINCT i.network_id) AS total_networks FROM inner_cte AS i GROUP BY i.tenant_id, i.status) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(tenant_id) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE tenant_id END AS tenant_id, CASE WHEN GROUPING(status) = 1 AND GROUPING(tenant_id) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' ELSE status END AS status, SUM(total_networks) AS total_networks FROM TenantStatusCounts GROUP BY tenant_id, status WITH ROLLUP

target_disjoint_workload.question: Among networks that are marked as default external networks (IS_DEFAULT = 0) and have the RBAC permission action set to 'access_as_external', show the top 10 tenants (by number of such networks) along with each tenant's ID, the total number of qualifying networks they own, and whether any of those networks have at least one RBAC entry targeting a specific tenant (i.e., TARGET_TENANT is not '*'). Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT n.NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY r.ACTION ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column FROM `externalnetworks` AS e JOIN `networks` AS n ON e.NETWORK_ID = n.ID JOIN `networkrbacs` AS r ON n.ID = r.OBJECT_ID WHERE e.IS_DEFAULT = 0 AND r.ACTION = 'access_as_external') SELECT n.tenant_id, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id) AS total_qualifying_networks, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN r.target_tenant <> '*' THEN r.id END) > 0 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_targeted_rbac FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN `networks` AS n ON n.name = i.name JOIN `externalnetworks` AS e ON e.network_id = n.id JOIN `networkrbacs` AS r ON r.object_id = n.id WHERE e.is_default = 0 AND r.action = 'access_as_external' GROUP BY n.tenant_id ORDER BY total_qualifying_networks DESC LIMIT 10

target_disjoint_workload.question: For each default external network (where IS_DEFAULT = 0), list the tenant and network details (network ID, name, status, admin state up, MTU, standard attribute ID), the minimum MTU within that tenant, the total number of such default external networks per tenant and the average of that total across tenants; and, for ports on each network whose standard attribute resource type is 'ports', also show the port status and device owner along with the number of ports, the earliest standard attribute updated timestamp, and the deviation of that port count from the overall average across all port status/owner groups. Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH port_status_owner_stats AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT p.STATUS AS port_status, p.DEVICE_OWNER AS device_owner, COUNT(p.ID) AS port_count, MIN(sa.UPDATED_AT) AS earliest_standard_attr_update FROM `ports` AS p JOIN `standardattributes` AS sa ON sa.ID = p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE sa.RESOURCE_TYPE = 'ports' GROUP BY p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER), avg_cte AS (SELECT AVG(port_count) AS avg_port_count FROM inner_cte) SELECT i.port_status, i.device_owner, i.port_count, i.earliest_standard_attr_update, (i.port_count - a.avg_port_count) AS deviation_from_avg_port_count FROM inner_cte AS i CROSS JOIN avg_cte AS a), default_external_networks_by_tenant AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT e.NETWORK_ID, e.IS_DEFAULT, n.TENANT_ID, n.NAME, n.STATUS, n.ADMIN_STATE_UP, n.MTU, n.STANDARD_ATTR_ID, MIN(n.MTU) OVER (PARTITION BY n.TENANT_ID ORDER BY n.TENANT_ID) AS window_column FROM `externalnetworks` AS e JOIN `networks` AS n ON e.NETWORK_ID = n.ID WHERE e.IS_DEFAULT = 0) SELECT inner_cte.NETWORK_ID, inner_cte.IS_DEFAULT, inner_cte.TENANT_ID, inner_cte.NAME, inner_cte.STATUS, inner_cte.ADMIN_STATE_UP, inner_cte.MTU, inner_cte.STANDARD_ATTR_ID, inner_cte.window_column, tenant_counts.total_default_external_networks, avg_counts.avg_default_external_networks_per_tenant FROM inner_cte JOIN (SELECT TENANT_ID, COUNT(NETWORK_ID) AS total_default_external_networks FROM inner_cte GROUP BY TENANT_ID) AS tenant_counts ON inner_cte.TENANT_ID = tenant_counts.TENANT_ID JOIN (SELECT AVG(cnt) AS avg_default_external_networks_per_tenant FROM (SELECT COUNT(NETWORK_ID) AS cnt FROM inner_cte GROUP BY TENANT_ID) AS sub) AS avg_counts ON 1 = 1) SELECT den.TENANT_ID, den.NETWORK_ID, den.IS_DEFAULT, den.NAME AS network_name, den.STATUS AS network_status, den.ADMIN_STATE_UP, den.MTU, den.STANDARD_ATTR_ID AS network_standard_attr_id, den.window_column AS min_mtu_within_tenant, den.total_default_external_networks, den.avg_default_external_networks_per_tenant, pso.port_status, pso.device_owner, pso.port_count, pso.earliest_standard_attr_update, pso.deviation_from_avg_port_count FROM default_external_networks_by_tenant AS den LEFT JOIN `ports` AS p ON p.NETWORK_ID = den.NETWORK_ID LEFT JOIN port_status_owner_stats AS pso ON pso.port_status = p.STATUS AND pso.device_owner = p.DEVICE_OWNER ORDER BY den.TENANT_ID, den.NETWORK_ID, pso.port_count DESC

q2.device_owner, q2.port_count, q2.min_standard_attr_id, q2.has_multi_sg_bindings, q1.coefficient_of_variation, q1.total_ports, q1.has_floating_ips FROM q2 JOIN q1 ON q1.status = q2.port_status ORDER target_disjoint_workload.question: For the top 10 port statuses with the highest coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of ports’ standard attribute IDs (considering only ports that have both a security group port binding and a port security binding), show the port status, the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), whether any of those ports have a floating IP allocated, and how many of the top 10 tenants (ranked by the highest coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of allocated IP address string lengths for ports with port security enabled) have ports in that same status. `securitygroupportbindings` AS sgpb JOIN `ports` AS p ON sgpb.port_id = p.id JOIN `portsecuritybindings` AS psb ON p.id = psb.port_id GROUP BY p.status HAVING AVG(p.standard_attr_id) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC) SELECT i.status, i.coefficient_of_variation, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT f.id) > 0 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_floating_ips FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN `ports` AS p ON p.status = i.status JOIN `securitygroupportbindings` AS sgpb ON sgpb.port_id = p.id JOIN `portsecuritybindings` AS psb ON psb.port_id = p.id LEFT JOIN `floatingips` AS f ON f.fixed_port_id = p.id GROUP BY i.status, i.coefficient_of_variation ORDER BY i.coefficient_of_variation DESC LIMIT 10), subq2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT p.status, STDDEV(LENGTH(ia.ip_address)) / NULLIF(AVG(LENGTH(ia.ip_address)), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM `portsecuritybindings` AS psb JOIN `ports` AS p ON psb.port_id = p.id JOIN `ipallocations` AS ia ON p.id = ia.port_id WHERE psb.port_security_enabled = 1 GROUP BY p.status HAVING AVG(LENGTH(ia.ip_address)) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC) SELECT p.tenant_id, STDDEV(LENGTH(ia.ip_address)) / NULLIF(AVG(LENGTH(ia.ip_address)), 0) AS tenant_coefficient_of_variation, CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN p.status = 'ACTIVE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_active_ports, CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN p.status = 'DOWN' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_down_ports, CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN p.status = 'BUILD' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_build_ports FROM `portsecuritybindings` AS psb JOIN `ports` AS p ON psb.port_id = p.id JOIN `ipallocations` AS ia ON p.id = ia.port_id JOIN inner_cte AS ic ON ic.status = p.status WHERE psb.port_security_enabled = 1 GROUP BY p.tenant_id HAVING AVG(LENGTH(ia.ip_address)) > 0 ORDER BY tenant_coefficient_of_variation DESC LIMIT 10) SELECT s1.status, s1.coefficient_of_variation, s1.has_floating_ips, COUNT(DISTINCT s2.tenant_id) AS top_tenants_with_ports_in_that_status FROM subq1 AS s1 JOIN `ports` AS p ON p.status = s1.status JOIN subq2 AS s2 ON s2.tenant_id = p.tenant_id target_disjoint_workload.question: For the top 10 port statuses with the highest coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of ports’ standard attribute IDs (considering only ports that have both a security group port binding and a port security binding), show the port status, the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), and whether any of those ports have a floating IP allocated. target_disjoint_workload.question: Among the top 10 (port status, device owner) combinations with the highest number of ports—considering only ports whose standard attribute resource type is 'ports' and excluding shared networks (networks whose IDs appear in networkrbacs with action = 'access_as_shared' and target_tenant = '*' or '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b')—return the port status, device owner, total number of ports, the earliest (minimum) standard attribute updated timestamp, and whether any of those ports have a floating IP allocated. target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT p.STATUS AS port_status, p.DEVICE_OWNER AS device_owner, COUNT(p.ID) AS port_count, MIN(sa.UPDATED_AT) AS earliest_standard_attr_update FROM `ports` AS p JOIN `standardattributes` AS sa ON sa.ID = p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE sa.RESOURCE_TYPE = 'ports' AND NOT p.NETWORK_ID IN (SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM `networkrbacs` WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b')) GROUP BY p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER) SELECT i.port_status, i.device_owner, i.port_count, i.earliest_standard_attr_update, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT f.id) > 0 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_floating_ips FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN `ports` AS p ON p.status = i.port_status AND p.device_owner = i.device_owner JOIN `standardattributes` AS sa ON sa.id = p.standard_attr_id LEFT JOIN `floatingips` AS f ON p.id = f.fixed_port_id WHERE sa.resource_type = 'ports' AND NOT p.network_id IN (SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM `networkrbacs` WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b')) GROUP BY i.port_status, i.device_owner, i.port_count, i.earliest_standard_attr_update ORDER BY i.port_count DESC LIMIT 10

target_disjoint_workload.question: From the ports that are administratively up and belong to tenant ID `98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57` (and have at least one IP allocation), show the top 10 ports with the most IP allocations. target_disjoint_workload.question: For the tenant ID `17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7`, among ports that are administratively up, show each port's ID, tenant ID, MAC address, the number of port security bindings on that port, the total number of times port security is enabled across those bindings, and whether the port has any floating IPs allocated. target_disjoint_workload.question: For IPv4 subnet ID `012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48`, return the (up to) top 10 subnets by number of distinct subnet routes, showing subnet ID, subnet name and CIDR, total distinct routes, whether the subnet has any IP allocation pools, and the dense-rank window value computed from the subnet’s associated standard attribute updated-at timestamp (using a window frame of the current row and the 2 preceding rows). END AS subnet_name_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.NAME) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE i.NAME END AS subnet_name, i.window_column FROM inner_cte AS i GROUP BY i.NAME, i.window_column WITH ROLLUP) AS tbltmp ORDER BY subnet_name_sort, subnet_name, window_column), top_subnets_by_routes AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT r.DESTINATION, r.NEXTHOP, s.NAME AS subnet_name, s.CIDR AS subnet_cidr, p.FIRST_IP, p.LAST_IP, AS p ON p.SUBNET_ID = s.ID JOIN inner_cte AS i ON i.subnet_name = s.NAME AND i.subnet_cidr = s.CIDR WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4 AND s.ID IN ('012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48') GROUP BY s.ID, s.NAME, s.IP_VERSION = 4), SubnetRouteCounts AS (SELECT s.ID AS subnet_id, COUNT(r.DESTINATION) AS total_routes FROM `subnets` AS s JOIN `subnetroutes` AS r ON r.SUBNET_ID = s.ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4 GROUP BY s.ID), AverageRoutes AS (SELECT AVG(total_routes) AS avg_routes FROM SubnetRouteCounts) SELECT i.DESTINATION, i.NEXTHOP, i.subnet_name, i.subnet_cidr, i.FIRST_IP, i.LAST_IP, i.window_column, src.total_routes, ar.avg_routes AS benchmark, CASE WHEN src.total_routes > ar.avg_routes * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_ROUTE_SUBNET' WHEN src.total_routes < ar.avg_routes * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_ROUTE_SUBNET' ELSE 'AVERAGE_ROUTE_SUBNET' END AS route_category FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN `subnets` AS s ON s.CIDR = i.subnet_cidr AND s.NAME = i.subnet_name JOIN SubnetRouteCounts AS src ON src.subnet_id = s.ID CROSS JOIN AverageRoutes AS ar), ActiveNetworkDetails AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT n.ID AS network_id, n.NAME AS network_name, n.TENANT_ID AS tenant_id, n.ADMIN_STATE_UP AS admin_state_up, n.MTU AS mtu, sa.UPDATED_AT AS standard_attr_updated_at, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.TENANT_ID ORDER BY n.NAME) AS window_column FROM `networks` AS n JOIN `standardattributes` AS sa ON sa.ID = n.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE n.STATUS = 'ACTIVE'), AvgMtu AS (SELECT AVG(mtu) AS avg_mtu FROM inner_cte) SELECT i.network_id, i.network_name, i.tenant_id, i.admin_state_up, i.mtu, i.standard_attr_updated_at, i.window_column, a.avg_mtu AS benchmark_avg_mtu, CASE WHEN i.mtu > a.avg_mtu THEN 'ABOVE_AVG_MTU' WHEN i.mtu < a.avg_mtu THEN 'BELOW_AVG_MTU' ELSE 'AT_AVG_MTU' END AS mtu_category FROM inner_cte AS i CROSS JOIN AvgMtu AS a) SELECT rd.DESTINATION, rd.NEXTHOP, rd.subnet_name, rd.subnet_cidr, rd.FIRST_IP, rd.LAST_IP, rd.window_column AS subnet_dense_rank, rd.total_routes, rd.benchmark AS avg_routes_benchmark, rd.route_category, andt.network_id, andt.network_name, andt.tenant_id, andt.admin_state_up, andt.mtu, andt.standard_attr_updated_at, andt.window_column AS tenant_network_rownum, andt.benchmark_avg_mtu, andt.mtu_category FROM RouteDetails AS rd JOIN `subnets` AS s ON s.CIDR = rd.subnet_cidr AND s.NAME = rd.subnet_name JOIN ActiveNetworkDetails AS andt ON andt.network_id = s.NETWORK_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4 ORDER BY andt.tenant_id, andt.network_name, rd.subnet_name, rd.DESTINATION

target_disjoint_workload.question: For IPv4 subnets whose max_standard_attr_id_next2 (the maximum subnet standard attribute ID over the current subnet row and the next 2 rows when ordered by subnet ID) is greater than the average max_standard_attr_id_next2 for subnets with the same DHCP-enabled flag, list only those subnets that belong to a network that is in the top 3 most-subnetted networks shared via RBAC action 'access_as_shared' and whose subnet count is above the average subnet count of those top 3 networks; return the network ID, tenant ID, subnet name, IP version, CIDR, gateway IP, DHCP enabled flag, allocation pool first/last IP, max_standard_attr_id_next2, the shared network’s subnet count, and the number of distinct target tenants it is shared with.
