target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH SubnetDetails AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT s.NAME, s.TENANT_ID, s.NETWORK_ID, s.IP_VERSION, s.CIDR, s.GATEWAY_IP, s.ENABLE_DHCP, p.FIRST_IP, p.LAST_IP, MAX(s.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER (ORDER BY s.ID ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_standard_attr_id_next2 FROM `subnets` AS s JOIN `ipallocationpools` AS p ON s.ID = p.SUBNET_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4), DhcpAverages AS (SELECT ENABLE_DHCP, AVG(max_standard_attr_id_next2) AS avg_max_next2 FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ENABLE_DHCP) SELECT i.NAME, i.TENANT_ID, i.NETWORK_ID, i.IP_VERSION, i.CIDR, i.GATEWAY_IP, i.ENABLE_DHCP, i.FIRST_IP, i.LAST_IP, i.max_standard_attr_id_next2 FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN DhcpAverages AS d ON i.ENABLE_DHCP = d.ENABLE_DHCP WHERE i.max_standard_attr_id_next2 > d.avg_max_next2), TopSharedNetworks AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT n.OBJECT_ID AS network_id, COUNT(*) AS subnet_count FROM `networkrbacs` AS n JOIN `subnets` AS s ON n.OBJECT_ID = s.NETWORK_ID WHERE n.ACTION = 'access_as_shared' GROUP BY n.OBJECT_ID ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 3), AvgTop3 AS (SELECT AVG(subnet_count) AS avg_subnet_count FROM inner_cte) SELECT i.network_id, i.subnet_count, COUNT(DISTINCT r.TARGET_TENANT) AS distinct_target_tenants FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN `networkrbacs` AS r ON r.OBJECT_ID = i.network_id AND r.ACTION = 'access_as_shared' GROUP BY i.network_id, i.subnet_count HAVING i.subnet_count > (SELECT avg_subnet_count FROM AvgTop3) ORDER BY i.subnet_count DESC), CombinedResults AS (SELECT sd.NETWORK_ID AS network_id, sd.TENANT_ID AS tenant_id, sd.NAME AS subnet_name, sd.IP_VERSION AS ip_version, sd.CIDR AS cidr, sd.GATEWAY_IP AS gateway_ip, sd.ENABLE_DHCP AS enable_dhcp, sd.FIRST_IP AS first_ip, sd.LAST_IP AS last_ip, sd.max_standard_attr_id_next2 AS max_standard_attr_id_next2, tsn.subnet_count AS shared_network_subnet_count, tsn.distinct_target_tenants AS shared_network_distinct_target_tenants FROM SubnetDetails AS sd JOIN TopSharedNetworks AS tsn ON tsn.network_id = sd.NETWORK_ID) SELECT * FROM CombinedResults ORDER BY network_id, subnet_name

target_disjoint_workload.question: For IPv4 subnets, list the subnet name, tenant ID, network ID, IP version, CIDR, gateway IP, DHCP enabled flag, the allocation pool’s first and last IP, and the maximum subnet standard attribute ID considering the current row and the next 2 rows when ordered by subnet ID; only include rows where the allocation pool’s first IP is the minimum first IP for that subnet. Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT s.NAME, s.TENANT_ID, s.NETWORK_ID, s.IP_VERSION, s.CIDR, s.GATEWAY_IP, s.ENABLE_DHCP, p.FIRST_IP, p.LAST_IP, MAX(s.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER (ORDER BY s.ID ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_standard_attr_id_next2 FROM `subnets` AS s JOIN `ipallocationpools` AS p ON s.ID = p.SUBNET_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4) SELECT i.NAME, i.TENANT_ID, i.NETWORK_ID, i.IP_VERSION, i.CIDR, i.GATEWAY_IP, i.ENABLE_DHCP, i.FIRST_IP, i.LAST_IP, i.max_standard_attr_id_next2 FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN `subnets` AS s2 ON s2.TENANT_ID = i.TENANT_ID JOIN `ipallocationpools` AS p2 ON p2.SUBNET_ID = s2.ID WHERE i.FIRST_IP = (SELECT MIN(p3.FIRST_IP) FROM `ipallocationpools` AS p3 WHERE p3.SUBNET_ID = s2.ID)

target_disjoint_workload.question: For each IPv4 subnet, show the subnet name, tenant ID, network ID, IP version, CIDR, gateway IP, DHCP enabled flag, the allocation pool’s first IP and last IP, and the maximum subnet standard attribute ID considering the current row and the next 2 rows when ordered by subnet ID; then return only those rows whose max_standard_attr_id_next2 is greater than the average of max_standard_attr_id_next2 for subnets with the same DHCP enabled flag. Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT s.NAME, s.TENANT_ID, s.NETWORK_ID, s.IP_VERSION, s.CIDR, s.GATEWAY_IP, s.ENABLE_DHCP, p.FIRST_IP, p.LAST_IP, MAX(s.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER (ORDER BY s.ID ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_standard_attr_id_next2 FROM `subnets` AS s JOIN `ipallocationpools` AS p ON s.ID = p.SUBNET_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4), DhcpAverages AS (SELECT ENABLE_DHCP, AVG(max_standard_attr_id_next2) AS avg_max_next2 FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ENABLE_DHCP) SELECT i.NAME, i.TENANT_ID, i.NETWORK_ID, i.IP_VERSION, i.CIDR, i.GATEWAY_IP, i.ENABLE_DHCP, i.FIRST_IP, i.LAST_IP, i.max_standard_attr_id_next2 FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN DhcpAverages AS d ON i.ENABLE_DHCP = d.ENABLE_DHCP WHERE i.max_standard_attr_id_next2 > d.avg_max_next2

target_disjoint_workload.question: For IPv4 subnets that are in the top 10 by DNS nameserver order range and that have DNS nameservers configured, return the subnet name, tenant ID, network ID, IP version, CIDR, gateway IP, DHCP enabled flag, the allocation pool’s first and last IP (only where the first IP is the minimum for that subnet), the maximum subnet standard attribute ID over the current row and next 2 rows by subnet ID, plus the DNS nameserver order range and order variance. Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH DnsOrderRangeTop10 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT s.name AS subnet_name, MAX(d.`ORDER`) - MIN(d.`ORDER`) AS order_range, VARIANCE(d.`ORDER`) AS order_variance FROM `subnets` AS s JOIN `dnsnameservers` AS d ON s.id = d.subnet_id WHERE s.ip_version = 4 GROUP BY s.name ORDER BY order_range DESC) SELECT i.subnet_name, i.order_range, i.order_variance, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT d2.address) > 0 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_dns_nameservers FROM inner_cte AS i LEFT JOIN `subnets` AS s2 ON s2.name = i.subnet_name LEFT JOIN `dnsnameservers` AS d2 ON d2.subnet_id = s2.id GROUP BY i.subnet_name, i.order_range, i.order_variance ORDER BY i.order_range DESC LIMIT 10), SubnetAllocationPoolMinFirstIp AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT s.NAME, s.TENANT_ID, s.NETWORK_ID, s.IP_VERSION, s.CIDR, s.GATEWAY_IP, s.ENABLE_DHCP, p.FIRST_IP, p.LAST_IP, MAX(s.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER (ORDER BY s.ID ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_standard_attr_id_next2 FROM `subnets` AS s JOIN `ipallocationpools` AS p ON s.ID = p.SUBNET_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4) SELECT i.NAME, i.TENANT_ID, i.NETWORK_ID, i.IP_VERSION, i.CIDR, i.GATEWAY_IP, i.ENABLE_DHCP, i.FIRST_IP, i.LAST_IP, i.max_standard_attr_id_next2 FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN `subnets` AS s2 ON s2.TENANT_ID = i.TENANT_ID JOIN `ipallocationpools` AS p2 ON p2.SUBNET_ID = s2.ID WHERE i.FIRST_IP = (SELECT MIN(p3.FIRST_IP) FROM `ipallocationpools` AS p3 WHERE p3.SUBNET_ID = s2.ID)) SELECT sap.NAME AS subnet_name, sap.TENANT_ID, sap.NETWORK_ID, sap.IP_VERSION, sap.CIDR, sap.GATEWAY_IP, sap.ENABLE_DHCP, sap.FIRST_IP AS allocation_pool_first_ip, sap.LAST_IP AS allocation_pool_last_ip, sap.max_standard_attr_id_next2, dor.order_range, dor.order_variance, dor.has_dns_nameservers FROM SubnetAllocationPoolMinFirstIp AS sap JOIN DnsOrderRangeTop10 AS dor ON dor.subnet_name = sap.NAME WHERE dor.has_dns_nameservers = 'Yes' ORDER BY dor.order_range DESC, sap.NAME

target_disjoint_workload.question: For the IPv4 subnet with ID '012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48', show each subnet route’s destination and next hop together with the subnet name and CIDR, plus the allocation pool’s first and last IP and the dense rank within each subnet (partitioned by subnet ID) ordered by subnet ID. Also report the total number of routes for that subnet, the average number of routes per subnet across all IPv4 subnets as a benchmark, and categorize the subnet as 'HIGH_ROUTE_SUBNET' (at least 50% more than average), 'LOW_ROUTE_SUBNET' (at least 50% less than average), or 'AVERAGE_ROUTE_SUBNET'. Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT r.DESTINATION, r.NEXTHOP, s.NAME AS subnet_name, s.CIDR AS subnet_cidr, p.FIRST_IP, p.LAST_IP, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.SUBNET_ID ORDER BY r.SUBNET_ID) AS window_column FROM `subnetroutes` AS r JOIN `subnets` AS s ON r.SUBNET_ID = s.ID JOIN `ipallocationpools` AS p ON s.ID = p.SUBNET_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4 AND s.ID IN ('012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48')), SubnetRouteCounts AS (SELECT s.ID AS subnet_id, COUNT(r.DESTINATION) AS total_routes FROM `subnets` AS s LEFT JOIN `subnetroutes` AS r ON r.SUBNET_ID = s.ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4 GROUP BY s.ID), AverageRoutes AS (SELECT AVG(total_routes) AS avg_routes FROM SubnetRouteCounts) SELECT i.DESTINATION, i.NEXTHOP, i.subnet_name, i.subnet_cidr, i.FIRST_IP, i.LAST_IP, i.window_column, src.total_routes, ar.avg_routes AS benchmark, CASE WHEN src.total_routes > ar.avg_routes * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_ROUTE_SUBNET' WHEN src.total_routes < ar.avg_routes * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_ROUTE_SUBNET' ELSE 'AVERAGE_ROUTE_SUBNET' END AS route_category FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN `subnets` AS s ON s.NAME = i.subnet_name AND s.CIDR = i.subnet_cidr JOIN SubnetRouteCounts AS src ON src.subnet_id = s.ID CROSS JOIN AverageRoutes AS ar

target_disjoint_workload.question: For each network ID that (a) has at least one administratively up port belonging to tenant `98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57` with at least one IP allocation and (b) has allocated IP address `10.150.64.113/8` on a port with port security enabled, return the network ID, the highest number of IP allocations on any single qualifying port in that network, and the maximum coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) (stddev/avg) of allocated IP address string lengths across port statuses. Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH q1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address, COUNT(ia.ip_address) AS ip_allocation_count, SUM(CASE WHEN NOT ia.subnet_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS subnet_id_rows FROM `ports` AS p JOIN `portsecuritybindings` AS psb ON psb.port_id = p.id JOIN `ipallocations` AS ia ON ia.port_id = p.id WHERE p.admin_state_up = 1 AND NOT ia.ip_address IS NULL AND p.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') GROUP BY p.id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address) SELECT p.network_id, MAX(inner_cte.ip_allocation_count) AS max_ip_allocations_on_a_port FROM inner_cte JOIN `ports` AS p ON p.id = inner_cte.port_id GROUP BY p.network_id), q2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT p.status, STDDEV(LENGTH(ia.ip_address)) / NULLIF(AVG(LENGTH(ia.ip_address)), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM `portsecuritybindings` AS psb JOIN `ports` AS p ON psb.port_id = p.id JOIN `ipallocations` AS ia ON p.id = ia.port_id WHERE psb.port_security_enabled = 1 AND ia.ip_address IN ('10.150.64.113/8') GROUP BY p.status HAVING AVG(LENGTH(ia.ip_address)) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC) SELECT ia.network_id, MAX(inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation) AS max_coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte JOIN `ports` AS p ON p.status = inner_cte.status JOIN `ipallocations` AS ia ON ia.port_id = p.id GROUP BY ia.network_id) SELECT q1.network_id, q1.max_ip_allocations_on_a_port, q2.max_coefficient_of_variation FROM q1 JOIN q2 ON q2.network_id = q1.network_id

target_disjoint_workload.question: For DOWN ports, list the port ID, tenant ID, port name, network ID, MAC address, device owner, allocated IP address, and the row number within each network (ordered by port ID), along with the DOWN-status range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of port security binding counts per port (considering only ports with at least one binding) and the total number of DOWN ports in the same network; additionally, include the number of allocated IP addresses in that port’s subnet and the deviation of that subnet’s allocated IP count from the average allocated IP count across all subnets. Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH DownPortsWithIPs AS (SELECT p.ID AS port_id, p.TENANT_ID AS tenant_id, p.NAME AS port_name, p.NETWORK_ID AS network_id, p.MAC_ADDRESS AS mac_address, p.DEVICE_OWNER AS device_owner, ia.IP_ADDRESS AS ip_address, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p.NETWORK_ID ORDER BY p.ID) AS window_column FROM `ports` AS p JOIN `ipallocations` AS ia ON p.ID = ia.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN'), PortSecurityBindingStatsByStatus AS (SELECT p.status, MAX(ps.binding_count) - MIN(ps.binding_count) AS binding_count_range, VARIANCE(ps.binding_count) AS binding_count_variance, STDDEV(ps.binding_count) AS binding_count_stddev FROM `ports` AS p JOIN (SELECT p2.id AS port_id, COUNT(*) AS binding_count FROM `ports` AS p2 JOIN `portsecuritybindings` AS b ON p2.id = b.port_id GROUP BY p2.id) AS ps ON p.id = ps.port_id GROUP BY p.status ORDER BY binding_count_range DESC), DownPortCountsByNetwork AS (SELECT network_id, COUNT(DISTINCT port_id) AS down_port_count FROM DownPortsWithIPs GROUP BY network_id) SELECT d.port_id, d.tenant_id, d.port_name, d.network_id, d.mac_address, d.device_owner, d.ip_address, d.window_column, ps.status, ps.binding_count_range, ps.binding_count_variance, ps.binding_count_stddev, c.down_port_count FROM DownPortsWithIPs AS d JOIN PortSecurityBindingStatsByStatus AS ps ON ps.status = 'DOWN' JOIN DownPortCountsByNetwork AS c ON d.network_id = c.network_id ORDER BY d.network_id, d.window_column), SubnetAllocations AS (SELECT ia.subnet_id, ia.network_id, COUNT(DISTINCT ia.ip_address) AS allocated_ips FROM `ipallocations` AS ia GROUP BY ia.subnet_id, ia.network_id), AverageAllocations AS (SELECT AVG(allocated_ips) AS avg_ips FROM SubnetAllocations) SELECT i.port_id, i.tenant_id, i.port_name, i.network_id, i.mac_address, i.device_owner, i.ip_address, i.window_column, i.status, i.binding_count_range, i.binding_count_variance, i.binding_count_stddev, i.down_port_count, ia.subnet_id, sa.allocated_ips AS subnet_allocated_ips, (sa.allocated_ips - aa.avg_ips) AS subnet_deviation_from_avg_allocated_ips FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN `ipallocations` AS ia ON ia.port_id = i.port_id AND ia.ip_address = i.ip_address JOIN SubnetAllocations AS sa ON sa.subnet_id = ia.subnet_id AND sa.network_id = ia.network_id CROSS JOIN AverageAllocations AS aa ORDER BY i.network_id, i.window_column

target_disjoint_workload.question: For each of the top 10 tenants with the highest total number of IP allocations on administratively up ports (with at least one IP allocation), list the tenant ID, the total number of such ports, the total number of IP allocations across those ports, whether the tenant has any floating IPs allocated, and the average (across that tenant’s ports) deviation of each port’s IP allocation count from the global average IP allocation count across all such ports. Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH port_level AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address, COUNT(ia.ip_address) AS ip_allocation_count, SUM(CASE WHEN NOT ia.subnet_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS subnet_id_rows FROM `ports` AS p JOIN `portsecuritybindings` AS psb ON psb.port_id = p.id JOIN `ipallocations` AS ia ON ia.port_id = p.id WHERE p.admin_state_up = 1 AND NOT ia.ip_address IS NULL GROUP BY p.id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address), avg_cte AS (SELECT AVG(ip_allocation_count) AS avg_ip_allocation_count FROM inner_cte) SELECT ic.port_id, ic.tenant_id, ic.mac_address, ic.ip_allocation_count, ic.subnet_id_rows, (ic.ip_allocation_count - a.avg_ip_allocation_count) AS deviation_from_avg_ip_allocations FROM inner_cte AS ic CROSS JOIN avg_cte AS a), top_tenants AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address, COUNT(ia.ip_address) AS ip_allocation_count, SUM(CASE WHEN NOT ia.subnet_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS subnet_id_rows FROM `ports` AS p JOIN `portsecuritybindings` AS psb ON psb.port_id = p.id JOIN `ipallocations` AS ia ON ia.port_id = p.id WHERE p.admin_state_up = 1 AND NOT ia.ip_address IS NULL GROUP BY p.id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address) SELECT i.tenant_id, COUNT(DISTINCT i.port_id) AS total_ports, SUM(i.ip_allocation_count) AS total_ip_allocations, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT f.id) > 0 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_floating_ips FROM inner_cte AS i LEFT JOIN `ports` AS p ON p.id = i.port_id LEFT JOIN `floatingips` AS f ON p.id = f.fixed_port_id GROUP BY i.tenant_id ORDER BY total_ip_allocations DESC LIMIT 10) SELECT tt.tenant_id, tt.total_ports, tt.total_ip_allocations, tt.has_floating_ips, AVG(pl.deviation_from_avg_ip_allocations) AS avg_port_deviation_from_global_avg_ip_allocations FROM top_tenants AS tt JOIN port_level AS pl ON pl.tenant_id = tt.tenant_id GROUP BY tt.tenant_id, tt.total_ports, tt.total_ip_allocations, tt.has_floating_ips ORDER BY tt.total_ip_allocations DESC

target_disjoint_workload.question: For network ID `0a1d0a27-cffa-4de3-92c5-9d3fd3f2e74d`, summarize (1) how many distinct DOWN port names and distinct bound security group IDs exist, and (2) among ports on that same network that are administratively up, belong to tenant `98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57`, and have at least one IP allocation, report the number of such ports plus their total IP allocation count and total subnet_id row count (joining the two port sets by MAC address). Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH TenantUpPortsWithIPs AS (SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address, COUNT(ia.ip_address) AS ip_allocation_count, SUM(CASE WHEN NOT ia.subnet_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS subnet_id_rows FROM `ports` AS p JOIN `portsecuritybindings` AS psb ON psb.port_id = p.id JOIN `ipallocations` AS ia ON ia.port_id = p.id WHERE p.admin_state_up = 1 AND NOT ia.ip_address IS NULL AND p.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') GROUP BY p.id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address), DownPortsOnNetworkWithSG AS (SELECT p.NAME, p.NETWORK_ID, p.MAC_ADDRESS, p.ADMIN_STATE_UP, p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER, s.SECURITY_GROUP_ID, MIN(p.ADMIN_STATE_UP) OVER (ORDER BY p.ID ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM `ports` AS p JOIN `securitygroupportbindings` AS s ON p.ID = s.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' AND p.NETWORK_ID IN ('0a1d0a27-cffa-4de3-92c5-9d3fd3f2e74d')), TenantUpPortsWithIPsOnNetwork AS (SELECT t.port_id, t.tenant_id, t.mac_address, t.ip_allocation_count, t.subnet_id_rows FROM TenantUpPortsWithIPs AS t JOIN `ports` AS p ON p.ID = t.port_id WHERE p.NETWORK_ID IN ('0a1d0a27-cffa-4de3-92c5-9d3fd3f2e74d')) SELECT d.NETWORK_ID, COUNT(DISTINCT d.NAME) AS down_port_name_count, COUNT(DISTINCT d.SECURITY_GROUP_ID) AS down_port_security_group_count, COUNT(DISTINCT t.port_id) AS tenant_up_port_count_with_ips, SUM(t.ip_allocation_count) AS tenant_up_total_ip_allocations, SUM(t.subnet_id_rows) AS tenant_up_total_subnet_id_rows FROM DownPortsOnNetworkWithSG AS d LEFT JOIN TenantUpPortsWithIPsOnNetwork AS t ON t.mac_address = d.MAC_ADDRESS GROUP BY d.NETWORK_ID

target_disjoint_workload.question: For tenant ID "98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57", how many ACTIVE networks exist, what is the most recent network standard-attribute updated_at timestamp, and (for administratively up ports with at least one IP allocation) how many such ports are there along with the total IP allocation count and total subnet-id row count? Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH active_networks AS (SELECT n.ID AS network_id, n.NAME AS network_name, n.TENANT_ID AS tenant_id, n.ADMIN_STATE_UP AS admin_state_up, n.MTU AS mtu, sa.UPDATED_AT AS standard_attr_updated_at, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.TENANT_ID ORDER BY n.NAME) AS window_column FROM `networks` AS n JOIN `standardattributes` AS sa ON sa.ID = n.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE n.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND n.TENANT_ID IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57')), admin_up_ports_with_ip_allocs AS (SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address, COUNT(ia.ip_address) AS ip_allocation_count, SUM(CASE WHEN NOT ia.subnet_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS subnet_id_rows FROM `ports` AS p JOIN `portsecuritybindings` AS psb ON psb.port_id = p.id JOIN `ipallocations` AS ia ON ia.port_id = p.id WHERE p.admin_state_up = 1 AND NOT ia.ip_address IS NULL AND p.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') GROUP BY p.id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address), tenant_port_ip_summary AS (SELECT p.tenant_id, COUNT(*) AS admin_up_port_count, SUM(p.ip_allocation_count) AS total_ip_allocations, SUM(p.subnet_id_rows) AS total_subnet_id_rows FROM admin_up_ports_with_ip_allocs AS p GROUP BY p.tenant_id) SELECT an.tenant_id, COUNT(an.network_id) AS active_network_count, MAX(an.standard_attr_updated_at) AS latest_network_standard_attr_updated_at, tps.admin_up_port_count, tps.total_ip_allocations, tps.total_subnet_id_rows FROM active_networks AS an JOIN tenant_port_ip_summary AS tps ON tps.tenant_id = an.tenant_id WHERE an.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') GROUP BY an.tenant_id, tps.admin_up_port_count, tps.total_ip_allocations, tps.total_subnet_id_rows

target_disjoint_workload.question: Return the port status/device-owner rollup for ports whose standard attribute resource type is 'ports' (including the port count and earliest standard-attribute updated timestamp), and alongside it also return overall tenant-level totals for administratively up ports that have at least one IP allocation (total such ports, total IP allocations, total subnet-id rows, and the average number of such ports per tenant across all tenants). Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH PortStatusOwnerRollup AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT p.STATUS AS port_status, p.DEVICE_OWNER AS device_owner, COUNT(p.ID) AS port_count, MIN(sa.UPDATED_AT) AS earliest_standard_attr_update FROM `ports` AS p JOIN `standardattributes` AS sa ON sa.ID = p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE sa.RESOURCE_TYPE = 'ports' GROUP BY p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(port_status) OVER (ORDER BY port_status_sort, port_status, device_owner) = port_status THEN NULL ELSE port_status END AS port_status, device_owner, port_count, earliest_standard_attr_update FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.port_status) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE i.port_status END AS port_status_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.port_status) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE i.port_status END AS port_status, i.device_owner AS device_owner, SUM(i.port_count) AS port_count, MIN(i.earliest_standard_attr_update) AS earliest_standard_attr_update FROM inner_cte AS i GROUP BY i.port_status, i.device_owner WITH ROLLUP) AS tbltmp ORDER BY port_status_sort, port_status, device_owner), TenantAdminUpIpAllocations AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address, COUNT(ia.ip_address) AS ip_allocation_count, SUM(CASE WHEN NOT ia.subnet_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS subnet_id_rows FROM `ports` AS p JOIN `portsecuritybindings` AS psb ON psb.port_id = p.id JOIN `ipallocations` AS ia ON ia.port_id = p.id WHERE p.admin_state_up = 1 AND NOT ia.ip_address IS NULL GROUP BY p.id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address) SELECT inner_cte.tenant_id AS ports_tenant_id, COUNT(inner_cte.port_id) AS total_admin_up_ports_with_ip_allocations, SUM(inner_cte.ip_allocation_count) AS total_ip_allocations, SUM(inner_cte.subnet_id_rows) AS total_subnet_id_rows, avg_ports.avg_port_count AS avg_ports_per_tenant FROM inner_cte, (SELECT AVG(port_count) AS avg_port_count FROM (SELECT COUNT(port_id) AS port_count FROM inner_cte GROUP BY tenant_id) AS sub) AS avg_ports GROUP BY inner_cte.tenant_id, avg_ports.avg_port_count) SELECT psor.port_status, psor.device_owner, psor.port_count, psor.earliest_standard_attr_update, taua.ports_tenant_id, taua.total_admin_up_ports_with_ip_allocations, taua.total_ip_allocations, taua.total_subnet_id_rows, taua.avg_ports_per_tenant FROM PortStatusOwnerRollup AS psor CROSS JOIN (SELECT MIN(ports_tenant_id) AS ports_tenant_id, SUM(total_admin_up_ports_with_ip_allocations) AS total_admin_up_ports_with_ip_allocations, SUM(total_ip_allocations) AS total_ip_allocations, SUM(total_subnet_id_rows) AS total_subnet_id_rows, MAX(avg_ports_per_tenant) AS avg_ports_per_tenant FROM TenantAdminUpIpAllocations) AS taua

target_disjoint_workload.question: For tenant ID '98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57' and ports that are administratively up, list each port’s ID and tenant ID along with two stacked “signals”: (1) a DNS signal showing the port’s DNS record count versus the overall average and its DNS category (HIGH_DNS/LOW_DNS/AVERAGE_DNS) for ports bound to a security group, and (2) an IP signal showing the port’s IP allocation count versus the overall average and its IP usage category (HIGH_IP/LOW_IP/AVERAGE_IP) for ports with at least one IP allocation. Do not return any rounded answers. Categorize each port as 'HIGH_DNS' (at least 50% more than average), 'LOW_DNS' (at least 50% less than average), or 'AVERAGE_DNS'.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH DnsPerPort AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.tenant_id, p.name AS port_name, COUNT(sgpb.security_group_id) AS security_group_binding_count, SUM(CASE WHEN pd.port_id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) AS dns_record_count FROM `securitygroupportbindings` AS sgpb JOIN `ports` AS p ON sgpb.port_id = p.id LEFT JOIN `portdnses` AS pd ON p.id = pd.port_id WHERE p.admin_state_up = 1 AND p.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') GROUP BY p.id, p.tenant_id, p.name), AverageDns AS (SELECT AVG(dns_record_count) AS avg_dns_records FROM inner_cte) SELECT ic.port_id, ic.tenant_id, ic.port_name, ic.security_group_binding_count, ic.dns_record_count, ad.avg_dns_records AS benchmark, CASE WHEN ic.dns_record_count > ad.avg_dns_records * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_DNS' WHEN ic.dns_record_count < ad.avg_dns_records * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_DNS' ELSE 'AVERAGE_DNS' END AS dns_category FROM inner_cte AS ic CROSS JOIN AverageDns AS ad), IpPerPort AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address, COUNT(ia.ip_address) AS ip_allocation_count, SUM(CASE WHEN NOT ia.subnet_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS subnet_id_rows FROM `ports` AS p JOIN `portsecuritybindings` AS psb ON psb.port_id = p.id JOIN `ipallocations` AS ia ON ia.port_id = p.id WHERE p.admin_state_up = 1 AND NOT ia.ip_address IS NULL AND p.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') GROUP BY p.id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address), AverageAllocations AS (SELECT AVG(ip_allocation_count) AS avg_ip_allocations FROM inner_cte) SELECT ic.port_id, ic.tenant_id, ic.mac_address, ic.ip_allocation_count, ic.subnet_id_rows, aa.avg_ip_allocations AS benchmark, CASE WHEN ic.ip_allocation_count > aa.avg_ip_allocations * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_IP' WHEN ic.ip_allocation_count < aa.avg_ip_allocations * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_IP' ELSE 'AVERAGE_IP' END AS ip_usage_category FROM inner_cte AS ic CROSS JOIN AverageAllocations AS aa), CombinedPortSignals AS (SELECT dpp.port_id, dpp.tenant_id, 'DNS' AS signal_type, dpp.dns_category AS category, dpp.dns_record_count AS signal_count, dpp.benchmark AS benchmark FROM DnsPerPort AS dpp UNION ALL SELECT ipp.port_id, ipp.tenant_id, 'IP' AS signal_type, ipp.ip_usage_category AS category, ipp.ip_allocation_count AS signal_count, ipp.benchmark AS benchmark FROM IpPerPort AS ipp) SELECT port_id, tenant_id, signal_type, category, signal_count, benchmark FROM CombinedPortSignals ORDER BY tenant_id, port_id, signal_type

target_disjoint_workload.question: For the top 10 tenants with the highest total number of IP allocations on administratively up ports (with at least one IP allocation), and where more than 75% of the tenant’s ports are in DOWN status, return the tenant ID, total number of such administratively up ports, total IP allocations across them, whether the tenant has any floating IPs, plus the number of DOWN ports whose standard attribute ID is above the DOWN-port average for their resource type and the average running sum of standard attribute IDs for those qualifying DOWN ports. Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH DownPortsWindowed AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT p.ID AS port_id, p.TENANT_ID AS tenant_id, p.MAC_ADDRESS AS mac_address, SUM(sa.ID) OVER (PARTITION BY sa.RESOURCE_TYPE ORDER BY sa.ID) AS window_column FROM `ports` AS p JOIN `standardattributes` AS sa ON sa.ID = p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN'), ResourceTypeAverages AS (SELECT sa.RESOURCE_TYPE, AVG(sa.ID) AS avg_standard_attr_id FROM `ports` AS p JOIN `standardattributes` AS sa ON sa.ID = p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' GROUP BY sa.RESOURCE_TYPE) SELECT i.port_id, i.tenant_id, i.mac_address, i.window_column FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN `ports` AS p2 ON p2.ID = i.port_id JOIN `standardattributes` AS sa2 ON sa2.ID = p2.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE sa2.ID > (SELECT avg_standard_attr_id FROM ResourceTypeAverages AS rta WHERE rta.RESOURCE_TYPE = sa2.RESOURCE_TYPE)), TopTenantsByIpAllocations AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address, COUNT(ia.ip_address) AS ip_allocation_count, SUM(CASE WHEN NOT ia.subnet_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS subnet_id_rows FROM `ports` AS p JOIN `portsecuritybindings` AS psb ON psb.port_id = p.id JOIN `ipallocations` AS ia ON ia.port_id = p.id WHERE p.admin_state_up = 1 AND NOT ia.ip_address IS NULL GROUP BY p.id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address) SELECT i.tenant_id, COUNT(DISTINCT i.port_id) AS total_ports, SUM(i.ip_allocation_count) AS total_ip_allocations, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT f.id) > 0 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_floating_ips FROM inner_cte AS i LEFT JOIN `ports` AS p ON p.id = i.port_id LEFT JOIN `floatingips` AS f ON p.id = f.fixed_port_id GROUP BY i.tenant_id ORDER BY total_ip_allocations DESC LIMIT 10), TenantDownPortShare AS (SELECT p.tenant_id, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.status = 'DOWN' THEN p.id END) AS down_port_count, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS total_port_count FROM `ports` AS p GROUP BY p.tenant_id) SELECT t.tenant_id, t.total_ports, t.total_ip_allocations, t.has_floating_ips, COUNT(DISTINCT d.port_id) AS qualifying_down_ports, AVG(d.window_column) AS avg_down_port_running_sum_standard_attr_ids FROM TopTenantsByIpAllocations AS t JOIN TenantDownPortShare AS s ON s.tenant_id = t.tenant_id LEFT JOIN DownPortsWindowed AS d ON d.tenant_id = t.tenant_id WHERE (s.down_port_count * 1.0 / NULLIF(s.total_port_count, 0)) > 0.75 GROUP BY t.tenant_id, t.total_ports, t.total_ip_allocations, t.has_floating_ips ORDER BY t.total_ip_allocations DESC

target_disjoint_workload.question: For ports whose status is DOWN, restricted to tenants that are in the top 10 by total IP allocations on administratively up ports (with at least one IP allocation), list the port ID, tenant ID, host, VIF type, allocated IP address, and the row number ordered by IP address (using a window frame of 2 preceding rows and 1 following row). Also include, for each tenant, the total number of DOWN ports and the average DOWN-port count across all tenants, along with that tenant’s total number of administratively up ports, total IP allocations on those ports, and whether the tenant has any floating IPs allocated. Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH down_ports AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT p.ID AS port_id, p.TENANT_ID AS tenant_id, b.HOST AS host, b.VIF_TYPE AS vif_type, ia.IP_ADDRESS AS ip_address, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ia.IP_ADDRESS ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM `ml2_port_bindings` AS b JOIN `ports` AS p ON b.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN `ipallocations` AS ia ON p.ID = ia.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN') SELECT inner_cte.port_id, inner_cte.tenant_id, inner_cte.host, inner_cte.vif_type, inner_cte.ip_address, inner_cte.window_column, tenant_counts.total_down_ports, avg_down.avg_down_port_count FROM inner_cte JOIN (SELECT tenant_id, COUNT(port_id) AS total_down_ports FROM inner_cte GROUP BY tenant_id) AS tenant_counts ON inner_cte.tenant_id = tenant_counts.tenant_id JOIN (SELECT AVG(down_port_count) AS avg_down_port_count FROM (SELECT COUNT(port_id) AS down_port_count FROM inner_cte GROUP BY tenant_id) AS sub) AS avg_down ON 1 = 1), top_tenants_admin_up AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address, COUNT(ia.ip_address) AS ip_allocation_count, SUM(CASE WHEN NOT ia.subnet_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS subnet_id_rows FROM `ports` AS p JOIN `portsecuritybindings` AS psb ON psb.port_id = p.id JOIN `ipallocations` AS ia ON ia.port_id = p.id WHERE p.admin_state_up = 1 AND NOT ia.ip_address IS NULL GROUP BY p.id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address) SELECT i.tenant_id, COUNT(DISTINCT i.port_id) AS total_ports, SUM(i.ip_allocation_count) AS total_ip_allocations, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT f.id) > 0 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_floating_ips FROM inner_cte AS i LEFT JOIN `ports` AS p ON p.id = i.port_id LEFT JOIN `floatingips` AS f ON p.id = f.fixed_port_id GROUP BY i.tenant_id ORDER BY total_ip_allocations DESC LIMIT 10) SELECT dp.port_id, dp.tenant_id, dp.host, dp.vif_type, dp.ip_address, dp.window_column, dp.total_down_ports, dp.avg_down_port_count, tt.total_ports AS admin_up_total_ports, tt.total_ip_allocations AS admin_up_total_ip_allocations, tt.has_floating_ips FROM down_ports AS dp JOIN top_tenants_admin_up AS tt ON dp.tenant_id = tt.tenant_id

target_disjoint_workload.question: Return (1) the count of ports that are DOWN in network ID `0a1d0a27-cffa-4de3-92c5-9d3fd3f2e74d` with security-group bindings and the average deviation of each port’s windowed minimum `admin_state_up` from the overall average of that windowed minimum, together with (2) the TOTAL number of IP allocations and TOTAL number of subnet-id rows for administratively up ports in tenant ID `98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57` that have at least one IP allocation. target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH q1_inner_cte AS (SELECT p.NAME, p.NETWORK_ID, p.MAC_ADDRESS, p.ADMIN_STATE_UP, p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER, s.SECURITY_GROUP_ID, MIN(p.ADMIN_STATE_UP) OVER (ORDER BY p.ID ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM `ports` AS p JOIN `securitygroupportbindings` AS s ON p.ID = s.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' AND p.NETWORK_ID IN ('0a1d0a27-cffa-4de3-92c5-9d3fd3f2e74d')), q1_avg_window AS (SELECT AVG(window_column) AS avg_window_column FROM q1_inner_cte), q1 AS (SELECT i.NAME, i.NETWORK_ID, i.MAC_ADDRESS, i.ADMIN_STATE_UP, i.STATUS, i.DEVICE_OWNER, i.SECURITY_GROUP_ID, i.window_column, (i.window_column - a.avg_window_column) AS deviation_from_avg_window_min FROM q1_inner_cte AS i CROSS JOIN q1_avg_window AS a), q2_inner_cte AS (SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address, COUNT(ia.ip_address) AS ip_allocation_count, SUM(CASE WHEN NOT ia.subnet_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS subnet_id_rows FROM `ports` AS p JOIN `portsecuritybindings` AS psb ON psb.port_id = p.id JOIN `ipallocations` AS ia ON ia.port_id = p.id WHERE p.admin_state_up = 1 AND NOT ia.ip_address IS NULL AND p.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') GROUP BY p.id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address), q2 AS (SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(port_id) OVER (ORDER BY port_id_sort, port_id) = port_id THEN NULL ELSE port_id END AS port_id, tenant_id, mac_address, ip_allocation_count, subnet_id_rows FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.port_id) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE i.port_id END AS port_id_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.port_id) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE i.port_id END AS port_id, CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.port_id) = 1 THEN NULL ELSE i.tenant_id END AS tenant_id, CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.port_id) = 1 THEN NULL ELSE i.mac_address END AS mac_address, SUM(i.ip_allocation_count) AS ip_allocation_count, SUM(i.subnet_id_rows) AS subnet_id_rows FROM q2_inner_cte AS i GROUP BY i.port_id, i.tenant_id, i.mac_address WITH ROLLUP) AS tbltmp ORDER BY port_id_sort, port_id) SELECT COUNT(*) AS Down_Ports_In_Network_With_SG_Bindings, AVG(q1.deviation_from_avg_window_min) AS Avg_Deviation_From_Avg_Window_Min_Admin_State_Up, MAX(CASE WHEN q2.port_id = 'TOTAL' THEN q2.ip_allocation_count END) AS Total_Ip_Allocations_For_Admin_Up_Ports_In_Tenant, MAX(CASE WHEN q2.port_id = 'TOTAL' THEN q2.subnet_id_rows END) AS Total_Subnet_Id_Rows_For_Admin_Up_Ports_In_Tenant FROM q1 CROSS JOIN q2

target_disjoint_workload.question: For tenant ID `98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57`, return (1) the total number of administratively up ports that have at least one IP allocation and whose IP allocation count is greater than that tenant’s average, (2) the total number of ACTIVE networks for that tenant (from the tenant subtotal row), and (3) the average number of such above-average ports per active network.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH PortAllocationsAboveTenantAvg AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address, COUNT(ia.ip_address) AS ip_allocation_count, SUM(CASE WHEN NOT ia.subnet_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS subnet_id_rows FROM `ports` AS p JOIN `portsecuritybindings` AS psb ON psb.port_id = p.id JOIN `ipallocations` AS ia ON ia.port_id = p.id WHERE p.admin_state_up = 1 AND NOT ia.ip_address IS NULL AND p.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') GROUP BY p.id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address), TenantAverages AS (SELECT tenant_id, AVG(ip_allocation_count) AS avg_ip_allocs FROM inner_cte GROUP BY tenant_id) SELECT i.port_id, i.tenant_id, i.mac_address, i.ip_allocation_count, i.subnet_id_rows FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN TenantAverages AS ta ON ta.tenant_id = i.tenant_id WHERE i.ip_allocation_count > ta.avg_ip_allocs), ActiveNetworksWithTenantRollup AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT n.ID AS network_id, n.NAME AS network_name, n.TENANT_ID AS tenant_id, n.ADMIN_STATE_UP AS admin_state_up, n.MTU AS mtu, sa.UPDATED_AT AS standard_attr_updated_at, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.TENANT_ID ORDER BY n.NAME) AS window_column FROM `networks` AS n JOIN `standardattributes` AS sa ON sa.ID = n.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE n.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND n.TENANT_ID IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57')) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(tenant_id) OVER (ORDER BY tenant_id_sort, tenant_id, network_name) = tenant_id THEN NULL ELSE tenant_id END AS tenant_id, network_id, network_name, admin_state_up, mtu, standard_attr_updated_at, window_column, total_networks FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(tenant_id) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE tenant_id END AS tenant_id_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(tenant_id) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE tenant_id END AS tenant_id, CASE WHEN GROUPING(tenant_id) = 1 THEN NULL ELSE network_id END AS network_id, CASE WHEN GROUPING(tenant_id) = 1 THEN NULL ELSE network_name END AS network_name, CASE WHEN GROUPING(tenant_id) = 1 THEN NULL ELSE admin_state_up END AS admin_state_up, CASE WHEN GROUPING(tenant_id) = 1 THEN NULL ELSE mtu END AS mtu, CASE WHEN GROUPING(tenant_id) = 1 THEN NULL ELSE standard_attr_updated_at END AS standard_attr_updated_at, CASE WHEN GROUPING(tenant_id) = 1 THEN NULL ELSE window_column END AS window_column, COUNT(*) AS total_networks FROM inner_cte GROUP BY tenant_id, network_id, network_name, admin_state_up, mtu, standard_attr_updated_at, window_column WITH ROLLUP) AS tbltmp ORDER BY tenant_id_sort, tenant_id, network_name), TotalPortsAboveAvg AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_ports_above_avg FROM PortAllocationsAboveTenantAvg) SELECT tpa.total_ports_above_avg, anwr.total_networks, ROUND(tpa.total_ports_above_avg / NULLIF(anwr.total_networks, 0), 2) AS avg_ports_above_avg_per_active_network FROM TotalPortsAboveAvg AS tpa CROSS JOIN (SELECT total_networks FROM ActiveNetworksWithTenantRollup WHERE tenant_id = 'TOTAL') AS anwr

target_disjoint_workload.question: Considering only load balancers in ACTIVE provisioning status and excluding shared networks (i.e., networks not granted `access_as_shared` to `*` or tenant `9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b`), list the top 10 operating statuses by total incoming bytes. target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT lb.OPERATING_STATUS, SUM(s.BYTES_IN) AS total_bytes_in FROM `lbaas_loadbalancers` AS lb JOIN `lbaas_loadbalancer_statistics` AS s ON lb.ID = s.LOADBALANCER_ID WHERE lb.PROVISIONING_STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND lb.VIP_SUBNET_ID IN (SELECT subnets.id FROM `subnets` JOIN `networks` ON networks.id = subnets.network_id WHERE NOT networks.id IN (SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM `networkrbacs` WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b'))) GROUP BY lb.OPERATING_STATUS HAVING SUM(s.BYTES_IN) > 1000000) SELECT i.OPERATING_STATUS, i.total_bytes_in, CASE WHEN MAX(CASE WHEN s.TOTAL_CONNECTIONS > 10000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 1 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_any_lb_over_10000_total_connections FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN `lbaas_loadbalancers` AS lb ON lb.OPERATING_STATUS = i.OPERATING_STATUS JOIN `lbaas_loadbalancer_statistics` AS s ON s.LOADBALANCER_ID = lb.ID WHERE lb.PROVISIONING_STATUS = 'ACTIVE' GROUP BY i.OPERATING_STATUS, i.total_bytes_in ORDER BY i.total_bytes_in DESC LIMIT 10

FROM `lbaas_loadbalancers` AS lb3 JOIN `providerresourceassociations` AS pra3 ON lb3.ID = pra3.RESOURCE_ID WHERE pra3.PROVIDER_NAME = 'haproxy' GROUP BY lb3.TENANT_ID) AS sub) AS avg_counts ON 1 = 1) SELECT q1.TENANT_ID, q1.total_online_haproxy_loadbalancers, q1.overall_online_haproxy_loadbalancers, q2.loadbalancer_name, q2.vip_address, q2.bytes_in, q2.total_connections, q2.window_column, q2.tenant_haproxy_loadbalancer_count, q2.avg_haproxy_loadbalancers_per_tenant FROM q1 JOIN q2 ON q2.tenant_id = q1.TENANT_ID ORDER BY q1.total_online_haproxy_loadbalancers DESC, q2.loadbalancer_name

target_disjoint_workload.question: For each tenant, find the tenant ID and the highest total incoming bytes among that tenant’s load balancer operating statuses, considering only load balancers in ACTIVE provisioning status and excluding shared networks (i.e., networks granted `access_as_shared` to `*` or tenant `9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b`), and keep only tenants whose highest such total exceeds 1,000,000. Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT lb.OPERATING_STATUS, SUM(s.BYTES_IN) AS total_bytes_in FROM `lbaas_loadbalancers` AS lb JOIN `lbaas_loadbalancer_statistics` AS s ON lb.ID = s.LOADBALANCER_ID WHERE lb.PROVISIONING_STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND lb.VIP_SUBNET_ID IN (SELECT subnets.id FROM `subnets` JOIN `networks` ON networks.id = subnets.network_id WHERE NOT networks.id IN (SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM `networkrbacs` WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b'))) GROUP BY lb.OPERATING_STATUS HAVING SUM(s.BYTES_IN) > 1000000) SELECT lb.TENANT_ID, MAX(inner_cte.total_bytes_in) AS max_total_bytes_in_across_statuses FROM inner_cte JOIN `lbaas_loadbalancers` AS lb ON lb.OPERATING_STATUS = inner_cte.OPERATING_STATUS WHERE lb.PROVISIONING_STATUS = 'ACTIVE' GROUP BY lb.TENANT_ID HAVING MAX(inner_cte.total_bytes_in) > 1000000

target_disjoint_workload.question: Among the load balancers associated with the provider named 'haproxy' whose highest admin_state_up value is 1, list the top 10 tenants by number of such load balancers, showing each tenant ID, the total number of qualifying load balancers, and whether any of those load balancers are currently operating ONLINE. Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT lb.name AS loadbalancer_name, MAX(lb.admin_state_up) AS max_admin_state_up, lb.operating_status FROM `lbaas_loadbalancers` AS lb JOIN `providerresourceassociations` AS pra ON lb.id = pra.resource_id WHERE pra.provider_name = 'haproxy' GROUP BY lb.name, lb.operating_status HAVING MAX(lb.admin_state_up) = 1) SELECT lb.tenant_id, COUNT(DISTINCT lb.id) AS total_qualifying_loadbalancers, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN inner_cte.operating_status = 'ONLINE' THEN lb.id END) > 0 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_any_online FROM inner_cte JOIN `lbaas_loadbalancers` AS lb ON lb.name = inner_cte.loadbalancer_name AND lb.operating_status = inner_cte.operating_status GROUP BY lb.tenant_id ORDER BY total_qualifying_loadbalancers DESC LIMIT 10

target_disjoint_workload.question: For load balancers provided by the “haproxy” provider, list the provider name, load balancer name, load balancer ID, VIP address, provisioning status, operating status, and the running average of the load balancer ID within each provider name group ordered by load balancer name. Do not repeat the provider name if it is the same as the previous row, and include a subtotal row for the provider. Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT lb.NAME, lb.ID, lb.VIP_ADDRESS, lb.PROVISIONING_STATUS, lb.OPERATING_STATUS, AVG(lb.ID) OVER (PARTITION BY pra.PROVIDER_NAME ORDER BY lb.NAME) AS window_column FROM `lbaas_loadbalancers` AS lb JOIN `providerresourceassociations` AS pra ON lb.ID = pra.RESOURCE_ID WHERE pra.PROVIDER_NAME = 'haproxy') SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(provider_name) OVER (ORDER BY provider_name_sort, lb_name) = provider_name THEN NULL ELSE provider_name END AS provider_name, lb_name, lb_id, vip_address, provisioning_status, operating_status, window_column FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(pra.PROVIDER_NAME) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE pra.PROVIDER_NAME END AS provider_name_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(pra.PROVIDER_NAME) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE pra.PROVIDER_NAME END AS provider_name, inner_cte.NAME AS lb_name, inner_cte.ID AS lb_id, inner_cte.VIP_ADDRESS AS vip_address, inner_cte.PROVISIONING_STATUS AS provisioning_status, inner_cte.OPERATING_STATUS AS operating_status, inner_cte.window_column AS window_column FROM inner_cte JOIN `providerresourceassociations` AS pra ON inner_cte.ID = pra.RESOURCE_ID GROUP BY pra.PROVIDER_NAME, inner_cte.NAME, inner_cte.ID, inner_cte.VIP_ADDRESS, inner_cte.PROVISIONING_STATUS, inner_cte.OPERATING_STATUS, inner_cte.window_column WITH ROLLUP) AS tbltmp ORDER BY provider_name_sort, lb_name

target_disjoint_workload.question: For each tenant, list each ACTIVE load balancer’s name, VIP address, total connections, and bytes in, along with the tenant’s average total connections across its ACTIVE load balancers as a benchmark, and categorize each load balancer as 'HIGH_CONN' (at least 50% above the tenant average), 'LOW_CONN' (at least 50% below the tenant average), or 'AVG_CONN'. Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT lb.NAME, lb.VIP_ADDRESS, stats.TOTAL_CONNECTIONS, stats.BYTES_IN, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY lb.TENANT_ID ORDER BY lb.ID) AS window_column FROM `lbaas_loadbalancers` AS lb JOIN `lbaas_loadbalancer_statistics` AS stats ON lb.ID = stats.LOADBALANCER_ID WHERE lb.PROVISIONING_STATUS = 'ACTIVE'), tenant_avg AS (SELECT lb.TENANT_ID, AVG(stats.TOTAL_CONNECTIONS) AS avg_total_connections FROM `lbaas_loadbalancers` AS lb JOIN `lbaas_loadbalancer_statistics` AS stats ON lb.ID = stats.LOADBALANCER_ID WHERE lb.PROVISIONING_STATUS = 'ACTIVE' GROUP BY lb.TENANT_ID) SELECT lb.TENANT_ID, i.NAME, i.VIP_ADDRESS, i.TOTAL_CONNECTIONS, i.BYTES_IN, i.window_column, ta.avg_total_connections AS benchmark, CASE WHEN i.TOTAL_CONNECTIONS > ta.avg_total_connections * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_CONN' WHEN i.TOTAL_CONNECTIONS < ta.avg_total_connections * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_CONN' ELSE 'AVG_CONN' END AS connection_category FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN `lbaas_loadbalancers` AS lb ON lb.NAME = i.NAME AND lb.VIP_ADDRESS = i.VIP_ADDRESS JOIN tenant_avg AS ta ON ta.TENANT_ID = lb.TENANT_ID

target_disjoint_workload.question: For ACTIVE load balancers, list the load balancer name, VIP address, bytes in, total connections, provider name, and the dense rank within each tenant ordered by load balancer ID, but only include those whose total connections are greater than the average total connections for ACTIVE load balancers in the same provider. Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT lb.NAME AS loadbalancer_name, lb.VIP_ADDRESS AS vip_address, stats.BYTES_IN AS bytes_in, stats.TOTAL_CONNECTIONS AS total_connections, pra.PROVIDER_NAME AS provider_name, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY lb.TENANT_ID ORDER BY lb.ID) AS window_column FROM `lbaas_loadbalancer_statistics` AS stats JOIN `lbaas_loadbalancers` AS lb ON stats.LOADBALANCER_ID = lb.ID JOIN `providerresourceassociations` AS pra ON lb.ID = pra.RESOURCE_ID WHERE lb.PROVISIONING_STATUS = 'ACTIVE'), ProviderAverages AS (SELECT provider_name, AVG(total_connections) AS avg_total_connections FROM inner_cte GROUP BY provider_name) SELECT i.loadbalancer_name, i.vip_address, i.bytes_in, i.total_connections, i.provider_name, i.window_column FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN ProviderAverages AS pa ON i.provider_name = pa.provider_name WHERE i.total_connections > pa.avg_total_connections

target_disjoint_workload.question: For each tenant, list each ACTIVE load balancer’s name, VIP address, total connections, and bytes in, include a dense rank within the tenant ordered by load balancer ID, and also show the tenant’s average total connections across its ACTIVE load balancers. Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT lb.NAME, lb.VIP_ADDRESS, stats.TOTAL_CONNECTIONS, stats.BYTES_IN, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY lb.TENANT_ID ORDER BY lb.ID) AS window_column FROM `lbaas_loadbalancers` AS lb JOIN `lbaas_loadbalancer_statistics` AS stats ON lb.ID = stats.LOADBALANCER_ID WHERE lb.PROVISIONING_STATUS = 'ACTIVE') SELECT inner_cte.NAME, inner_cte.VIP_ADDRESS, inner_cte.TOTAL_CONNECTIONS, inner_cte.BYTES_IN, inner_cte.window_column, tenant_avg.avg_total_connections FROM inner_cte JOIN (SELECT lb.TENANT_ID, AVG(stats.TOTAL_CONNECTIONS) AS avg_total_connections FROM `lbaas_loadbalancers` AS lb JOIN `lbaas_loadbalancer_statistics` AS stats ON lb.ID = stats.LOADBALANCER_ID WHERE lb.PROVISIONING_STATUS = 'ACTIVE' GROUP BY lb.TENANT_ID) AS tenant_avg ON tenant_avg.TENANT_ID = (SELECT lb2.TENANT_ID FROM `lbaas_loadbalancers` AS lb2 WHERE lb2.VIP_ADDRESS = inner_cte.VIP_ADDRESS LIMIT 1)

target_disjoint_workload.question: For load balancers provided by the “haproxy” provider, list each load balancer’s name, ID, VIP address, provisioning status, operating status, and the running average of the load balancer ID within the provider group (ordered by load balancer name), and also include the total incoming bytes for that operating status considering only ACTIVE load balancers and keeping only operating statuses whose total incoming bytes exceed 1,000,000; additionally, for each operating status, report the maximum of the per-load-balancer total connections among those same ACTIVE load balancers. Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH HapLoadBalancers AS (SELECT lb.NAME, lb.ID, lb.VIP_ADDRESS, lb.PROVISIONING_STATUS, lb.OPERATING_STATUS, AVG(lb.ID) OVER (PARTITION BY pra.PROVIDER_NAME ORDER BY lb.NAME) AS window_column FROM `lbaas_loadbalancers` AS lb JOIN `providerresourceassociations` AS pra ON lb.ID = pra.RESOURCE_ID WHERE pra.PROVIDER_NAME = 'haproxy'), OperatingStatusBytesIn AS (SELECT lb.OPERATING_STATUS, SUM(s.BYTES_IN) AS total_bytes_in FROM `lbaas_loadbalancers` AS lb JOIN `lbaas_loadbalancer_statistics` AS s ON lb.ID = s.LOADBALANCER_ID WHERE lb.PROVISIONING_STATUS = 'ACTIVE' GROUP BY lb.OPERATING_STATUS HAVING SUM(s.BYTES_IN) > 1000000) SELECT hlb.NAME, hlb.ID, hlb.VIP_ADDRESS, hlb.PROVISIONING_STATUS, hlb.OPERATING_STATUS, hlb.window_column, osbi.total_bytes_in FROM HapLoadBalancers AS hlb JOIN OperatingStatusBytesIn AS osbi ON hlb.OPERATING_STATUS = osbi.OPERATING_STATUS ORDER BY hlb.NAME), StatusPerLbConnections AS (SELECT lb.OPERATING_STATUS, lb.ID AS loadbalancer_id, SUM(s.TOTAL_CONNECTIONS) AS per_lb_total_connections FROM `lbaas_loadbalancers` AS lb JOIN `lbaas_loadbalancer_statistics` AS s ON lb.ID = s.LOADBALANCER_ID WHERE lb.PROVISIONING_STATUS = 'ACTIVE' GROUP BY lb.OPERATING_STATUS, lb.ID), StatusMaxConnections AS (SELECT OPERATING_STATUS, MAX(per_lb_total_connections) AS max_per_lb_total_connections FROM StatusPerLbConnections GROUP BY OPERATING_STATUS) SELECT i.NAME, i.ID, i.VIP_ADDRESS, i.PROVISIONING_STATUS, i.OPERATING_STATUS, i.window_column, i.total_bytes_in, smc.max_per_lb_total_connections FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN StatusMaxConnections AS smc ON i.OPERATING_STATUS = smc.OPERATING_STATUS ORDER BY i.NAME

target_disjoint_workload.question: For load balancers that are both provided by the 'haproxy' provider and have an operating status of ONLINE, list each load balancer’s name, ID, VIP address, provisioning status, operating status, the running average of the load balancer ID within its provider group ordered by load balancer name, its rank within the provider group ordered by total connections, the load balancer’s total connections, and the deviation of its total connections from the average total connections across all such load balancers. Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH subq1 AS (SELECT lb.NAME, lb.ID, lb.VIP_ADDRESS, lb.PROVISIONING_STATUS, lb.OPERATING_STATUS, AVG(lb.ID) OVER (PARTITION BY pra.PROVIDER_NAME ORDER BY lb.NAME) AS window_column FROM `lbaas_loadbalancers` AS lb JOIN `providerresourceassociations` AS pra ON lb.ID = pra.RESOURCE_ID WHERE pra.PROVIDER_NAME = 'haproxy'), subq2 AS (SELECT lb.ID AS loadbalancer_id, lb.NAME AS loadbalancer_name, pra.PROVIDER_NAME AS provider_name, lb.VIP_ADDRESS AS vip_address, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pra.PROVIDER_NAME ORDER BY stats.TOTAL_CONNECTIONS) AS window_column FROM `lbaas_loadbalancer_statistics` AS stats JOIN `lbaas_loadbalancers` AS lb ON stats.LOADBALANCER_ID = lb.ID JOIN `providerresourceassociations` AS pra ON lb.ID = pra.RESOURCE_ID WHERE lb.OPERATING_STATUS = 'ONLINE') SELECT s1.NAME AS load_balancer_name, s1.ID AS load_balancer_id, s1.VIP_ADDRESS AS vip_address, s1.PROVISIONING_STATUS AS provisioning_status, s1.OPERATING_STATUS AS operating_status, s1.window_column AS running_avg_loadbalancer_id_within_provider_ordered_by_name, s2.provider_name, s2.window_column AS rank_within_provider_by_total_connections FROM subq1 AS s1 JOIN subq2 AS s2 ON s1.ID = s2.loadbalancer_id ORDER BY s1.NAME), AvgConnections AS (SELECT AVG(stats.TOTAL_CONNECTIONS) AS avg_total_connections FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN `lbaas_loadbalancer_statistics` AS stats ON stats.LOADBALANCER_ID = i.load_balancer_id) SELECT i.load_balancer_name, i.load_balancer_id, i.vip_address, i.provisioning_status, i.operating_status, i.running_avg_loadbalancer_id_within_provider_ordered_by_name, i.provider_name, i.rank_within_provider_by_total_connections, stats.TOTAL_CONNECTIONS AS total_connections, (stats.TOTAL_CONNECTIONS - ac.avg_total_connections) AS deviation_from_avg_total_connections FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN `lbaas_loadbalancer_statistics` AS stats ON stats.LOADBALANCER_ID = i.load_balancer_id CROSS JOIN AvgConnections AS ac ORDER BY i.load_balancer_name

target_disjoint_workload.question: For haproxy load balancers that are in ACTIVE provisioning status, list the load balancer name, ID, VIP address, provisioning status, operating status, the running average of the load balancer ID within the haproxy provider group ordered by load balancer name, and the total incoming bytes for that operating status. Also include the overall average of total incoming bytes across operating statuses (considering only ACTIVE load balancers) as a benchmark, and categorize each operating status as 'HIGH_BYTES_IN' (at least 50% above the benchmark), 'LOW_BYTES_IN' (at least 50% below the benchmark), or 'AVERAGE_BYTES_IN'. Keep only operating statuses whose total incoming bytes (across ACTIVE load balancers) exceed 1,000,000. Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH HapLoadBalancers AS (SELECT lb.NAME, lb.ID, lb.VIP_ADDRESS, lb.PROVISIONING_STATUS, lb.OPERATING_STATUS, AVG(lb.ID) OVER (PARTITION BY pra.PROVIDER_NAME ORDER BY lb.NAME) AS window_column FROM `lbaas_loadbalancers` AS lb JOIN `providerresourceassociations` AS pra ON lb.ID = pra.RESOURCE_ID WHERE pra.PROVIDER_NAME = 'haproxy'), OperatingStatusBytesIn AS (SELECT lb.OPERATING_STATUS, SUM(s.BYTES_IN) AS total_bytes_in FROM `lbaas_loadbalancers` AS lb JOIN `lbaas_loadbalancer_statistics` AS s ON lb.ID = s.LOADBALANCER_ID WHERE lb.PROVISIONING_STATUS = 'ACTIVE' GROUP BY lb.OPERATING_STATUS HAVING SUM(s.BYTES_IN) > 1000000) SELECT hlb.NAME, hlb.ID, hlb.VIP_ADDRESS, hlb.PROVISIONING_STATUS, hlb.OPERATING_STATUS, hlb.window_column, osbi.total_bytes_in FROM HapLoadBalancers AS hlb JOIN OperatingStatusBytesIn AS osbi ON hlb.OPERATING_STATUS = osbi.OPERATING_STATUS WHERE hlb.PROVISIONING_STATUS = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY hlb.NAME), AvgBytesInBenchmark AS (SELECT AVG(total_bytes_in) AS avg_total_bytes_in FROM (SELECT lb.OPERATING_STATUS, SUM(s.BYTES_IN) AS total_bytes_in FROM `lbaas_loadbalancers` AS lb JOIN `lbaas_loadbalancer_statistics` AS s ON lb.ID = s.LOADBALANCER_ID WHERE lb.PROVISIONING_STATUS = 'ACTIVE' GROUP BY lb.OPERATING_STATUS HAVING SUM(s.BYTES_IN) > 1000000) AS t) SELECT i.NAME, i.ID, i.VIP_ADDRESS, i.PROVISIONING_STATUS, i.OPERATING_STATUS, i.window_column, i.total_bytes_in, a.avg_total_bytes_in AS benchmark, CASE WHEN i.total_bytes_in > a.avg_total_bytes_in * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_BYTES_IN' WHEN i.total_bytes_in < a.avg_total_bytes_in * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_BYTES_IN' ELSE 'AVERAGE_BYTES_IN' END AS bytes_in_category FROM inner_cte AS i CROSS JOIN AvgBytesInBenchmark AS a

target_disjoint_workload.question: For the top 10 tenants by number of 'haproxy' load balancers (considering only load balancers whose highest admin_state_up is 1), return each tenant’s ID, their total number of qualifying load balancers, the average number of these qualifying 'haproxy' load balancers across all tenants, and whether the tenant has any qualifying load balancers currently operating ONLINE—restricted to tenants whose qualifying load balancer count is greater than the overall average. Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH TopTenTenants AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT lb.name AS loadbalancer_name, MAX(lb.admin_state_up) AS max_admin_state_up, lb.operating_status FROM `lbaas_loadbalancers` AS lb JOIN `providerresourceassociations` AS pra ON lb.id = pra.resource_id WHERE pra.provider_name = 'haproxy' GROUP BY lb.name, lb.operating_status HAVING MAX(lb.admin_state_up) = 1) SELECT lb.tenant_id, COUNT(DISTINCT lb.id) AS total_qualifying_loadbalancers, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN inner_cte.operating_status = 'ONLINE' THEN lb.id END) > 0 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_any_online FROM inner_cte JOIN `lbaas_loadbalancers` AS lb ON lb.name = inner_cte.loadbalancer_name AND lb.operating_status = inner_cte.operating_status GROUP BY lb.tenant_id ORDER BY total_qualifying_loadbalancers DESC LIMIT 10), TenantHaproxyCountsAndAverage AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT lb.name AS loadbalancer_name, MAX(lb.admin_state_up) AS max_admin_state_up, lb.operating_status FROM `lbaas_loadbalancers` AS lb JOIN `providerresourceassociations` AS pra ON lb.id = pra.resource_id WHERE pra.provider_name = 'haproxy' GROUP BY lb.name, lb.operating_status HAVING MAX(lb.admin_state_up) = 1) SELECT lb.tenant_id AS tenant_id, COUNT(inner_cte.loadbalancer_name) AS total_haproxy_loadbalancers, avg_counts.avg_lb_count FROM inner_cte JOIN `lbaas_loadbalancers` AS lb ON lb.name = inner_cte.loadbalancer_name AND lb.operating_status = inner_cte.operating_status, (SELECT AVG(lb_count) AS avg_lb_count FROM (SELECT lb2.tenant_id, COUNT(*) AS lb_count FROM (SELECT lb.name AS loadbalancer_name, MAX(lb.admin_state_up) AS max_admin_state_up, lb.operating_status FROM `lbaas_loadbalancers` AS lb JOIN `providerresourceassociations` AS pra ON lb.id = pra.resource_id WHERE pra.provider_name = 'haproxy' GROUP BY lb.name, lb.operating_status HAVING MAX(lb.admin_state_up) = 1) AS inner2 JOIN `lbaas_loadbalancers` AS lb2 ON lb2.name = inner2.loadbalancer_name AND lb2.operating_status = inner2.operating_status GROUP BY lb2.tenant_id) AS sub) AS avg_counts GROUP BY lb.tenant_id, avg_counts.avg_lb_count) SELECT ttt.tenant_id, ttt.total_qualifying_loadbalancers, tha.avg_lb_count, ttt.has_any_online FROM TopTenTenants AS ttt JOIN TenantHaproxyCountsAndAverage AS tha ON ttt.tenant_id = tha.tenant_id WHERE ttt.total_qualifying_loadbalancers > tha.avg_lb_count ORDER BY ttt.total_qualifying_loadbalancers DESC

target_disjoint_workload.question: Find load balancers associated with the provider named 'haproxy' whose highest admin_state_up value is 1, and for each such load balancer return its name and operating status along with the total incoming bytes for that operating status across ACTIVE-provisioning load balancers, keeping only operating statuses where the total incoming bytes exceed 1,000,000. Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH ActiveStatusBytes AS (SELECT lb.OPERATING_STATUS, SUM(s.BYTES_IN) AS total_bytes_in FROM `lbaas_loadbalancers` AS lb JOIN `lbaas_loadbalancer_statistics` AS s ON lb.ID = s.LOADBALANCER_ID WHERE lb.PROVISIONING_STATUS = 'ACTIVE' GROUP BY lb.OPERATING_STATUS HAVING SUM(s.BYTES_IN) > 1000000), HaproxyAdminUpLoadBalancers AS (SELECT lb.name AS loadbalancer_name, MAX(lb.admin_state_up) AS max_admin_state_up, lb.operating_status FROM `lbaas_loadbalancers` AS lb JOIN `providerresourceassociations` AS pra ON lb.id = pra.resource_id WHERE pra.provider_name = 'haproxy' GROUP BY lb.name, lb.operating_status HAVING MAX(lb.admin_state_up) = 1) SELECT h.loadbalancer_name, h.operating_status, a.total_bytes_in FROM HaproxyAdminUpLoadBalancers AS h JOIN ActiveStatusBytes AS a ON h.operating_status = a.OPERATING_STATUS ORDER BY h.operating_status, h.loadbalancer_name

target_disjoint_workload.question: How many ports are currently in DOWN status and also have an extra DHCP option configured for IPv4, excluding ports that belong to shared networks? Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS down_ports_with_ipv4_dhcp_opts FROM `ml2_dvr_port_bindings` AS b JOIN `ports` AS p ON b.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN `extradhcpopts` AS e ON p.ID = e.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' AND e.IP_VERSION = 4 AND NOT p.NETWORK_ID IN (SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM `networkrbacs` WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b'))

target_disjoint_workload.question: For tenant ID "98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57", list all administratively-up ports that are on ACTIVE networks owned by the same tenant. Return the network ID and name, network admin_state_up, MTU, and the network standard attribute updated_at timestamp (with a row number per tenant ordered by network name), along with each matching port’s ID, host, VIF type, VNIC type, MAC address, status, device owner, and the VIF-type windowed average of the port standard attribute ID (2 preceding to 2 following rows). Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH ActiveTenantNetworks AS (SELECT n.ID AS network_id, n.NAME AS network_name, n.TENANT_ID AS tenant_id, n.ADMIN_STATE_UP AS admin_state_up, n.MTU AS mtu, sa.UPDATED_AT AS standard_attr_updated_at, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.TENANT_ID ORDER BY n.NAME) AS window_column FROM `networks` AS n JOIN `standardattributes` AS sa ON sa.ID = n.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE n.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND n.TENANT_ID IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57')), AdminUpTenantPorts AS (SELECT b.PORT_ID, b.HOST, b.VIF_TYPE, b.VNIC_TYPE, p.TENANT_ID, p.NETWORK_ID, p.MAC_ADDRESS, p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER, AVG(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER (PARTITION BY b.VIF_TYPE ORDER BY p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM `ml2_port_bindings` AS b JOIN `ports` AS p ON b.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN `portsecuritybindings` AS psb ON p.ID = psb.PORT_ID WHERE p.ADMIN_STATE_UP = 1 AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57')) SELECT n.network_id, n.network_name, n.tenant_id, n.admin_state_up AS network_admin_state_up, n.mtu, n.standard_attr_updated_at AS network_standard_attr_updated_at, n.window_column AS network_row_number_within_tenant, p.PORT_ID AS port_id, p.HOST AS port_host, p.VIF_TYPE AS port_vif_type, p.VNIC_TYPE AS port_vnic_type, p.MAC_ADDRESS AS port_mac_address, p.STATUS AS port_status, p.DEVICE_OWNER AS port_device_owner, p.window_column AS port_avg_standard_attr_id_window FROM ActiveTenantNetworks AS n JOIN AdminUpTenantPorts AS p ON p.NETWORK_ID = n.network_id AND p.TENANT_ID = n.tenant_id ORDER BY n.network_name, p.PORT_ID

target_disjoint_workload.question: For tenant ID `98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57`, list ports that (1) are administratively up and have a VIF-type windowed average standard attribute ID (2 preceding and 2 following, ordered by standard attribute ID) greater than the overall average for that VIF type, and that also (2) appear among DOWN ports whose running sum of standard attribute ID within each security group (ordered by standard attribute ID) is greater than the average running sum across those DOWN ports. owa.overall_avg_window_column) AS deviation_from_overall_window_avg FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN VifTypeCounts AS vtc ON i.VIF_TYPE = vtc.VIF_TYPE CROSS JOIN OverallWindowAvg AS owa), down_ports AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address, sgpb.security_group_id, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY sgpb.security_group_id ORDER BY p.id) AS window_column FROM `securitygroupportbindings` AS sgpb JOIN `ports` AS p ON sgpb.port_id = p.id JOIN `portsecuritybindings` AS psb ON p.id = psb.port_id WHERE p.status = 'DOWN' AND p.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57')), avg_rank_cte AS (SELECT AVG(window_column) AS avg_rank FROM inner_cte) SELECT i.port_id, i.tenant_id, i.mac_address, i.security_group_id, i.window_column AS rank_within_security_group, (i.window_column - target_disjoint_workload.question: How many administratively up ports exist for tenant ID `98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57`, and how many distinct statuses are present in the top 10 port statuses (by port count) for ports with VIF type `ovs` and device_id `da811c75-0f9b-462c-b020-8ea55f6ca7c7`? target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH q1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT b.PORT_ID, b.HOST, b.VIF_TYPE, b.VNIC_TYPE, p.TENANT_ID, p.NETWORK_ID, p.MAC_ADDRESS, p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER, b.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN `portsecuritybindings` AS psb ON p.ID = psb.PORT_ID WHERE p.ADMIN_STATE_UP = 1 AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57')), VifTypeCounts AS (SELECT VIF_TYPE, AS avp), q2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT p.STATUS, MIN(p.ADMIN_STATE_UP) AS min_admin_state_up, AVG(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) AS avg_standard_attr_id FROM `ports` AS p JOIN `ml2_port_bindings` AS b ON p.ID = b.PORT_ID WHERE b.VIF_TYPE = 'ovs' AND p.DEVICE_ID IN ('da811c75-0f9b-462c-b020-8ea55f6ca7c7') GROUP BY p.STATUS) SELECT i.status, COUNT(DISTINCT p2.id) AS total_ports, i.min_admin_state_up, ('da811c75-0f9b-462c-b020-8ea55f6ca7c7') GROUP BY i.status, i.min_admin_state_up, i.avg_standard_attr_id ORDER BY total_ports DESC LIMIT 10) SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT q1.PORT_ID) AS target_disjoint_workload.question: For tenant ID "98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57", for each administratively-up port on an ACTIVE network in that tenant, list the network details (network ID, name, admin_state_up, MTU, standard attribute updated_at, the row number of the network within the tenant ordered by network name, and the network’s MTU deviation from the tenant’s average MTU across those ACTIVE networks) together with the port details (port ID, host, VIF/VNIC type, MAC address, status, device owner, the windowed average standard attribute ID over 2 preceding and 2 following rows within each VIF type, the total ports per VIF type, and the deviation of that windowed average from the overall average windowed average across all returned ports). owa.overall_avg_window_column) AS deviation_from_overall_window_avg FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN VifTypeCounts AS vtc ON i.VIF_TYPE = vtc.VIF_TYPE CROSS JOIN OverallWindowAvg AS owa) SELECT n.network_id, n.network_name, n.tenant_id, n.admin_state_up AS network_admin_state_up, n.mtu, n.standard_attr_updated_at, n.window_column AS network_row_number_within_tenant, n.deviation_from_avg_mtu, p.PORT_ID, p.HOST, p.VIF_TYPE, p.VNIC_TYPE, p.MAC_ADDRESS, p.STATUS AS port_status, p.DEVICE_OWNER, p.window_column AS port_windowed_avg_standard_attr_id, p.ports_in_vif_type, p.deviation_from_overall_window_avg FROM networks_subq AS n JOIN ports_subq AS p ON p.NETWORK_ID = n.network_id AND p.TENANT_ID = n.tenant_id

target_disjoint_workload.question: For tenant ID "98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57", show the rollup summary of ACTIVE networks grouped by admin_state_up (including subtotals and a grand total) with the number of networks and the latest standard attribute updated_at timestamp, alongside the rollup summary of shared-to-public ('access_as_shared' to target tenant '*') subnets grouped by subnet name and gateway IP (including subtotals and a grand total) showing the maximum IP version (only where it is greater than 3) and the number of groups. target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH q1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT n.ID AS network_id, n.NAME AS network_name, n.TENANT_ID AS tenant_id, n.ADMIN_STATE_UP AS admin_state_up, n.MTU AS mtu, sa.UPDATED_AT AS standard_attr_updated_at, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.TENANT_ID ORDER BY n.NAME) AS window_column FROM `networks` AS n JOIN `standardattributes` AS sa ON sa.ID = n.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE n.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND n.TENANT_ID IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57')) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(admin_state_up) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE CAST(admin_state_up AS CHAR) END AS admin_state_up, COUNT(DISTINCT network_id) AS total_networks, MAX(standard_attr_updated_at) AS max_standard_attr_updated_at FROM inner_cte GROUP BY admin_state_up WITH ROLLUP), q2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT s.name, MAX(s.ip_version) AS max_ip_version, s.gateway_ip FROM `networkrbacs` AS n JOIN `subnets` AS s ON n.object_id = s.network_id WHERE n.action = 'access_as_shared' AND n.target_tenant = '*' GROUP BY s.name, s.gateway_ip HAVING MAX(s.ip_version) > 3) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(name) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE name END AS name, CASE WHEN GROUPING(gateway_ip) = 1 AND GROUPING(name) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(gateway_ip) = 1 AND GROUPING(name) = 1 THEN 'ALL' ELSE gateway_ip END AS gateway_ip, MAX(max_ip_version) AS max_ip_version, COUNT(*) AS total_groups FROM inner_cte GROUP BY name, gateway_ip WITH ROLLUP) SELECT q1.admin_state_up, q1.total_networks, q1.max_standard_attr_updated_at, q2.name AS subnet_name, q2.gateway_ip, q2.max_ip_version, q2.total_groups FROM q1 CROSS JOIN q2 ORDER BY q1.admin_state_up, q2.name, q2.gateway_ip

target_disjoint_workload.question: For default external networks (IS_DEFAULT = 0), identify the top 10 tenants by how many of their networks have an RBAC action of 'access_as_external', and for each of those tenants show: the tenant ID, the total number of qualifying networks, whether any of those networks have a targeted RBAC entry (TARGET_TENANT is not '*'), and a breakdown of how many default external networks they have in each network status after excluding networks shared via RBAC (action = 'access_as_shared' with TARGET_TENANT = '*' or '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b'). target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH TopTenantsExternalAccess AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT n.NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY r.ACTION ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column FROM `networks` AS n ON n.name = i.name JOIN `externalnetworks` AS e ON e.network_id = n.id JOIN `networkrbacs` AS r ON r.object_id = n.id WHERE e.is_default = 0 AND r.action = 'access_as_external' GROUP BY n.tenant_id ORDER BY total_qualifying_networks DESC LIMIT 10), TenantStatusRollup AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT e.NETWORK_ID, e.IS_DEFAULT, n.TENANT_ID, n.NAME, n.STATUS, n.ADMIN_STATE_UP, n.MTU, n.STANDARD_ATTR_ID, MIN(n.MTU) OVER (PARTITION BY n.TENANT_ID ORDER BY n.TENANT_ID) AS window_column FROM `externalnetworks` AS e JOIN `networks` AS n ON e.NETWORK_ID = n.ID WHERE e.IS_DEFAULT = 0 AND NOT n.ID IN (SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM `networkrbacs` WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b'))), TenantStatusCounts AS (SELECT i.tenant_id, i.status, COUNT(DISTINCT i.network_id) AS total_networks FROM inner_cte AS i GROUP BY i.tenant_id, i.status) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(tenant_id) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE tenant_id END AS tenant_id, CASE WHEN GROUPING(status) = 1 AND GROUPING(tenant_id) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' ELSE status END AS status, SUM(total_networks) AS total_networks FROM TenantStatusCounts GROUP BY tenant_id, status WITH ROLLUP) SELECT t.tenant_id, t.total_qualifying_networks, t.has_targeted_rbac, r.status, r.total_networks FROM TopTenantsExternalAccess AS t JOIN TenantStatusRollup AS r ON r.tenant_id = t.tenant_id WHERE r.status <> 'SUBTOTAL' AND r.tenant_id <> 'GRAND TOTAL' ORDER BY t.total_qualifying_networks DESC, r.status

target_disjoint_workload.question: For each RBAC action (including subtotals per action and a grand total), show whether the counted ACTIVE, non-shared networks are External or Internal and the number of such networks, along with the subnet IP-version statistics (average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP)) computed for the “access_as_shared” RBAC action on IPv4 subnets; also compute the share of each External/Internal count within its action total.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH q1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT n.name, n.status, n.admin_state_up, r.action, r.target_tenant, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.id ORDER BY n.id) AS window_column FROM `networkrbacs` WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b'))), ActionExternalSummary AS n.status = i.status AND n.admin_state_up = i.admin_state_up LEFT JOIN `externalnetworks` AS en ON n.id = en.network_id GROUP BY i.action, external_status) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(action) = 1 THEN FROM ActionExternalSummary GROUP BY action, external_status WITH ROLLUP), q2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT n.ACTION, AVG(s.IP_VERSION) AS avg_ip_version, VARIANCE(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_variance, ip_version_variance DESC) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(action) OVER (ORDER BY action_sort, action) = action THEN NULL ELSE action END AS action, avg_ip_version, ip_version_variance, ip_version_stddev FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.action) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE i.action END AS action_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.action) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE i.action END AS action, AVG(i.avg_ip_version) AS avg_ip_version, AVG(i.ip_version_variance) AS ip_version_variance, AVG(i.ip_version_stddev) AS ip_version_stddev FROM inner_cte AS i GROUP BY i.action WITH ROLLUP) AS tbltmp ORDER BY action_sort) SELECT q1.action, q1.external_status, q1.total_rows, q2.avg_ip_version, q2.ip_version_variance, q2.ip_version_stddev, ROUND(q1.total_rows / NULLIF(SUM(q1.total_rows) OVER (PARTITION BY q1.action), 0), 4) AS pct_of_action_total FROM q1 LEFT JOIN q2 ON q2.action = q1.action ORDER BY CASE WHEN q1.action = 'GRAND TOTAL' THEN 2 ELSE 1 END, q1.action, CASE WHEN q1.external_status = 'SUBTOTAL' THEN 2 ELSE 1 END, q1.external_status

target_disjoint_workload.question: For networks that are marked as default external networks (IS_DEFAULT = 0) and have the RBAC permission action set to 'access_as_external', list the (non-repeated) network name, its dense rank (ordered by the RBAC action using a window frame of the current row and the 2 preceding rows), the RBAC tenant ID and target tenant, the total number of matching networks, the average number of matching networks per tenant, and the ratio of total matching networks to the average per tenant (rounded to 2 decimals).
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH sq1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT n.NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY r.ACTION ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column FROM `externalnetworks` AS e JOIN `networks` AS n ON e.NETWORK_ID = n.ID JOIN `networkrbacs` AS r ON n.ID = r.OBJECT_ID WHERE e.IS_DEFAULT = 0 AND r.ACTION = 'access_as_external') SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(inner_cte.NAME) OVER inner_cte JOIN `networks` AS n ON n.NAME = inner_cte.NAME JOIN `networkrbacs` AS r ON r.OBJECT_ID = n.ID AND r.ACTION = 'access_as_external' ORDER BY inner_cte.NAME, r.TENANT_ID), sq2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT n.NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY r.ACTION ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column FROM `externalnetworks` AS e JOIN `networks` AS n ON e.NETWORK_ID = n.ID JOIN `networkrbacs` AS r ON n.ID = r.OBJECT_ID WHERE e.IS_DEFAULT = 0 AND r.ACTION = 'access_as_external'), tenant_counts AS (SELECT n.TENANT_ID, COUNT(*) AS tenant_network_count FROM `externalnetworks` AS e JOIN `networks` AS n ON e.NETWORK_ID = n.ID JOIN `networkrbacs` AS r ON n.ID = r.OBJECT_ID WHERE e.IS_DEFAULT = 0 AND r.ACTION = 'access_as_external' GROUP BY n.TENANT_ID), avg_counts AS (SELECT AVG(tenant_network_count) AS avg_networks_per_tenant FROM tenant_counts) SELECT inner_cte.NAME, inner_cte.window_column, totals.total_matching_networks, target_disjoint_workload.question: Among the top 10 tenants with the highest number of ACTIVE networks that have an RBAC rule with action 'access_as_shared', show each tenant's ID, the total number of such networks, and whether any of those networks are shared to at least one specific target tenant (i.e., TARGET_TENANT is not '*'). target_disjoint_workload.question: For subnets whose network is shared via RBAC with target tenant `1ee6b5b4fe8c45cfa16c3ecdbb8ee02b`, and considering only IPv4 subnets on networks that are not shared to `*` or to tenant `9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b`, return the subnet name, CIDR, RBAC target tenant, the running sum of standard attribute IDs within each IP version group, and the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of DNS nameserver order values; include only subnets where the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) is greater than 0. target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH SubnetDNSOrderVariation AS (SELECT s.name AS subnet_name, STDDEV(d.`order`) / NULLIF(AVG(d.`order`), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM `subnets` AS s JOIN `dnsnameservers` AS d ON d.subnet_id = s.id JOIN `ipallocationpools` AS p ON p.subnet_id = s.id JOIN `networks` AS n ON n.id = s.network_id WHERE s.ip_version = 4 AND NOT n.id IN (SELECT r.object_id FROM `networkrbacs` AS r WHERE r.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (r.target_tenant = '*' OR r.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b')) GROUP BY s.name HAVING AVG(d.`order`) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC), SharedSubnetWindowedAttrs AS (SELECT s.NAME AS subnet_name, s.CIDR AS subnet_cidr, n.TARGET_TENANT AS rbac_target_tenant, SUM(s.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER (PARTITION BY s.IP_VERSION ORDER BY s.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) AS window_column FROM `subnets` AS s JOIN `networkrbacs` AS n ON n.OBJECT_ID = s.NETWORK_ID WHERE n.ACTION = 'access_as_shared' AND n.TARGET_TENANT IN ('1ee6b5b4fe8c45cfa16c3ecdbb8ee02b')) SELECT sswa.subnet_name, sswa.subnet_cidr, sswa.rbac_target_tenant, sswa.window_column, sdo.coefficient_of_variation FROM SharedSubnetWindowedAttrs AS sswa JOIN SubnetDNSOrderVariation AS sdo ON sswa.subnet_name = sdo.subnet_name WHERE sdo.coefficient_of_variation > 0 ORDER BY sdo.coefficient_of_variation DESC

target_disjoint_workload.question: For each RBAC action that (1) has more than 5 matching DHCP-enabled subnets and (2) is not associated with shared networks (networks having an `access_as_shared` RBAC entry targeting `'*'` or `9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b`), show the action name along with the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of subnet IP versions; additionally, for the `access_as_shared` action, also display the average, range (max minus min), and variance of subnet IP versions (restricted to IP versions 4 and 6), and order results by the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) descending.
