target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH subq1 AS (SELECT n.ACTION, STDDEV(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_stddev FROM `networkrbacs` AS n JOIN `subnets` AS s ON n.OBJECT_ID = s.NETWORK_ID WHERE s.ENABLE_DHCP = 1 AND NOT s.NETWORK_ID IN (SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM `networkrbacs` WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b')) GROUP BY n.ACTION HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY ip_version_stddev DESC), subq2 AS (SELECT n.ACTION AS rbac_action, AVG(s.IP_VERSION) AS avg_ip_version, MAX(s.IP_VERSION) - MIN(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_range, VARIANCE(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_variance FROM `networkrbacs` AS n JOIN `subnets` AS s ON n.OBJECT_ID = s.NETWORK_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION IN (4, 6) AND n.ACTION = 'access_as_shared' GROUP BY n.ACTION ORDER BY ip_version_range DESC) SELECT subq1.ACTION AS action, subq1.ip_version_stddev, subq2.avg_ip_version, subq2.ip_version_range, subq2.ip_version_variance FROM subq1 JOIN subq2 ON subq1.ACTION = subq2.rbac_action ORDER BY subq1.ip_version_stddev DESC

target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT n.STATUS AS network_status, VARIANCE(nsb.PORT_SECURITY_ENABLED) AS port_security_enabled_variance, STDDEV(nsb.PORT_SECURITY_ENABLED) AS port_security_enabled_stddev FROM `networks` AS n JOIN `networksecuritybindings` AS nsb ON n.ID = nsb.NETWORK_ID WHERE NOT n.ID IN (SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM `networkrbacs` WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b')) GROUP BY n.STATUS ORDER BY port_security_enabled_variance DESC) SELECT n.STATUS AS network_status, COUNT(DISTINCT n.ID) AS total_networks_with_security_binding, inner_cte.port_security_enabled_variance, inner_cte.port_security_enabled_stddev FROM `networks` AS n JOIN `networksecuritybindings` AS nsb ON n.ID = nsb.NETWORK_ID JOIN inner_cte ON n.STATUS = inner_cte.network_status WHERE NOT n.ID IN (SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM `networkrbacs` WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b')) GROUP BY n.STATUS, inner_cte.port_security_enabled_variance, inner_cte.port_security_enabled_stddev ORDER BY total_networks_with_security_binding DESC LIMIT 10

target_disjoint_workload.question: For each network status, show the status, the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the security group binding order (PORT_SECURITY_ENABLED) across non-shared networks that have at least one security binding, and also include the deviation of each status’s variance from the overall average variance across all such statuses. Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT n.STATUS AS network_status, VARIANCE(nsb.PORT_SECURITY_ENABLED) AS port_security_enabled_variance, STDDEV(nsb.PORT_SECURITY_ENABLED) AS port_security_enabled_stddev FROM `networks` AS n JOIN `networksecuritybindings` AS nsb ON n.ID = nsb.NETWORK_ID WHERE NOT n.ID IN (SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM `networkrbacs` WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b')) GROUP BY n.STATUS ORDER BY port_security_enabled_variance DESC), avg_cte AS (SELECT AVG(port_security_enabled_variance) AS avg_variance FROM inner_cte) SELECT i.network_status, i.port_security_enabled_variance, i.port_security_enabled_stddev, (i.port_security_enabled_variance - a.avg_variance) AS deviation_from_avg_variance FROM inner_cte AS i CROSS JOIN avg_cte AS a

target_disjoint_workload.question: Using the per-network-status security/port statistics query as a base, also break results out by whether the network is “External” (has a row in EXTERNALNETWORKS) or “Internal” (otherwise). For each (network status, external status) combination, return the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of PORT_SECURITY_ENABLED across networks with at least one security binding, the total number of ports (restricted to STANDARDATTRIBUTES where RESOURCE_TYPE = 'ports'), and include subtotals per network status plus a grand total. Keep the device-owner port counts and earliest standard-attribute UPDATED_AT (for the matching port status) in the output as well. Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH NetworkSecurityStats AS (SELECT n.STATUS AS network_status, VARIANCE(nsb.PORT_SECURITY_ENABLED) AS port_security_enabled_variance, STDDEV(nsb.PORT_SECURITY_ENABLED) AS port_security_enabled_stddev FROM `networks` AS n JOIN `networksecuritybindings` AS nsb ON n.ID = nsb.NETWORK_ID GROUP BY n.STATUS ORDER BY port_security_enabled_variance DESC), PortOwnerStats AS (SELECT p.STATUS AS port_status, p.DEVICE_OWNER AS device_owner, COUNT(p.ID) AS port_count, MIN(sa.UPDATED_AT) AS earliest_standard_attr_update FROM `ports` AS p JOIN `standardattributes` AS sa ON sa.ID = p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE sa.RESOURCE_TYPE = 'ports' GROUP BY p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER), NetworkPortCountsByStatus AS (SELECT n.STATUS AS network_status, COUNT(p.ID) AS total_ports_in_status FROM `networks` AS n JOIN `ports` AS p ON p.NETWORK_ID = n.ID JOIN `standardattributes` AS sa ON sa.ID = p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE sa.RESOURCE_TYPE = 'ports' GROUP BY n.STATUS) SELECT nss.network_status, nss.port_security_enabled_variance, nss.port_security_enabled_stddev, npc.total_ports_in_status, pos.port_status, pos.device_owner, pos.port_count, pos.earliest_standard_attr_update FROM NetworkSecurityStats AS nss JOIN NetworkPortCountsByStatus AS npc ON nss.network_status = npc.network_status JOIN PortOwnerStats AS pos ON pos.port_status = nss.network_status ORDER BY npc.total_ports_in_status DESC, nss.port_security_enabled_variance DESC, pos.port_count DESC) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.network_status) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE i.network_status END AS network_status, CASE WHEN GROUPING(external_status) = 1 AND GROUPING(i.network_status) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(external_status) = 1 AND GROUPING(i.network_status) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' ELSE external_status END AS external_status, SUM(i.port_security_enabled_variance) AS sum_port_security_enabled_variance, SUM(i.port_security_enabled_stddev) AS sum_port_security_enabled_stddev, SUM(i.total_ports_in_status) AS sum_total_ports_in_status, i.port_status, i.device_owner, SUM(i.port_count) AS port_count, MIN(i.earliest_standard_attr_update) AS earliest_standard_attr_update FROM (SELECT inner_cte.*, CASE WHEN NOT en.network_id IS NULL THEN 'External' ELSE 'Internal' END AS external_status FROM inner_cte JOIN `networks` AS n ON n.STATUS = inner_cte.network_status LEFT JOIN `externalnetworks` AS en ON en.NETWORK_ID = n.ID) AS i GROUP BY i.network_status, external_status, i.port_status, i.device_owner WITH ROLLUP

target_disjoint_workload.question: Using the same exclusions for shared networks (i.e., networks with an RBAC entry where action = 'access_as_shared' and target_tenant is '*' or '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b'), take the combined result set that reports (1) per network status the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of PORT_SECURITY_ENABLED across networks that have at least one security binding, and (2) per port status and device owner (restricted to standard attributes with resource_type = 'ports') the number of ports and the earliest standard attribute updated timestamp. Then, for each network status, return the maximum port_count observed across the combined rows. Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH NetworkStatusSecurityStats AS (SELECT n.STATUS AS network_status, VARIANCE(nsb.PORT_SECURITY_ENABLED) AS port_security_enabled_variance, STDDEV(nsb.PORT_SECURITY_ENABLED) AS port_security_enabled_stddev FROM `networks` AS n JOIN `networksecuritybindings` AS nsb ON n.ID = nsb.NETWORK_ID WHERE NOT n.ID IN (SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM `networkrbacs` WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b')) GROUP BY n.STATUS ORDER BY port_security_enabled_variance DESC), PortStatusOwnerStats AS (SELECT p.STATUS AS port_status, p.DEVICE_OWNER AS device_owner, COUNT(p.ID) AS port_count, MIN(sa.UPDATED_AT) AS earliest_standard_attr_update FROM `ports` AS p JOIN `standardattributes` AS sa ON sa.ID = p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE sa.RESOURCE_TYPE = 'ports' AND NOT p.NETWORK_ID IN (SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM `networkrbacs` WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b')) GROUP BY p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER) SELECT nsss.network_status, nsss.port_security_enabled_variance, nsss.port_security_enabled_stddev, pss.port_status, pss.device_owner, pss.port_count, pss.earliest_standard_attr_update FROM NetworkStatusSecurityStats AS nsss CROSS JOIN PortStatusOwnerStats AS pss) SELECT network_status, MAX(port_count) AS max_port_count_across_port_groups FROM inner_cte GROUP BY network_status

target_disjoint_workload.question: For each network status (excluding shared networks where RBAC action = 'access_as_shared' and target tenant is '*' or '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b'), show the status, the number of ACTIVE networks in that status, the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of PORT_SECURITY_ENABLED across networks that have at least one security binding, the overall average of those variances across statuses as a benchmark, and categorize each status as 'HIGH_VARIANCE' (at least 50% above the benchmark), 'LOW_VARIANCE' (at least 50% below the benchmark), or 'AVERAGE_VARIANCE'. Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH NetworkStatusSecurityStats AS (SELECT n.STATUS AS network_status, VARIANCE(nsb.PORT_SECURITY_ENABLED) AS port_security_enabled_variance, STDDEV(nsb.PORT_SECURITY_ENABLED) AS port_security_enabled_stddev FROM `networks` AS n JOIN `networksecuritybindings` AS nsb ON n.ID = nsb.NETWORK_ID WHERE NOT n.ID IN (SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM `networkrbacs` WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b')) GROUP BY n.STATUS ORDER BY port_security_enabled_variance DESC), ActiveNetworkRbacDetails AS (SELECT n.name, n.status, n.admin_state_up, r.action, r.target_tenant, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.id ORDER BY n.id) AS window_column FROM `networksecuritybindings` AS b JOIN `networks` AS n ON b.network_id = n.id JOIN `networkrbacs` AS r ON n.id = r.object_id WHERE n.status = 'ACTIVE' AND NOT n.id IN (SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM `networkrbacs` WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b'))), ActiveNetworkCountsByStatus AS (SELECT status AS network_status, COUNT(DISTINCT name) AS active_network_count FROM ActiveNetworkRbacDetails GROUP BY status) SELECT nsss.network_status, anc.active_network_count, nsss.port_security_enabled_variance, nsss.port_security_enabled_stddev FROM NetworkStatusSecurityStats AS nsss JOIN ActiveNetworkCountsByStatus AS anc ON nsss.network_status = anc.network_status ORDER BY anc.active_network_count DESC, nsss.port_security_enabled_variance DESC), VarianceBenchmark AS (SELECT AVG(port_security_enabled_variance) AS avg_variance_benchmark FROM inner_cte) SELECT i.network_status, i.active_network_count, i.port_security_enabled_variance, i.port_security_enabled_stddev, vb.avg_variance_benchmark AS benchmark, CASE WHEN i.port_security_enabled_variance > vb.avg_variance_benchmark * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_VARIANCE' WHEN i.port_security_enabled_variance < vb.avg_variance_benchmark * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_VARIANCE' ELSE 'AVERAGE_VARIANCE' END AS variance_category FROM inner_cte AS i CROSS JOIN VarianceBenchmark AS vb ORDER BY i.active_network_count DESC, i.port_security_enabled_variance DESC

target_disjoint_workload.question: For each (non-shared) network status, show the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of PORT_SECURITY_ENABLED across networks with at least one security binding, the number of RBAC rows for ACTIVE (non-shared) networks in that same status, and also include the average of those ACTIVE-network RBAC row counts across all statuses. Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH network_status_security_stats AS (SELECT n.STATUS AS network_status, VARIANCE(nsb.PORT_SECURITY_ENABLED) AS port_security_enabled_variance, STDDEV(nsb.PORT_SECURITY_ENABLED) AS port_security_enabled_stddev FROM `networks` AS n JOIN `networksecuritybindings` AS nsb ON n.ID = nsb.NETWORK_ID WHERE NOT n.ID IN (SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM `networkrbacs` WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b')) GROUP BY n.STATUS ORDER BY port_security_enabled_variance DESC), active_network_rbac_details AS (SELECT n.name, n.status, n.admin_state_up, r.action, r.target_tenant, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.id ORDER BY n.id) AS window_column FROM `networksecuritybindings` AS b JOIN `networks` AS n ON b.network_id = n.id JOIN `networkrbacs` AS r ON n.id = r.object_id WHERE n.status = 'ACTIVE' AND NOT n.id IN (SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM `networkrbacs` WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b'))), active_network_rbac_summary AS (SELECT status AS network_status, COUNT(*) AS active_network_rbac_row_count FROM active_network_rbac_details GROUP BY status) SELECT nsss.network_status, nsss.port_security_enabled_variance, nsss.port_security_enabled_stddev, anrs.active_network_rbac_row_count FROM network_status_security_stats AS nsss LEFT JOIN active_network_rbac_summary AS anrs ON anrs.network_status = nsss.network_status) SELECT i.network_status, i.port_security_enabled_variance, i.port_security_enabled_stddev, i.active_network_rbac_row_count, avg_counts.avg_active_network_rbac_row_count FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN (SELECT AVG(active_network_rbac_row_count) AS avg_active_network_rbac_row_count FROM inner_cte) AS avg_counts ON 1 = 1

target_disjoint_workload.question: For ports that (1) are bound to a security group and have admin_state_up = 1 and (2) are also in DOWN status, list the port ID, tenant ID, port name, the port’s security group binding count, the total DNS record count for the port, the deviation of that binding count from the average across all admin_state_up = 1 security-group-bound ports, and also include the port MAC address, the running sum of standard attribute ID within each security group, the tenant’s total number of DOWN ports, the average DOWN-port count across tenants as a benchmark, and the tenant category (HIGH_USER/LOW_USER/AVERAGE_USER). Do not return any rounded answers. Categorize each tenant as 'HIGH_USER' (at least 50% more than average), 'LOW_USER' (at least 50% less than average), or 'AVERAGE_USER'.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH sg_admin_ports AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.tenant_id, p.name AS port_name, COUNT(sgpb.security_group_id) AS security_group_binding_count, SUM(CASE WHEN pd.port_id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) AS dns_record_count FROM `securitygroupportbindings` AS sgpb JOIN `ports` AS p ON sgpb.port_id = p.id LEFT JOIN `portdnses` AS pd ON p.id = pd.port_id WHERE p.admin_state_up = 1 GROUP BY p.id, p.tenant_id, p.name), avg_cte AS (SELECT AVG(security_group_binding_count) AS avg_sg_binding_count FROM inner_cte) SELECT i.port_id, i.tenant_id, i.port_name, i.security_group_binding_count, i.dns_record_count, (i.security_group_binding_count - a.avg_sg_binding_count) AS deviation_from_avg_sg_binding_count FROM inner_cte AS i CROSS JOIN avg_cte AS a), down_ports_by_sg AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT p.ID AS port_id, p.TENANT_ID AS tenant_id, p.MAC_ADDRESS AS mac_address, SUM(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER (PARTITION BY sgpb.SECURITY_GROUP_ID ORDER BY p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) AS window_column FROM `securitygroupportbindings` AS sgpb JOIN `ports` AS p ON sgpb.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN `portsecuritybindings` AS psb ON p.ID = psb.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN'), TenantDownPorts AS (SELECT tenant_id, COUNT(DISTINCT port_id) AS total_down_ports FROM inner_cte GROUP BY tenant_id), AverageDownPorts AS (SELECT AVG(total_down_ports) AS avg_down_ports FROM TenantDownPorts) SELECT i.port_id, i.tenant_id, i.mac_address, i.window_column, tdp.total_down_ports, adp.avg_down_ports AS benchmark, CASE WHEN tdp.total_down_ports > adp.avg_down_ports * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_USER' WHEN tdp.total_down_ports < adp.avg_down_ports * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_USER' ELSE 'AVERAGE_USER' END AS user_category FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN TenantDownPorts AS tdp ON i.tenant_id = tdp.tenant_id CROSS JOIN AverageDownPorts AS adp) SELECT sap.port_id, sap.tenant_id, sap.port_name, sap.security_group_binding_count, sap.dns_record_count, sap.deviation_from_avg_sg_binding_count, dps.mac_address, dps.window_column, dps.total_down_ports, dps.benchmark, dps.user_category FROM sg_admin_ports AS sap JOIN down_ports_by_sg AS dps ON sap.port_id = dps.port_id AND sap.tenant_id = dps.tenant_id

target_disjoint_workload.question: For tenant ID '98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57' and ports that are administratively up, list each port’s ID and tenant ID along with two stacked “signals”: (1) a DNS signal showing the port’s DNS record count versus the overall average and its DNS category (HIGH_DNS/LOW_DNS/AVERAGE_DNS) for ports bound to a security group, and (2) an IP signal showing the port’s IP allocation count versus the overall average and its IP usage category (HIGH_IP/LOW_IP/AVERAGE_IP) for ports with at least one IP allocation. Do not return any rounded answers. Categorize each port as 'HIGH_DNS' (at least 50% more than average), 'LOW_DNS' (at least 50% less than average), or 'AVERAGE_DNS'.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH DnsPerPort AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.tenant_id, p.name AS port_name, COUNT(sgpb.security_group_id) AS security_group_binding_count, SUM(CASE WHEN pd.port_id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) AS dns_record_count FROM `securitygroupportbindings` AS sgpb JOIN `ports` AS p ON sgpb.port_id = p.id LEFT JOIN `portdnses` AS pd ON p.id = pd.port_id WHERE p.admin_state_up = 1 AND p.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') GROUP BY p.id, p.tenant_id, p.name), AverageDns AS (SELECT AVG(dns_record_count) AS avg_dns_records FROM inner_cte) SELECT ic.port_id, ic.tenant_id, ic.port_name, ic.security_group_binding_count, ic.dns_record_count, ad.avg_dns_records AS benchmark, CASE WHEN ic.dns_record_count > ad.avg_dns_records * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_DNS' WHEN ic.dns_record_count < ad.avg_dns_records * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_DNS' ELSE 'AVERAGE_DNS' END AS dns_category FROM inner_cte AS ic CROSS JOIN AverageDns AS ad), IpPerPort AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address, COUNT(ia.ip_address) AS ip_allocation_count, SUM(CASE WHEN NOT ia.subnet_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS subnet_id_rows FROM `ports` AS p JOIN `portsecuritybindings` AS psb ON psb.port_id = p.id JOIN `ipallocations` AS ia ON ia.port_id = p.id WHERE p.admin_state_up = 1 AND NOT ia.ip_address IS NULL AND p.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') GROUP BY p.id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address), AverageAllocations AS (SELECT AVG(ip_allocation_count) AS avg_ip_allocations FROM inner_cte) SELECT ic.port_id, ic.tenant_id, ic.mac_address, ic.ip_allocation_count, ic.subnet_id_rows, aa.avg_ip_allocations AS benchmark, CASE WHEN ic.ip_allocation_count > aa.avg_ip_allocations * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_IP' WHEN ic.ip_allocation_count < aa.avg_ip_allocations * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_IP' ELSE 'AVERAGE_IP' END AS ip_usage_category FROM inner_cte AS ic CROSS JOIN AverageAllocations AS aa), CombinedPortSignals AS (SELECT dpp.port_id, dpp.tenant_id, 'DNS' AS signal_type, dpp.dns_category AS category, dpp.dns_record_count AS signal_count, dpp.benchmark AS benchmark FROM DnsPerPort AS dpp UNION ALL SELECT ipp.port_id, ipp.tenant_id, 'IP' AS signal_type, ipp.ip_usage_category AS category, ipp.ip_allocation_count AS signal_count, ipp.benchmark AS benchmark FROM IpPerPort AS ipp) SELECT port_id, tenant_id, signal_type, category, signal_count, benchmark FROM CombinedPortSignals ORDER BY tenant_id, port_id, signal_type

target_disjoint_workload.question: For tenant ID '98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57', for each ACTIVE network, return the network’s ID, name, admin_state_up flag, MTU, standard attribute updated_at timestamp, its row number within the tenant ordered by network name, and its MTU deviation from the average MTU; additionally, for each such network, report how many admin_state_up=1 ports on that network are bound to a security group, the average DNS record count across those ports, and how many of those ports are categorized as HIGH_DNS, LOW_DNS, or AVERAGE_DNS (relative to the tenant-wide average DNS record benchmark used for the ports). Do not return any rounded answers. Categorize each port as 'HIGH_DNS' (at least 50% more than average), 'LOW_DNS' (at least 50% less than average), or 'AVERAGE_DNS'.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH PortDnsAndSg AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.tenant_id, p.name AS port_name, COUNT(sgpb.security_group_id) AS security_group_binding_count, SUM(CASE WHEN pd.port_id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) AS dns_record_count FROM `securitygroupportbindings` AS sgpb JOIN `ports` AS p ON sgpb.port_id = p.id LEFT JOIN `portdnses` AS pd ON p.id = pd.port_id WHERE p.admin_state_up = 1 AND p.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') GROUP BY p.id, p.tenant_id, p.name), AverageDns AS (SELECT AVG(dns_record_count) AS avg_dns_records FROM inner_cte) SELECT ic.port_id, ic.tenant_id, ic.port_name, ic.security_group_binding_count, ic.dns_record_count, ad.avg_dns_records AS benchmark, CASE WHEN ic.dns_record_count > ad.avg_dns_records * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_DNS' WHEN ic.dns_record_count < ad.avg_dns_records * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_DNS' ELSE 'AVERAGE_DNS' END AS dns_category FROM inner_cte AS ic CROSS JOIN AverageDns AS ad), ActiveNetworksMtu AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT n.ID AS network_id, n.NAME AS network_name, n.TENANT_ID AS tenant_id, n.ADMIN_STATE_UP AS admin_state_up, n.MTU AS mtu, sa.UPDATED_AT AS standard_attr_updated_at, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.TENANT_ID ORDER BY n.NAME) AS window_column FROM `networks` AS n JOIN `standardattributes` AS sa ON sa.ID = n.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE n.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND n.TENANT_ID IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57')), avg_mtu_cte AS (SELECT AVG(mtu) AS avg_mtu FROM inner_cte) SELECT i.network_id, i.network_name, i.tenant_id, i.admin_state_up, i.mtu, i.standard_attr_updated_at, i.window_column, (i.mtu - a.avg_mtu) AS deviation_from_avg_mtu FROM inner_cte AS i CROSS JOIN avg_mtu_cte AS a) SELECT an.network_id, an.network_name, an.tenant_id, an.admin_state_up AS network_admin_state_up, an.mtu, an.standard_attr_updated_at, an.window_column, an.deviation_from_avg_mtu, COUNT(DISTINCT pds.port_id) AS admin_up_sg_bound_port_count, AVG(pds.dns_record_count) AS avg_dns_records_per_port, SUM(CASE WHEN pds.dns_category = 'HIGH_DNS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_dns_port_count, SUM(CASE WHEN pds.dns_category = 'LOW_DNS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS low_dns_port_count, SUM(CASE WHEN pds.dns_category = 'AVERAGE_DNS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS average_dns_port_count FROM ActiveNetworksMtu AS an JOIN `ports` AS p ON p.network_id = an.network_id AND p.tenant_id = an.tenant_id AND p.admin_state_up = 1 JOIN PortDnsAndSg AS pds ON pds.port_id = p.id AND pds.tenant_id = an.tenant_id GROUP BY an.network_id, an.network_name, an.tenant_id, an.admin_state_up, an.mtu, an.standard_attr_updated_at, an.window_column, an.deviation_from_avg_mtu ORDER BY an.tenant_id, an.network_name

target_disjoint_workload.question: For tenant ID '98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57', for each port status and DNS presence category (Has DNS vs No DNS) among security-group-bound, admin-up ports, show the port status, DNS presence, total ports (including subtotals per status and a grand total), the tenant’s total number of ACTIVE networks, and the ports-per-active-network ratio (total ports divided by total active networks, rounded to 2 decimals).

target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH q1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT b.PORT_ID, b.HOST, b.VIF_TYPE, b.VNIC_TYPE, p.TENANT_ID, p.NETWORK_ID, p.MAC_ADDRESS, p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER, AVG(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER (PARTITION BY b.VIF_TYPE ORDER BY p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM `ml2_port_bindings` AS b JOIN `ports` AS p ON b.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN `portsecuritybindings` AS psb ON p.ID = psb.PORT_ID WHERE p.ADMIN_STATE_UP = 1 AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57')), VifTypeCounts AS (SELECT VIF_TYPE, COUNT(*) AS total_ports FROM inner_cte GROUP BY VIF_TYPE), AverageVifTypePorts AS (SELECT AVG(total_ports) AS avg_ports FROM VifTypeCounts) SELECT i.PORT_ID, i.HOST, i.VIF_TYPE, i.VNIC_TYPE, i.TENANT_ID, i.NETWORK_ID, i.MAC_ADDRESS, i.STATUS, i.DEVICE_OWNER, i.window_column, vtc.total_ports, avp.avg_ports AS benchmark, CASE WHEN vtc.total_ports > avp.avg_ports * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_USER' WHEN vtc.total_ports < avp.avg_ports * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_USER' ELSE 'AVERAGE_USER' END AS user_category FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN VifTypeCounts AS vtc ON i.VIF_TYPE = vtc.VIF_TYPE CROSS JOIN AverageVifTypePorts AS avp), q2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT p.STATUS, MIN(p.ADMIN_STATE_UP) AS min_admin_state_up, AVG(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) AS avg_standard_attr_id FROM `ports` AS p JOIN `ml2_port_bindings` AS b ON p.ID = b.PORT_ID WHERE b.VIF_TYPE = 'ovs' AND p.DEVICE_ID IN ('da811c75-0f9b-462c-b020-8ea55f6ca7c7') GROUP BY p.STATUS) SELECT i.status, COUNT(DISTINCT p2.id) AS total_ports, i.min_admin_state_up, i.avg_standard_attr_id FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN `ports` AS p2 ON p2.status = i.status JOIN `ml2_port_bindings` AS b2 ON p2.id = b2.port_id WHERE b2.vif_type = 'ovs' AND p2.device_id IN ('da811c75-0f9b-462c-b020-8ea55f6ca7c7') GROUP BY i.status, i.min_admin_state_up, i.avg_standard_attr_id ORDER BY total_ports DESC LIMIT 10) SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT q1.PORT_ID) AS tenant_98333_admin_up_ports_count, COUNT(DISTINCT q2.status) AS top10_ovs_device_status_count FROM q1 CROSS JOIN q2

target_disjoint_workload.question: For DOWN ports on network ID `0a1d0a27-cffa-4de3-92c5-9d3fd3f2e74d` and DOWN ports for tenant ID `98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57`, matched by MAC address, return the network ID and tenant ID along with: the number of matched DOWN-port rows, the average deviation of each port’s windowed minimum `admin_state_up` from the overall average of that windowed minimum, the average running sum of `standard_attr_id` within each security group, the total number of DOWN ports for that tenant, and the average number of DOWN ports across all tenants. Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH subq1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT p.NAME, p.NETWORK_ID, p.MAC_ADDRESS, p.ADMIN_STATE_UP, p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER, s.SECURITY_GROUP_ID, MIN(p.ADMIN_STATE_UP) OVER (ORDER BY p.ID ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM `ports` AS p JOIN `securitygroupportbindings` AS s ON p.ID = s.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' AND p.NETWORK_ID IN ('0a1d0a27-cffa-4de3-92c5-9d3fd3f2e74d')), avg_window AS (SELECT AVG(window_column) AS avg_window_column FROM inner_cte) SELECT i.NAME, i.NETWORK_ID, i.MAC_ADDRESS, i.ADMIN_STATE_UP, i.STATUS, i.DEVICE_OWNER, i.SECURITY_GROUP_ID, i.window_column, (i.window_column - a.avg_window_column) AS deviation_from_avg_window_min FROM inner_cte AS i CROSS JOIN avg_window AS a), subq2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT p.ID AS port_id, p.TENANT_ID AS tenant_id, p.MAC_ADDRESS AS mac_address, SUM(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER (PARTITION BY sgpb.SECURITY_GROUP_ID ORDER BY p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) AS window_column FROM `securitygroupportbindings` AS sgpb JOIN `ports` AS p ON sgpb.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN `portsecuritybindings` AS psb ON p.ID = psb.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57')) SELECT inner_cte.port_id, inner_cte.tenant_id, inner_cte.mac_address, inner_cte.window_column, tenant_counts.total_down_ports_for_tenant, avg_counts.avg_down_ports_across_tenants FROM inner_cte JOIN (SELECT p.tenant_id AS tenant_id, COUNT(p.id) AS total_down_ports_for_tenant FROM `ports` AS p WHERE p.status = 'DOWN' GROUP BY p.tenant_id) AS tenant_counts ON inner_cte.tenant_id = tenant_counts.tenant_id JOIN (SELECT AVG(port_count) AS avg_down_ports_across_tenants FROM (SELECT COUNT(p.id) AS port_count FROM `ports` AS p WHERE p.status = 'DOWN' GROUP BY p.tenant_id) AS sub) AS avg_counts ON 1 = 1) SELECT subq1.NETWORK_ID, subq2.tenant_id, COUNT(*) AS joined_down_port_rows, AVG(subq1.deviation_from_avg_window_min) AS avg_deviation_from_avg_window_min, AVG(subq2.window_column) AS avg_running_sum_standard_attr_id_within_sg, MAX(subq2.total_down_ports_for_tenant) AS total_down_ports_for_tenant, MAX(subq2.avg_down_ports_across_tenants) AS avg_down_ports_across_tenants FROM subq1 JOIN subq2 ON subq1.MAC_ADDRESS = subq2.mac_address GROUP BY subq1.NETWORK_ID, subq2.tenant_id

target_disjoint_workload.question: For each VIF type among administratively up ports for tenant ID `98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57`, when restricted to networks that also have DOWN ports in network ID `0a1d0a27-cffa-4de3-92c5-9d3fd3f2e74d` whose windowed minimum admin_state_up is below the average of that windowed minimum, list the VIF type, the total number of such up ports in that VIF type, the number of distinct security group IDs on those qualifying DOWN ports, and the ratio of distinct security groups to up-port count (rounded to 2 decimals).
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH q1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT b.PORT_ID, b.HOST, b.VIF_TYPE, b.VNIC_TYPE, p.TENANT_ID, p.NETWORK_ID, p.MAC_ADDRESS, p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER, AVG(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER (PARTITION BY b.VIF_TYPE ORDER BY p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM `ml2_port_bindings` AS b JOIN `ports` AS p ON b.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN `portsecuritybindings` AS psb ON p.ID = psb.PORT_ID WHERE p.ADMIN_STATE_UP = 1 AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57')), VifTypeCounts AS (SELECT VIF_TYPE, COUNT(*) AS ports_in_vif_type FROM inner_cte GROUP BY VIF_TYPE), OverallWindowAvg AS (SELECT AVG(window_column) AS overall_avg_window_column FROM inner_cte) SELECT i.PORT_ID, i.HOST, i.VIF_TYPE, i.VNIC_TYPE, i.TENANT_ID, i.NETWORK_ID, i.MAC_ADDRESS, i.STATUS, i.DEVICE_OWNER, i.window_column, vtc.ports_in_vif_type, (i.window_column - owa.overall_avg_window_column) AS deviation_from_overall_window_avg FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN VifTypeCounts AS vtc ON i.VIF_TYPE = vtc.VIF_TYPE CROSS JOIN OverallWindowAvg AS owa), q2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT p.NAME, p.NETWORK_ID, p.MAC_ADDRESS, p.ADMIN_STATE_UP, p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER, s.SECURITY_GROUP_ID, MIN(p.ADMIN_STATE_UP) OVER (ORDER BY p.ID ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM `ports` AS p JOIN `securitygroupportbindings` AS s ON p.ID = s.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' AND p.NETWORK_ID IN ('0a1d0a27-cffa-4de3-92c5-9d3fd3f2e74d')) SELECT i.NAME, i.NETWORK_ID, i.MAC_ADDRESS, i.ADMIN_STATE_UP, i.STATUS, i.DEVICE_OWNER, i.SECURITY_GROUP_ID, i.window_column FROM inner_cte AS i WHERE i.window_column < (SELECT AVG(window_column) FROM inner_cte)) SELECT q1.VIF_TYPE, q1.ports_in_vif_type, COUNT(DISTINCT q2.SECURITY_GROUP_ID) AS distinct_security_groups_on_down_ports_in_network, ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT q2.SECURITY_GROUP_ID) / NULLIF(q1.ports_in_vif_type, 0), 2) AS security_groups_per_up_port_ratio FROM q1 JOIN q2 ON q1.NETWORK_ID = q2.NETWORK_ID GROUP BY q1.VIF_TYPE, q1.ports_in_vif_type ORDER BY security_groups_per_up_port_ratio DESC

target_disjoint_workload.question: For the top 10 tenants with the most distinct DOWN ports on network ID `0a1d0a27-cffa-4de3-92c5-9d3fd3f2e74d`, return the tenant ID, total distinct ports, whether they have any security-group-bound ports, the count of DOWN ports on that network, and the number of qualifying DOWN ports for tenant `98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57` (ports whose standard attribute ID is above that tenant’s average), but only include tenants where more than 75% of their total ports are DOWN on that network. Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH TenantPortSummary AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT p.NAME, p.NETWORK_ID, p.MAC_ADDRESS, p.ADMIN_STATE_UP, p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER, s.SECURITY_GROUP_ID, MIN(p.ADMIN_STATE_UP) OVER (ORDER BY p.ID ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM `ports` AS p JOIN `securitygroupportbindings` AS s ON p.ID = s.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' AND p.NETWORK_ID IN ('0a1d0a27-cffa-4de3-92c5-9d3fd3f2e74d')) SELECT p.tenant_id, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS total_ports, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT inner_cte.security_group_id) > 0 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_security_groups FROM `ports` AS p LEFT JOIN inner_cte ON p.network_id = inner_cte.network_id AND p.mac_address = inner_cte.mac_address GROUP BY p.tenant_id ORDER BY total_ports DESC LIMIT 10), TenantDownPortWindowed AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT p.ID AS port_id, p.TENANT_ID AS tenant_id, p.MAC_ADDRESS AS mac_address, SUM(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER (PARTITION BY sgpb.SECURITY_GROUP_ID ORDER BY p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) AS window_column FROM `securitygroupportbindings` AS sgpb JOIN `ports` AS p ON sgpb.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN `portsecuritybindings` AS psb ON p.ID = psb.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57')), TenantAvg AS (SELECT p.TENANT_ID AS tenant_id, AVG(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) AS avg_standard_attr_id FROM `ports` AS p WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') GROUP BY p.TENANT_ID) SELECT i.port_id, i.tenant_id, i.mac_address, i.window_column FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN `ports` AS p2 ON p2.ID = i.port_id JOIN TenantAvg AS ta ON ta.tenant_id = i.tenant_id WHERE p2.STANDARD_ATTR_ID > ta.avg_standard_attr_id), TenantDownPortCounts AS (SELECT p.tenant_id, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS down_ports_in_network FROM `ports` AS p WHERE p.status = 'DOWN' AND p.network_id IN ('0a1d0a27-cffa-4de3-92c5-9d3fd3f2e74d') GROUP BY p.tenant_id) SELECT tps.tenant_id, tps.total_ports, tps.has_security_groups, tdc.down_ports_in_network, COUNT(DISTINCT tdpw.port_id) AS qualifying_down_ports_for_tenant_98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57 FROM TenantPortSummary AS tps JOIN TenantDownPortCounts AS tdc ON tps.tenant_id = tdc.tenant_id LEFT JOIN TenantDownPortWindowed AS tdpw ON tps.tenant_id = tdpw.tenant_id WHERE (tdc.down_ports_in_network * 1.0 / NULLIF(tps.total_ports, 0)) > 0.75 GROUP BY tps.tenant_id, tps.total_ports, tps.has_security_groups, tdc.down_ports_in_network ORDER BY tps.total_ports DESC

target_disjoint_workload.question: For DOWN ports on network ID '0a1d0a27-cffa-4de3-92c5-9d3fd3f2e74d', list the port name, (non-repeated) network ID, MAC address, admin state, status, device owner, bound security group ID, the windowed minimum admin_state_up (3 preceding to 1 following ordered by port ID), and the subtotal count of matching ports per network; additionally, for any of these rows whose MAC address matches a DOWN port owned by tenant '17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7' with a running sum of standard attribute IDs (partitioned by resource type and ordered by standard attribute ID) greater than 1000, also show that port’s ID, tenant ID, and the running-sum value. Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH q1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT p.ID AS port_id, p.TENANT_ID AS tenant_id, p.MAC_ADDRESS AS mac_address, SUM(sa.ID) OVER (PARTITION BY sa.RESOURCE_TYPE ORDER BY sa.ID) AS window_column FROM `ports` AS p JOIN `standardattributes` AS sa ON sa.ID = p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7')) SELECT port_id, tenant_id, mac_address, window_column FROM inner_cte WHERE window_column > 1000), q2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT p.NAME, p.NETWORK_ID, p.MAC_ADDRESS, p.ADMIN_STATE_UP, p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER, s.SECURITY_GROUP_ID, MIN(p.ADMIN_STATE_UP) OVER (ORDER BY p.ID ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM `ports` AS p JOIN `securitygroupportbindings` AS s ON p.ID = s.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' AND p.NETWORK_ID IN ('0a1d0a27-cffa-4de3-92c5-9d3fd3f2e74d')) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(network_id) OVER (ORDER BY network_id_sort, network_id, name, mac_address, security_group_id) = network_id THEN NULL ELSE network_id END AS network_id, name, mac_address, admin_state_up, status, device_owner, security_group_id, window_column, total_ports FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.network_id) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE i.network_id END AS network_id_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.network_id) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE i.network_id END AS network_id, i.name, i.mac_address, i.admin_state_up, i.status, i.device_owner, i.security_group_id, i.window_column, COUNT(*) AS total_ports FROM inner_cte AS i GROUP BY i.network_id, i.name, i.mac_address, i.admin_state_up, i.status, i.device_owner, i.security_group_id, i.window_column WITH ROLLUP) AS tbltmp ORDER BY network_id_sort, network_id, name, mac_address, security_group_id) SELECT q2.network_id, q2.name, q2.mac_address, q2.admin_state_up, q2.status, q2.device_owner, q2.security_group_id, q2.window_column AS min_admin_state_window, q2.total_ports, q1.port_id, q1.tenant_id, q1.window_column AS running_sum_standard_attr_ids FROM q2 LEFT JOIN q1 ON q1.mac_address = q2.mac_address ORDER BY q2.network_id, q2.name, q2.mac_address, q2.security_group_id

target_disjoint_workload.question: For each network, using the combined list of administratively-up ports (including those with status DOWN) from the prior result set, find the network ID and the maximum of the per-port window metric (admin-up window average standard attribute ID for “Admin State Up” rows, or down-window average port ID for “Status DOWN” rows) observed among ports in that network. Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH AdminUpPorts AS (SELECT b.PORT_ID, b.HOST, b.VIF_TYPE, b.VNIC_TYPE, p.TENANT_ID, p.NETWORK_ID, p.MAC_ADDRESS, p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER, AVG(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER (PARTITION BY b.VIF_TYPE ORDER BY p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM `ml2_port_bindings` AS b JOIN `ports` AS p ON b.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN `portsecuritybindings` AS psb ON p.ID = psb.PORT_ID WHERE p.ADMIN_STATE_UP = 1), DownPortsWithIPs AS (SELECT p.ID AS port_id, p.NAME AS port_name, p.MAC_ADDRESS AS mac_address, ia.IP_ADDRESS AS ip_address, ia.SUBNET_ID AS subnet_id, AVG(p.ID) OVER (PARTITION BY p.ID ORDER BY ia.IP_ADDRESS) AS window_column FROM `ports` AS p JOIN `ipallocations` AS ia ON p.ID = ia.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' ORDER BY ia.IP_ADDRESS), CombinedPorts AS (SELECT a.PORT_ID AS port_id, a.HOST, a.VIF_TYPE, a.VNIC_TYPE, a.TENANT_ID, a.NETWORK_ID, a.MAC_ADDRESS, a.STATUS, a.DEVICE_OWNER, a.window_column AS admin_up_window_avg_standard_attr_id, NULL AS port_name, NULL AS ip_address, NULL AS subnet_id, NULL AS down_window_avg_port_id, 'Admin State Up' AS reason FROM AdminUpPorts AS a UNION ALL SELECT d.port_id, NULL AS HOST, NULL AS VIF_TYPE, NULL AS VNIC_TYPE, p.TENANT_ID, p.NETWORK_ID, d.mac_address AS MAC_ADDRESS, p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER, NULL AS admin_up_window_avg_standard_attr_id, d.port_name, d.ip_address, d.subnet_id, d.window_column AS down_window_avg_port_id, 'Status DOWN' AS reason FROM DownPortsWithIPs AS d JOIN `ports` AS p ON p.ID = d.port_id WHERE p.ADMIN_STATE_UP = 1) SELECT * FROM CombinedPorts ORDER BY port_id, reason), NetworkPortWindowMetric AS (SELECT p.network_id, p.id AS port_id, MAX(COALESCE(inner_cte.admin_up_window_avg_standard_attr_id, inner_cte.down_window_avg_port_id)) AS port_window_metric FROM inner_cte JOIN `ports` AS p ON p.id = inner_cte.port_id GROUP BY p.network_id, p.id) SELECT network_id, MAX(port_window_metric) AS max_port_window_metric FROM NetworkPortWindowMetric GROUP BY network_id

target_disjoint_workload.question: For ports that are administratively up and belong to tenant ID `98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57`, list the port ID, host, VIF type, VNIC type, tenant ID, network ID, MAC address, status, device owner, and the average standard attribute ID over a 2-preceding/2-following window (partitioned by VIF type and ordered by standard attribute ID), and also show (by matching port status) the minimum admin_state_up and average standard_attr_id for ports bound with VIF type `ovs` whose device_id is `da811c75-0f9b-462c-b020-8ea55f6ca7c7`. Do not repeat the status if it is the same as the previous row, and include a final TOTAL row across all statuses. Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH Subquery1 AS (SELECT b.PORT_ID, b.HOST, b.VIF_TYPE, b.VNIC_TYPE, p.TENANT_ID, p.NETWORK_ID, p.MAC_ADDRESS, p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER, AVG(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER (PARTITION BY b.VIF_TYPE ORDER BY p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM `ml2_port_bindings` AS b JOIN `ports` AS p ON b.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN `portsecuritybindings` AS psb ON p.ID = psb.PORT_ID WHERE p.ADMIN_STATE_UP = 1 AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57')), Subquery2 AS (SELECT p.STATUS, MIN(p.ADMIN_STATE_UP) AS min_admin_state_up, AVG(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) AS avg_standard_attr_id FROM `ports` AS p JOIN `ml2_port_bindings` AS b ON p.ID = b.PORT_ID WHERE b.VIF_TYPE = 'ovs' AND p.DEVICE_ID IN ('da811c75-0f9b-462c-b020-8ea55f6ca7c7') GROUP BY p.STATUS) SELECT s1.PORT_ID, s1.HOST, s1.VIF_TYPE, s1.VNIC_TYPE, s1.TENANT_ID, s1.NETWORK_ID, s1.MAC_ADDRESS, s1.STATUS, s1.DEVICE_OWNER, s1.window_column, s2.min_admin_state_up, s2.avg_standard_attr_id FROM Subquery1 AS s1 JOIN Subquery2 AS s2 ON s1.STATUS = s2.STATUS) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(status) OVER (ORDER BY status_sort, status, port_id) = status THEN NULL ELSE status END AS status, port_id, host, vif_type, vnic_type, tenant_id, network_id, mac_address, device_owner, window_column, min_admin_state_up, avg_standard_attr_id FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.status) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE i.status END AS status_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.status) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE i.status END AS status, i.port_id, i.host, i.vif_type, i.vnic_type, i.tenant_id, i.network_id, i.mac_address, i.device_owner, i.window_column, i.min_admin_state_up, i.avg_standard_attr_id FROM inner_cte AS i GROUP BY i.status, i.port_id, i.host, i.vif_type, i.vnic_type, i.tenant_id, i.network_id, i.mac_address, i.device_owner, i.window_column, i.min_admin_state_up, i.avg_standard_attr_id WITH ROLLUP) AS tbltmp ORDER BY status_sort, status, port_id

target_disjoint_workload.question: For each network among ports that are administratively up and belong to tenant ID `98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57`, find the network ID and the highest (maximum) value of the per-port windowed average standard attribute ID (computed over a 2-preceding/2-following window partitioned by VIF type and ordered by standard attribute ID), and also include (by matching port status) the minimum admin_state_up and average standard_attr_id for ports bound with VIF type `ovs` whose device_id is `da811c75-0f9b-462c-b020-8ea55f6ca7c7`. target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH Subquery1 AS (SELECT b.PORT_ID, b.HOST, b.VIF_TYPE, b.VNIC_TYPE, p.TENANT_ID, p.NETWORK_ID, p.MAC_ADDRESS, p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER, AVG(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER (PARTITION BY b.VIF_TYPE ORDER BY p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM `ml2_port_bindings` AS b JOIN `ports` AS p ON b.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN `portsecuritybindings` AS psb ON p.ID = psb.PORT_ID WHERE p.ADMIN_STATE_UP = 1 AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57')), Subquery2 AS (SELECT p.STATUS, MIN(p.ADMIN_STATE_UP) AS min_admin_state_up, AVG(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) AS avg_standard_attr_id FROM `ports` AS p JOIN `ml2_port_bindings` AS b ON p.ID = b.PORT_ID WHERE b.VIF_TYPE = 'ovs' AND p.DEVICE_ID IN ('da811c75-0f9b-462c-b020-8ea55f6ca7c7') GROUP BY p.STATUS) SELECT s1.PORT_ID, s1.HOST, s1.VIF_TYPE, s1.VNIC_TYPE, s1.TENANT_ID, s1.NETWORK_ID, s1.MAC_ADDRESS, s1.STATUS, s1.DEVICE_OWNER, s1.window_column, s2.min_admin_state_up, s2.avg_standard_attr_id FROM Subquery1 AS s1 JOIN Subquery2 AS s2 ON s1.STATUS = s2.STATUS) SELECT network_id, MAX(window_column) AS max_windowed_avg_standard_attr_id, MAX(min_admin_state_up) AS min_admin_state_up_for_matching_status, AVG(avg_standard_attr_id) AS avg_standard_attr_id_for_matching_status FROM inner_cte GROUP BY network_id

target_disjoint_workload.question: For each port status that appears among administratively up ports for tenant ID `98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57`, list the status, the number of distinct ports, the average of the per-port windowed average standard attribute ID (partitioned by VIF type and ordered by standard attribute ID with 2 preceding and 2 following rows), and the minimum admin_state_up value and average standard_attr_id for ports bound with VIF type `ovs` whose device_id is `da811c75-0f9b-462c-b020-8ea55f6ca7c7`, keeping only statuses where the tenant’s distinct-port count is greater than 75% of the distinct-port count for that same status in the `ovs` device subset. Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH TenantAdminUpPorts AS (SELECT b.PORT_ID, b.HOST, b.VIF_TYPE, b.VNIC_TYPE, p.TENANT_ID, p.NETWORK_ID, p.MAC_ADDRESS, p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER, AVG(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER (PARTITION BY b.VIF_TYPE ORDER BY p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM `ml2_port_bindings` AS b JOIN `ports` AS p ON b.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN `portsecuritybindings` AS psb ON p.ID = psb.PORT_ID WHERE p.ADMIN_STATE_UP = 1 AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57')), OvsDeviceStatusStats AS (SELECT p.STATUS, MIN(p.ADMIN_STATE_UP) AS min_admin_state_up, AVG(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) AS avg_standard_attr_id FROM `ports` AS p JOIN `ml2_port_bindings` AS b ON p.ID = b.PORT_ID WHERE b.VIF_TYPE = 'ovs' AND p.DEVICE_ID IN ('da811c75-0f9b-462c-b020-8ea55f6ca7c7') GROUP BY p.STATUS) SELECT tap.STATUS, COUNT(DISTINCT tap.PORT_ID) AS ports_for_tenant_admin_up, AVG(tap.window_column) AS avg_window_standard_attr_id, ods.min_admin_state_up, ods.avg_standard_attr_id FROM TenantAdminUpPorts AS tap JOIN OvsDeviceStatusStats AS ods ON tap.STATUS = ods.STATUS GROUP BY tap.STATUS, ods.min_admin_state_up, ods.avg_standard_attr_id ORDER BY ports_for_tenant_admin_up DESC) SELECT i.STATUS, i.ports_for_tenant_admin_up, i.avg_window_standard_attr_id, i.min_admin_state_up, i.avg_standard_attr_id FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN (SELECT p.STATUS, COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS ovs_device_ports_for_status FROM `ports` AS p JOIN `ml2_port_bindings` AS b ON p.ID = b.PORT_ID WHERE b.VIF_TYPE = 'ovs' AND p.DEVICE_ID IN ('da811c75-0f9b-462c-b020-8ea55f6ca7c7') GROUP BY p.STATUS) AS d ON d.STATUS = i.STATUS WHERE d.ovs_device_ports_for_status > 0 AND (i.ports_for_tenant_admin_up * 1.0 / d.ovs_device_ports_for_status) > 0.75 ORDER BY i.ports_for_tenant_admin_up DESC

target_disjoint_workload.question: For ports that are administratively up and belong to tenant ID `98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57`, list the port ID, host, VIF type, VNIC type, tenant ID, network ID, MAC address, status, device owner, and the average standard attribute ID over a 2-preceding/2-following window (partitioned by VIF type and ordered by standard attribute ID). Also, by matching port status, include the minimum admin_state_up and average standard_attr_id for ports bound with VIF type `ovs` whose device_id is `da811c75-0f9b-462c-b020-8ea55f6ca7c7`, and indicate whether each port has any floating IP allocated. Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH Subquery1 AS (SELECT b.PORT_ID, b.HOST, b.VIF_TYPE, b.VNIC_TYPE, p.TENANT_ID, p.NETWORK_ID, p.MAC_ADDRESS, p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER, AVG(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER (PARTITION BY b.VIF_TYPE ORDER BY p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM `ml2_port_bindings` AS b JOIN `ports` AS p ON b.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN `portsecuritybindings` AS psb ON p.ID = psb.PORT_ID WHERE p.ADMIN_STATE_UP = 1 AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57')), Subquery2 AS (SELECT p.STATUS, MIN(p.ADMIN_STATE_UP) AS min_admin_state_up, AVG(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) AS avg_standard_attr_id FROM `ports` AS p JOIN `ml2_port_bindings` AS b ON p.ID = b.PORT_ID WHERE b.VIF_TYPE = 'ovs' AND p.DEVICE_ID IN ('da811c75-0f9b-462c-b020-8ea55f6ca7c7') GROUP BY p.STATUS) SELECT s1.PORT_ID, s1.HOST, s1.VIF_TYPE, s1.VNIC_TYPE, s1.TENANT_ID, s1.NETWORK_ID, s1.MAC_ADDRESS, s1.STATUS, s1.DEVICE_OWNER, s1.window_column, s2.min_admin_state_up, s2.avg_standard_attr_id FROM Subquery1 AS s1 JOIN Subquery2 AS s2 ON s1.STATUS = s2.STATUS) SELECT i.PORT_ID, i.HOST, i.VIF_TYPE, i.VNIC_TYPE, i.TENANT_ID, i.NETWORK_ID, i.MAC_ADDRESS, i.STATUS, i.DEVICE_OWNER, i.window_column, i.min_admin_state_up, i.avg_standard_attr_id, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT f.ID) > 0 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_floating_ip FROM inner_cte AS i LEFT JOIN `floatingips` AS f ON i.PORT_ID = f.FIXED_PORT_ID GROUP BY i.PORT_ID, i.HOST, i.VIF_TYPE, i.VNIC_TYPE, i.TENANT_ID, i.NETWORK_ID, i.MAC_ADDRESS, i.STATUS, i.DEVICE_OWNER, i.window_column, i.min_admin_state_up, i.avg_standard_attr_id

target_disjoint_workload.question: For tenant ID '17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7', among DOWN ports on network '0a1d0a27-cffa-4de3-92c5-9d3fd3f2e74d' that are bound to a security group, list each device owner and security group ID along with the device-owner-level distinct DOWN port count and minimum standard attribute ID, include how many matching DOWN ports in that network fall under each device owner and security group, and also show the overall average of these matching DOWN-port counts across all returned device-owner/security-group rows. Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH PortStatusOwnerAgg AS (SELECT p.STATUS AS port_status, p.DEVICE_OWNER AS device_owner, COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS port_count, MIN(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) AS min_standard_attr_id FROM `ports` AS p JOIN `securitygroupportbindings` AS spb ON p.ID = spb.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') GROUP BY p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER), DownNetworkPortDetails AS (SELECT p.NAME, p.NETWORK_ID, p.MAC_ADDRESS, p.ADMIN_STATE_UP, p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER, s.SECURITY_GROUP_ID, MIN(p.ADMIN_STATE_UP) OVER (ORDER BY p.ID ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM `ports` AS p JOIN `securitygroupportbindings` AS s ON p.ID = s.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' AND p.NETWORK_ID IN ('0a1d0a27-cffa-4de3-92c5-9d3fd3f2e74d')) SELECT dnpd.DEVICE_OWNER, dnpd.SECURITY_GROUP_ID, psa.port_count, psa.min_standard_attr_id, COUNT(*) AS matching_down_ports_in_network FROM DownNetworkPortDetails AS dnpd JOIN `ports` AS p ON p.MAC_ADDRESS = dnpd.MAC_ADDRESS AND p.NETWORK_ID = dnpd.NETWORK_ID AND p.DEVICE_OWNER = dnpd.DEVICE_OWNER AND p.STATUS = dnpd.STATUS JOIN PortStatusOwnerAgg AS psa ON psa.port_status = dnpd.STATUS AND psa.device_owner = dnpd.DEVICE_OWNER WHERE p.TENANT_ID IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') GROUP BY dnpd.DEVICE_OWNER, dnpd.SECURITY_GROUP_ID, psa.port_count, psa.min_standard_attr_id ORDER BY matching_down_ports_in_network DESC, dnpd.DEVICE_OWNER, dnpd.SECURITY_GROUP_ID) SELECT inner_cte.DEVICE_OWNER, inner_cte.SECURITY_GROUP_ID, inner_cte.port_count, inner_cte.min_standard_attr_id, inner_cte.matching_down_ports_in_network, avg_stats.avg_matching_down_ports_in_network FROM inner_cte JOIN (SELECT AVG(matching_down_ports_in_network) AS avg_matching_down_ports_in_network FROM inner_cte) AS avg_stats ON 1 = 1

target_disjoint_workload.question: For each port status and device owner, considering only ports whose standard attribute resource type is 'ports' and excluding shared networks (networks whose IDs appear in networkrbacs with action = 'access_as_shared' and target_tenant = '*' or '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b'), list the port count and the earliest standard attribute updated timestamp, and also include (by port status) the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of allocated IP address string lengths for ports with port security enabled restricted to IP address '10.150.64.113/8'. Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH PortCountsAndEarliestUpdate AS (SELECT p.STATUS AS port_status, p.DEVICE_OWNER AS device_owner, COUNT(p.ID) AS port_count, MIN(sa.UPDATED_AT) AS earliest_standard_attr_update FROM `ports` AS p JOIN `standardattributes` AS sa ON sa.ID = p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE sa.RESOURCE_TYPE = 'ports' AND NOT p.NETWORK_ID IN (SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM `networkrbacs` WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b')) GROUP BY p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER), PortStatusIpLengthVariation AS (SELECT p.status, STDDEV(LENGTH(ia.ip_address)) / NULLIF(AVG(LENGTH(ia.ip_address)), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM `portsecuritybindings` AS psb JOIN `ports` AS p ON psb.port_id = p.id JOIN `ipallocations` AS ia ON p.id = ia.port_id WHERE psb.port_security_enabled = 1 AND ia.ip_address IN ('10.150.64.113/8') GROUP BY p.status HAVING AVG(LENGTH(ia.ip_address)) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC), CombinedPortStatusMetrics AS (SELECT pc.port_status AS port_status, pc.device_owner AS device_owner, pc.port_count AS port_count, pc.earliest_standard_attr_update AS earliest_standard_attr_update, pv.coefficient_of_variation AS coefficient_of_variation FROM PortCountsAndEarliestUpdate AS pc JOIN PortStatusIpLengthVariation AS pv ON pv.status = pc.port_status) SELECT port_status, device_owner, port_count, earliest_standard_attr_update, coefficient_of_variation FROM CombinedPortStatusMetrics ORDER BY port_status, device_owner

target_disjoint_workload.question: For ports on host "drive-59", list each port’s port ID, tenant ID, MAC address, running sum of standard attribute IDs within its VIF type (ordered by standard attribute ID), the total number of ports in that VIF type, and the deviation from the VIF-type average running sum; also show, for the same tenant, the tenant’s count of ports that are DOWN with port security enabled, the overall average of that count across tenants (benchmark), the tenant’s HIGH/LOW/AVERAGE user category, and the overall total number of DOWN ports with port security enabled. Do not return any rounded answers. Classify each tenant as 'HIGH_USER' (at least 50% more than average), 'LOW_USER' (at least 50% less than average), or 'AVERAGE_USER'.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH port_vif_running_sums AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT b.PORT_ID, p.TENANT_ID, p.MAC_ADDRESS, SUM(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER (PARTITION BY b.VIF_TYPE ORDER BY p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) AS window_column FROM `ml2_port_bindings` AS b JOIN `ports` AS p ON b.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN `portsecuritybindings` AS psb ON p.ID = psb.PORT_ID WHERE b.HOST = 'drive-59'), VifTypeStats AS (SELECT b.VIF_TYPE, COUNT(*) AS ports_in_vif_type, AVG(ic.window_column) AS avg_running_sum_in_vif_type FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN `ml2_port_bindings` AS b ON b.PORT_ID = ic.PORT_ID GROUP BY b.VIF_TYPE) SELECT ic.PORT_ID, ic.TENANT_ID, ic.MAC_ADDRESS, ic.window_column AS running_sum_standard_attr_id, vts.ports_in_vif_type, (ic.window_column - vts.avg_running_sum_in_vif_type) AS deviation_from_avg_running_sum_in_vif_type FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN `ml2_port_bindings` AS b ON b.PORT_ID = ic.PORT_ID JOIN VifTypeStats AS vts ON vts.VIF_TYPE = b.VIF_TYPE), tenant_down_secure_port_stats AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS down_ports_with_port_security_enabled FROM `ports` AS p JOIN `portsecuritybindings` AS psb ON p.ID = psb.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' AND psb.PORT_SECURITY_ENABLED = 1), TenantDownSecurePorts AS (SELECT p.TENANT_ID, COUNT(*) AS down_secure_ports FROM `ports` AS p JOIN `portsecuritybindings` AS psb ON p.ID = psb.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' AND psb.PORT_SECURITY_ENABLED = 1 GROUP BY p.TENANT_ID), AverageDownSecurePorts AS (SELECT AVG(down_secure_ports) AS avg_down_secure_ports FROM TenantDownSecurePorts) SELECT tdsp.TENANT_ID, tdsp.down_secure_ports, adsp.avg_down_secure_ports AS benchmark, CASE WHEN tdsp.down_secure_ports > adsp.avg_down_secure_ports * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_USER' WHEN tdsp.down_secure_ports < adsp.avg_down_secure_ports * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_USER' ELSE 'AVERAGE_USER' END AS user_category, inner_cte.down_ports_with_port_security_enabled AS overall_down_secure_ports FROM TenantDownSecurePorts AS tdsp CROSS JOIN AverageDownSecurePorts AS adsp CROSS JOIN inner_cte) SELECT pvrs.PORT_ID, pvrs.TENANT_ID, pvrs.MAC_ADDRESS, pvrs.running_sum_standard_attr_id, pvrs.ports_in_vif_type, pvrs.deviation_from_avg_running_sum_in_vif_type, tdsp.down_secure_ports, tdsp.benchmark, tdsp.user_category, tdsp.overall_down_secure_ports FROM port_vif_running_sums AS pvrs JOIN tenant_down_secure_port_stats AS tdsp ON tdsp.TENANT_ID = pvrs.TENANT_ID

target_disjoint_workload.question: For ports in status 'DOWN', list each port’s ID, tenant ID, host, VIF type, allocated IP address, and the row number ordered by IP address (using a window frame of 2 preceding rows and 1 following row). Also show, per host, the total number of DOWN-port IP allocations and each row’s deviation from the average DOWN-port IP allocations per host; and for the same tenant, include the tenant’s count of DOWN ports with port security enabled, the average of that count across tenants as a benchmark, the tenant’s usage category (HIGH_USER/LOW_USER/AVERAGE_USER), and the overall total number of DOWN ports with port security enabled. Do not return any rounded answers. Classify each tenant as 'HIGH_USER' (at least 50% more than average), 'LOW_USER' (at least 50% less than average), or 'AVERAGE_USER'.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH q1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT p.ID AS port_id, p.TENANT_ID AS tenant_id, b.HOST AS host, b.VIF_TYPE AS vif_type, ia.IP_ADDRESS AS ip_address, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ia.IP_ADDRESS ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM `ml2_port_bindings` AS b JOIN `ports` AS p ON b.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN `ipallocations` AS ia ON p.ID = ia.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN'), HostCounts AS (SELECT host, COUNT(DISTINCT ip_address) AS down_allocated_ips FROM inner_cte GROUP BY host), AverageHostCounts AS (SELECT AVG(down_allocated_ips) AS avg_down_allocated_ips FROM HostCounts) SELECT i.port_id, i.tenant_id, i.host, i.vif_type, i.ip_address, i.window_column, hc.down_allocated_ips, (hc.down_allocated_ips - ahc.avg_down_allocated_ips) AS deviation_from_avg FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN HostCounts AS hc ON i.host = hc.host CROSS JOIN AverageHostCounts AS ahc), q2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS down_ports_with_port_security_enabled FROM `ports` AS p JOIN `portsecuritybindings` AS psb ON p.ID = psb.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' AND psb.PORT_SECURITY_ENABLED = 1), TenantDownSecurePorts AS (SELECT p.TENANT_ID, COUNT(*) AS down_secure_ports FROM `ports` AS p JOIN `portsecuritybindings` AS psb ON p.ID = psb.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' AND psb.PORT_SECURITY_ENABLED = 1 GROUP BY p.TENANT_ID), AverageDownSecurePorts AS (SELECT AVG(down_secure_ports) AS avg_down_secure_ports FROM TenantDownSecurePorts) SELECT tdsp.TENANT_ID, tdsp.down_secure_ports, adsp.avg_down_secure_ports AS benchmark, CASE WHEN tdsp.down_secure_ports > adsp.avg_down_secure_ports * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_USER' WHEN tdsp.down_secure_ports < adsp.avg_down_secure_ports * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_USER' ELSE 'AVERAGE_USER' END AS user_category, inner_cte.down_ports_with_port_security_enabled AS overall_down_secure_ports FROM TenantDownSecurePorts AS tdsp CROSS JOIN AverageDownSecurePorts AS adsp CROSS JOIN inner_cte) SELECT q1.port_id, q1.tenant_id, q1.host, q1.vif_type, q1.ip_address, q1.window_column, q1.down_allocated_ips, q1.deviation_from_avg, q2.down_secure_ports, q2.benchmark AS avg_down_secure_ports_benchmark, q2.user_category, q2.overall_down_secure_ports FROM q1 JOIN q2 ON q1.tenant_id = q2.tenant_id ORDER BY q1.host, q1.ip_address

target_disjoint_workload.question: For tenant ID `17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7`, among ports on host `drive-59` whose running sum of `STANDARD_ATTR_ID` within each `VIF_TYPE` group (ordered by `STANDARD_ATTR_ID`) is greater than the overall average running sum for those ports, show each port’s ID, tenant ID, MAC address, VIF type, running sum and its overall average, plus the port’s port-security binding count, total enabled port-security flags, the average binding-count benchmark across the tenant’s administratively up ports, and the binding category (HIGH/LOW/AVERAGE). Do not return any rounded answers. Categorize each port as 'HIGH_BINDINGS' (at least 50% more than average), 'LOW_BINDINGS' (at least 50% less than average), or 'AVERAGE_BINDINGS'.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH q1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT b.PORT_ID, p.TENANT_ID, p.MAC_ADDRESS, SUM(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER (PARTITION BY b.VIF_TYPE ORDER BY p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) AS window_column FROM `ml2_port_bindings` AS b JOIN `ports` AS p ON b.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN `portsecuritybindings` AS psb ON p.ID = psb.PORT_ID WHERE b.HOST = 'drive-59' AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7')) SELECT i.PORT_ID, i.TENANT_ID, i.MAC_ADDRESS, b.VIF_TYPE, i.window_column, (SELECT AVG(window_column) FROM inner_cte) AS avg_window_column FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN `ml2_port_bindings` AS b ON i.PORT_ID = b.PORT_ID WHERE i.window_column > (SELECT AVG(window_column) FROM inner_cte)), q2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address, COUNT(psb.port_id) AS binding_count, SUM(CASE WHEN psb.port_security_enabled THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS port_security_enabled_total FROM `ports` AS p JOIN `portsecuritybindings` AS psb ON p.id = psb.port_id WHERE p.admin_state_up = 1 AND p.tenant_id IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') GROUP BY p.id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address), AverageBindings AS (SELECT AVG(binding_count) AS avg_binding_count FROM inner_cte) SELECT ic.port_id, ic.tenant_id, ic.mac_address, ic.binding_count, ic.port_security_enabled_total, ab.avg_binding_count AS benchmark, CASE WHEN ic.binding_count > ab.avg_binding_count * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_BINDINGS' WHEN ic.binding_count < ab.avg_binding_count * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_BINDINGS' ELSE 'AVERAGE_BINDINGS' END AS binding_category FROM inner_cte AS ic CROSS JOIN AverageBindings AS ab) SELECT q1.port_id, q1.tenant_id, q1.mac_address, q1.vif_type, q1.window_column AS running_standard_attr_id_sum, q1.avg_window_column AS avg_running_sum_over_filtered_ports, q2.binding_count, q2.port_security_enabled_total, q2.benchmark AS avg_binding_count_benchmark, q2.binding_category FROM q1 JOIN q2 ON q1.port_id = q2.port_id ORDER BY q1.vif_type, q1.window_column DESC, q2.binding_count DESC

target_disjoint_workload.question: For each port status (plus a final TOTAL row), show the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of allocated IP address string lengths for ports with port security enabled where the allocated IP address is '10.150.64.113/8', and also show (for the same status values) the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of port security bindings per port for ports belonging to tenant ID '17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7', along with the overall average number of port security bindings per port across that tenant’s ports. Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH q1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT p.status, STDDEV(LENGTH(ia.ip_address)) / NULLIF(AVG(LENGTH(ia.ip_address)), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM `portsecuritybindings` AS psb JOIN `ports` AS p ON psb.port_id = p.id JOIN `ipallocations` AS ia ON p.id = ia.port_id WHERE psb.port_security_enabled = 1 AND ia.ip_address IN ('10.150.64.113/8') GROUP BY p.status HAVING AVG(LENGTH(ia.ip_address)) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(status) OVER (ORDER BY status_sort, status) = status THEN NULL ELSE status END AS status, coefficient_of_variation FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(status) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE status END AS status_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(status) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE status END AS status, AVG(coefficient_of_variation) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte GROUP BY status WITH ROLLUP) AS tbltmp ORDER BY status_sort, status), q2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT p.status, MAX(ps.binding_count) - MIN(ps.binding_count) AS binding_count_range, VARIANCE(ps.binding_count) AS binding_count_variance, STDDEV(ps.binding_count) AS binding_count_stddev FROM `ports` AS p JOIN (SELECT p2.id AS port_id, COUNT(*) AS binding_count FROM `ports` AS p2 JOIN `portsecuritybindings` AS b ON p2.id = b.port_id WHERE p2.tenant_id IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') GROUP BY p2.id) AS ps ON p.id = ps.port_id GROUP BY p.status ORDER BY binding_count_range DESC) SELECT inner_cte.status, inner_cte.binding_count_range, inner_cte.binding_count_variance, inner_cte.binding_count_stddev, avg_bindings.avg_binding_count FROM inner_cte JOIN (SELECT AVG(binding_count) AS avg_binding_count FROM (SELECT p2.id AS port_id, COUNT(*) AS binding_count FROM `ports` AS p2 JOIN `portsecuritybindings` AS b ON p2.id = b.port_id WHERE p2.tenant_id IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') GROUP BY p2.id) AS sub) AS avg_bindings ON 1 = 1 ORDER BY inner_cte.binding_count_range DESC) SELECT q1.status, q1.coefficient_of_variation, q2.binding_count_range, q2.binding_count_variance, q2.binding_count_stddev, q2.avg_binding_count FROM q1 LEFT JOIN q2 ON q1.status = q2.status ORDER BY CASE WHEN q1.status = 'TOTAL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, q1.status

target_disjoint_workload.question: For each network ID that (a) has at least one administratively up port belonging to tenant `98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57` with at least one IP allocation and (b) has allocated IP address `10.150.64.113/8` on a port with port security enabled, return the network ID, the highest number of IP allocations on any single qualifying port in that network, and the maximum coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) (stddev/avg) of allocated IP address string lengths across port statuses. Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH q1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address, COUNT(ia.ip_address) AS ip_allocation_count, SUM(CASE WHEN NOT ia.subnet_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS subnet_id_rows FROM `ports` AS p JOIN `portsecuritybindings` AS psb ON psb.port_id = p.id JOIN `ipallocations` AS ia ON ia.port_id = p.id WHERE p.admin_state_up = 1 AND NOT ia.ip_address IS NULL AND p.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') GROUP BY p.id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address) SELECT p.network_id, MAX(inner_cte.ip_allocation_count) AS max_ip_allocations_on_a_port FROM inner_cte JOIN `ports` AS p ON p.id = inner_cte.port_id GROUP BY p.network_id), q2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT p.status, STDDEV(LENGTH(ia.ip_address)) / NULLIF(AVG(LENGTH(ia.ip_address)), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM `portsecuritybindings` AS psb JOIN `ports` AS p ON psb.port_id = p.id JOIN `ipallocations` AS ia ON p.id = ia.port_id WHERE psb.port_security_enabled = 1 AND ia.ip_address IN ('10.150.64.113/8') GROUP BY p.status HAVING AVG(LENGTH(ia.ip_address)) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC) SELECT ia.network_id, MAX(inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation) AS max_coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte JOIN `ports` AS p ON p.status = inner_cte.status JOIN `ipallocations` AS ia ON ia.port_id = p.id GROUP BY ia.network_id) SELECT q1.network_id, q1.max_ip_allocations_on_a_port, q2.max_coefficient_of_variation FROM q1 JOIN q2 ON q2.network_id = q1.network_id

target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH port_security_by_port AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address, COUNT(psb.port_id) AS binding_count, SUM(CASE WHEN psb.port_security_enabled THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS port_security_enabled_total FROM `ports` AS p JOIN `portsecuritybindings` AS psb ON p.id = psb.port_id WHERE p.admin_state_up = 1 AND p.tenant_id IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') GROUP BY p.id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(port_id) OVER (ORDER BY port_id_sort, port_id) = port_id THEN NULL ELSE port_id END AS port_id, tenant_id, mac_address, binding_count, port_security_enabled_total FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.port_id) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE i.port_id END AS port_id_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.port_id) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE i.port_id END AS port_id, MAX(i.tenant_id) AS tenant_id, MAX(i.mac_address) AS mac_address, SUM(i.binding_count) AS binding_count, SUM(i.port_security_enabled_total) AS port_security_enabled_total FROM inner_cte AS i GROUP BY i.port_id WITH ROLLUP) AS tbltmp ORDER BY port_id_sort), active_networks_by_tenant AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT n.ID AS network_id, n.NAME AS network_name, n.TENANT_ID AS tenant_id, n.ADMIN_STATE_UP AS admin_state_up, n.MTU AS mtu, sa.UPDATED_AT AS standard_attr_updated_at, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.TENANT_ID ORDER BY n.NAME) AS window_column FROM `networks` AS n JOIN `standardattributes` AS sa ON sa.ID = n.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE n.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND n.TENANT_ID IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57')) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(tenant_id) OVER (ORDER BY tenant_id_sort, tenant_id, network_name) = tenant_id THEN NULL ELSE tenant_id END AS tenant_id, network_id, network_name, admin_state_up, mtu, standard_attr_updated_at, window_column, total_networks FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(tenant_id) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE tenant_id END AS tenant_id_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(tenant_id) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE tenant_id END AS tenant_id, CASE WHEN GROUPING(tenant_id) = 1 THEN NULL ELSE network_id END AS network_id, CASE WHEN GROUPING(tenant_id) = 1 THEN NULL ELSE network_name END AS network_name, CASE WHEN GROUPING(tenant_id) = 1 THEN NULL ELSE admin_state_up END AS admin_state_up, CASE WHEN GROUPING(tenant_id) = 1 THEN NULL ELSE mtu END AS mtu, CASE WHEN GROUPING(tenant_id) = 1 THEN NULL ELSE standard_attr_updated_at END AS standard_attr_updated_at, CASE WHEN GROUPING(tenant_id) = 1 THEN NULL ELSE window_column END AS window_column, COUNT(*) AS total_networks FROM inner_cte GROUP BY tenant_id, network_id, network_name, admin_state_up, mtu, standard_attr_updated_at, window_column WITH ROLLUP) AS tbltmp ORDER BY tenant_id_sort, tenant_id, network_name) SELECT ps.port_id, network_admin_state_up, an.mtu, an.standard_attr_updated_at, an.window_column, an.total_networks FROM port_security_by_port AS ps CROSS JOIN active_networks_by_tenant AS an

target_disjoint_workload.question: For tenant ID `17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7`, list the ports that are administratively up and also have status `DOWN` with a standard-attribute running-sum (within each resource type ordered by standard attribute ID) greater than 1000; for each such port return the port ID, tenant ID, MAC address, the number of port security bindings, the total number of times port security is enabled across those bindings, the deviation of that enabled total from the average enabled total across all administratively up ports for the tenant, and the running-sum value. Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH ps_stats AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address, COUNT(psb.port_id) AS binding_count, SUM(CASE WHEN psb.port_security_enabled THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS port_security_enabled_total FROM `ports` AS p JOIN `portsecuritybindings` AS psb ON p.id = psb.port_id WHERE p.admin_state_up = 1 AND p.tenant_id IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') GROUP BY p.id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address), avg_cte AS (SELECT AVG(port_security_enabled_total) AS avg_enabled_total FROM inner_cte) SELECT i.port_id, i.tenant_id, i.mac_address, i.binding_count, i.port_security_enabled_total, (i.port_security_enabled_total - a.avg_enabled_total) AS deviation_from_avg_enabled_total FROM inner_cte AS i CROSS JOIN avg_cte AS a), down_ports_window AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT p.ID AS port_id, p.TENANT_ID AS tenant_id, p.MAC_ADDRESS AS mac_address, SUM(sa.ID) OVER (PARTITION BY sa.RESOURCE_TYPE ORDER BY sa.ID) AS window_column FROM `ports` AS p JOIN `standardattributes` AS sa ON sa.ID = p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7')) SELECT port_id, tenant_id, mac_address, window_column FROM inner_cte WHERE window_column > 1000) SELECT ps.port_id, ps.tenant_id, ps.mac_address, ps.binding_count, ps.port_security_enabled_total, ps.deviation_from_avg_enabled_total, dp.window_column FROM ps_stats AS ps JOIN down_ports_window AS dp ON ps.port_id = dp.port_id AND ps.tenant_id = dp.tenant_id AND ps.mac_address = dp.mac_address

target_disjoint_workload.question: For ports bound to security group ID 0008e629-5619-41e0-b86c-4eecfeaacb6c whose standard attribute ID is greater than the average standard attribute ID of other ports in the same network, show each port’s ID, status, allocated IP address, and the running sum of its standard attribute ID within its network; also include (for the matching port status) the port-security rollup label (Enabled/Disabled, including subtotals and grand total rows) and the corresponding count of ports. target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH q1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT p.ID AS port_id, p.STATUS AS port_status, ia.IP_ADDRESS AS ip_address, SUM(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER (PARTITION BY p.NETWORK_ID ORDER BY p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) AS window_column FROM `securitygroupportbindings` AS sgpb JOIN `ports` AS p ON sgpb.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN `ipallocations` AS ia ON p.ID = ia.PORT_ID WHERE sgpb.SECURITY_GROUP_ID = '0008e629-5619-41e0-b86c-4eecfeaacb6c') SELECT inner_cte.port_id, inner_cte.port_status, inner_cte.ip_address, inner_cte.window_column FROM inner_cte JOIN `ports` AS p2 ON p2.ID = inner_cte.port_id WHERE p2.STANDARD_ATTR_ID > (SELECT AVG(p3.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) FROM `ports` AS p3 WHERE p3.NETWORK_ID = p2.NETWORK_ID)), q2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT p.id AS port_id, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY psb.port_security_enabled ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column FROM `ports` AS p JOIN `portsecuritybindings` AS psb ON p.id = psb.port_id WHERE p.status = 'DOWN'), PortSecurityRollup AS (SELECT p.status, CASE WHEN psb.port_security_enabled = 1 THEN 'Enabled' ELSE 'Disabled' END AS port_security_status, COUNT(DISTINCT inner_cte.port_id) AS total_ports FROM inner_cte JOIN `ports` AS p ON inner_cte.port_id = p.id JOIN `portsecuritybindings` AS psb ON p.id = psb.port_id GROUP BY p.status, port_security_status) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(status) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE status END AS status, CASE WHEN GROUPING(port_security_status) = 1 AND GROUPING(status) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' ELSE port_security_status END AS port_security_status, SUM(total_ports) AS total_ports FROM PortSecurityRollup GROUP BY status, port_security_status WITH ROLLUP) SELECT q1.port_id, q1.port_status, q1.ip_address, q1.window_column AS running_sum_standard_attr_id_in_network, q2.port_security_status, q2.total_ports FROM q1 JOIN q2 ON q2.status = q1.port_status ORDER BY q1.port_id

target_disjoint_workload.question: For tenant ID `17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7`, list each administratively up port (including the final TOTAL rollup row) with its port ID, tenant ID, MAC address, the number of port security bindings, and the total number of times port security is enabled across those bindings, and also show (when available for the same tenant and MAC address) the running sum of standard attribute IDs for DOWN ports where that running sum is greater than 1000. target_disjoint_workload.question: For each (port status, device owner) group under the standard-attributes port filtering rules (resource_type = 'ports' and excluding shared networks listed in networkrbacs for access_as_shared to '*' or tenant '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b'), show the port count, the earliest standard attribute updated timestamp, the overall average port count benchmark and volume category, and also include (by matching port status) the subtotal total number of ports and the count of DOWN ports with port security enabled for tenant ID '17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7' considering only ports that have a port security binding. target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH ps_rollup AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS down_ports_with_port_security_enabled FROM `ports` AS p JOIN `portsecuritybindings` AS psb ON p.ID = psb.PORT_ID WHERE p.TENANT_ID IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') GROUP BY p.STATUS, port_security_state) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(port_status) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE port_status END AS port_status, MAX(inner_cte.down_ports_with_port_security_enabled) AS down_ports_with_port_security_enabled FROM PortSecurityStatus CROSS JOIN inner_cte GROUP BY port_status, port_security_state WITH ROLLUP), volume_by_owner AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT p.STATUS AS port_status, p.DEVICE_OWNER AS device_owner, COUNT(p.ID) AS port_count, MIN(sa.UPDATED_AT) AS earliest_standard_attr_update FROM `ports` AS p avg_port_count FROM inner_cte) SELECT i.port_status, i.device_owner, i.port_count, i.earliest_standard_attr_update, a.avg_port_count AS benchmark, CASE WHEN i.port_count > a.avg_port_count * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_VOLUME' WHEN i.port_count < a.avg_port_count * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_VOLUME' ELSE 'AVERAGE_VOLUME' END AS volume_category FROM inner_cte AS i CROSS JOIN avg_cte AS a) SELECT v.port_status, v.device_owner, v.port_count, v.earliest_standard_attr_update, v.benchmark, v.volume_category, p.total_ports AS tenant17_total_ports_with_port_security_binding, p.down_ports_with_port_security_enabled AS tenant17_down_ports_with_port_security_enabled FROM volume_by_owner AS v LEFT JOIN ps_rollup AS p ON p.port_status = v.port_status AND p.port_security_state = 'SUBTOTAL' ORDER BY v.port_status, lb2.TENANT_ID) AS tenant_counts ON tenant_counts.TENANT_ID = lb.TENANT_ID JOIN (SELECT AVG(sub.haproxy_lb_count) AS avg_haproxy_lb_count FROM (SELECT lb3.TENANT_ID, COUNT(lb3.ID) AS haproxy_lb_count SELECT q1.TENANT_ID, q1.total_online_haproxy_loadbalancers, q1.overall_online_haproxy_loadbalancers, q2.loadbalancer_name, q2.vip_address, q2.bytes_in, q2.total_connections, q2.window_column, q2.tenant_haproxy_loadbalancer_count, q2.avg_haproxy_loadbalancers_per_tenant FROM q1 JOIN q2 ON q2.tenant_id = q1.TENANT_ID ORDER BY q1.total_online_haproxy_loadbalancers DESC, q2.loadbalancer_name

target_disjoint_workload.question: For each tenant, list the tenant ID and the number of load balancers that are ONLINE and associated with the provider named 'haproxy', but only include tenants whose count is greater than the average such count across all tenants.
