target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS online_haproxy_loadbalancers FROM `lbaas_loadbalancers` AS lb JOIN `providerresourceassociations` AS pra ON lb.ID = pra.RESOURCE_ID WHERE lb.OPERATING_STATUS = 'ONLINE' AND pra.PROVIDER_NAME = 'haproxy'), TenantCounts AS (SELECT lb.TENANT_ID, COUNT(*) AS tenant_online_haproxy_count FROM `lbaas_loadbalancers` AS lb JOIN `providerresourceassociations` AS pra ON lb.ID = pra.RESOURCE_ID WHERE lb.OPERATING_STATUS = 'ONLINE' AND pra.PROVIDER_NAME = 'haproxy' GROUP BY lb.TENANT_ID), AvgTenantCount AS (SELECT AVG(tenant_online_haproxy_count) AS avg_tenant_online_haproxy_count FROM TenantCounts) SELECT tc.TENANT_ID, tc.tenant_online_haproxy_count FROM TenantCounts AS tc CROSS JOIN inner_cte CROSS JOIN AvgTenantCount AS atc WHERE tc.tenant_online_haproxy_count > atc.avg_tenant_online_haproxy_count

target_disjoint_workload.question: For load balancers provided by the “haproxy” provider, list the provider name, load balancer name, load balancer ID, VIP address, provisioning status, operating status, and the running average of the load balancer ID within each provider name group ordered by load balancer name. Do not repeat the provider name if it is the same as the previous row, and include a subtotal row for the provider. Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT lb.NAME, lb.ID, lb.VIP_ADDRESS, lb.PROVISIONING_STATUS, lb.OPERATING_STATUS, AVG(lb.ID) OVER (PARTITION BY pra.PROVIDER_NAME ORDER BY lb.NAME) AS window_column FROM `lbaas_loadbalancers` AS lb JOIN `providerresourceassociations` AS pra ON lb.ID = pra.RESOURCE_ID WHERE pra.PROVIDER_NAME = 'haproxy') SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(provider_name) OVER (ORDER BY provider_name_sort, lb_name) = provider_name THEN NULL ELSE provider_name END AS provider_name, lb_name, lb_id, vip_address, provisioning_status, operating_status, window_column FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(pra.PROVIDER_NAME) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE pra.PROVIDER_NAME END AS provider_name_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(pra.PROVIDER_NAME) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE pra.PROVIDER_NAME END AS provider_name, inner_cte.NAME AS lb_name, inner_cte.ID AS lb_id, inner_cte.VIP_ADDRESS AS vip_address, inner_cte.PROVISIONING_STATUS AS provisioning_status, inner_cte.OPERATING_STATUS AS operating_status, inner_cte.window_column AS window_column FROM inner_cte JOIN `providerresourceassociations` AS pra ON inner_cte.ID = pra.RESOURCE_ID GROUP BY pra.PROVIDER_NAME, inner_cte.NAME, inner_cte.ID, inner_cte.VIP_ADDRESS, inner_cte.PROVISIONING_STATUS, inner_cte.OPERATING_STATUS, inner_cte.window_column WITH ROLLUP) AS tbltmp ORDER BY provider_name_sort, lb_name

target_disjoint_workload.question: For load balancers that are ONLINE, list the provider name, load balancer ID, name, VIP address, and total connections. Do not repeat the provider name if it is the same as the previous row. Also include a subtotal row per provider showing the total number of ONLINE load balancers and the sum of total connections. target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT lb.ID AS loadbalancer_id, lb.NAME AS loadbalancer_name, pra.PROVIDER_NAME AS provider_name, lb.VIP_ADDRESS AS vip_address, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pra.PROVIDER_NAME ORDER BY stats.TOTAL_CONNECTIONS) AS window_column FROM `lbaas_loadbalancer_statistics` AS stats JOIN `lbaas_loadbalancers` AS lb ON stats.LOADBALANCER_ID = lb.ID JOIN `providerresourceassociations` AS pra ON lb.ID = pra.RESOURCE_ID WHERE lb.OPERATING_STATUS = 'ONLINE') SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(provider_name) OVER (ORDER BY provider_name_sort, provider_name, total_connections, loadbalancer_id) = provider_name THEN NULL ELSE provider_name END AS provider_name, loadbalancer_id, loadbalancer_name, vip_address, total_connections, total_online_loadbalancers FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.provider_name) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE i.provider_name END AS provider_name_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.provider_name) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE i.provider_name END AS provider_name, CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.provider_name) = 1 THEN NULL ELSE i.loadbalancer_id END AS loadbalancer_id, CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.provider_name) = 1 THEN NULL ELSE i.loadbalancer_name END AS loadbalancer_name, CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.provider_name) = 1 THEN NULL ELSE i.vip_address END AS vip_address, SUM(i.window_column) AS total_connections, COUNT(i.loadbalancer_id) AS total_online_loadbalancers FROM inner_cte AS i GROUP BY i.provider_name, i.loadbalancer_id, i.loadbalancer_name, i.vip_address WITH ROLLUP) AS tbltmp ORDER BY provider_name_sort, provider_name, total_connections, loadbalancer_id

target_disjoint_workload.question: For load balancers provided by “haproxy”, list only those whose total connections are greater than the average total connections across all “haproxy” load balancers, and return the load balancer name, VIP address, bytes in, total connections, and the same row number ordered by load balancer name using a window frame of 2 preceding and 1 following rows. target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT lb.NAME AS loadbalancer_name, lb.VIP_ADDRESS AS vip_address, stats.BYTES_IN AS bytes_in, stats.TOTAL_CONNECTIONS AS total_connections, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY lb.NAME ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM `lbaas_loadbalancer_statistics` AS stats JOIN `lbaas_loadbalancers` AS lb ON stats.LOADBALANCER_ID = lb.ID JOIN `providerresourceassociations` AS pra ON lb.ID = pra.RESOURCE_ID WHERE pra.PROVIDER_NAME = 'haproxy'), ProviderAverages AS (SELECT pra.PROVIDER_NAME, AVG(stats.TOTAL_CONNECTIONS) AS avg_total_connections FROM `lbaas_loadbalancer_statistics` AS stats JOIN `lbaas_loadbalancers` AS lb ON stats.LOADBALANCER_ID = lb.ID JOIN `providerresourceassociations` AS pra ON lb.ID = pra.RESOURCE_ID GROUP BY pra.PROVIDER_NAME) SELECT i.loadbalancer_name, i.vip_address, i.bytes_in, i.total_connections, i.window_column FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN `lbaas_loadbalancers` AS lb2 ON lb2.NAME = i.loadbalancer_name AND lb2.VIP_ADDRESS = i.vip_address JOIN `providerresourceassociations` AS pra2 ON lb2.ID = pra2.RESOURCE_ID WHERE i.total_connections > (SELECT avg_total_connections FROM ProviderAverages WHERE ProviderAverages.PROVIDER_NAME = pra2.PROVIDER_NAME) ORDER BY i.loadbalancer_name

target_disjoint_workload.question: For each load balancer operating status, list the operating status and total number of “haproxy” load balancers, but only include operating statuses where that count represents more than 50% of all “haproxy” load balancers. Do not return any rounded answers.

target_disjoint_workload.question: Among the load balancers associated with the provider named 'haproxy' whose highest admin_state_up value is 1, list the top 10 tenants by number of such load balancers, showing each tenant ID, the total number of qualifying load balancers, and whether any of those load balancers are currently operating ONLINE. target_disjoint_workload.question: For each load balancer operating status, show the operating status, the total number of load balancers associated with the “haproxy” provider (only keeping statuses where this count is greater than 1), the average of these per-status totals as a benchmark, and categorize each status as 'HIGH_COUNT' (at least 50% above average), 'LOW_COUNT' (at least 50% below average), or 'AVERAGE_COUNT'. target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT lb.ID AS loadbalancer_id, lb.NAME AS loadbalancer_name, pra.PROVIDER_NAME AS provider_name, lb.VIP_ADDRESS AS vip_address, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pra.PROVIDER_NAME ORDER BY stats.TOTAL_CONNECTIONS) AS window_column FROM `lbaas_loadbalancer_statistics` AS stats JOIN `lbaas_loadbalancers` AS lb ON stats.LOADBALANCER_ID = lb.ID JOIN `providerresourceassociations` AS pra ON lb.ID = pra.RESOURCE_ID WHERE lb.OPERATING_STATUS = 'ONLINE'), provider_avg AS (SELECT pra.PROVIDER_NAME AS provider_name, AVG(stats.TOTAL_CONNECTIONS) AS avg_total_connections FROM `lbaas_loadbalancer_statistics` AS stats JOIN `lbaas_loadbalancers` AS lb ON stats.LOADBALANCER_ID = lb.ID JOIN `providerresourceassociations` AS pra ON lb.ID = pra.RESOURCE_ID WHERE lb.OPERATING_STATUS = 'ONLINE' GROUP BY pra.PROVIDER_NAME) SELECT i.loadbalancer_id, i.loadbalancer_name, i.provider_name, i.vip_address, i.window_column AS rank_within_provider_by_total_connections, (stats.TOTAL_CONNECTIONS - pa.avg_total_connections) AS deviation_from_provider_avg_total_connections FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN `lbaas_loadbalancer_statistics` AS stats ON stats.LOADBALANCER_ID = i.loadbalancer_id JOIN provider_avg AS pa ON pa.provider_name = i.provider_name

target_disjoint_workload.question: For load balancers provided by “haproxy”, for each tenant find the tenant ID and the maximum total connections among that tenant’s load balancers, where the per-load-balancer totals come from the detailed list of load balancer name, VIP address, bytes in, total connections, and a row number ordered by load balancer name using a window frame of 2 preceding and 1 following rows. target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT lb.NAME AS loadbalancer_name, lb.VIP_ADDRESS AS vip_address, stats.BYTES_IN AS bytes_in, stats.TOTAL_CONNECTIONS AS total_connections, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY lb.NAME ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM `lbaas_loadbalancer_statistics` AS stats JOIN `lbaas_loadbalancers` AS lb ON stats.LOADBALANCER_ID = lb.ID JOIN `providerresourceassociations` AS pra ON lb.ID = pra.RESOURCE_ID WHERE pra.PROVIDER_NAME = 'haproxy') SELECT lb.TENANT_ID AS tenant_id, MAX(inner_cte.total_connections) AS max_total_connections FROM inner_cte JOIN `lbaas_loadbalancers` AS lb ON lb.NAME = inner_cte.loadbalancer_name AND lb.VIP_ADDRESS = inner_cte.vip_address GROUP BY lb.TENANT_ID

target_disjoint_workload.question: For ports that (1) are bound to a security group and have admin_state_up = 1 and (2) are also in DOWN status, list the port ID, tenant ID, port name, the port’s security group binding count, the total DNS record count for the port, the deviation of that binding count from the average across all admin_state_up = 1 security-group-bound ports, and also include the port MAC address, the running sum of standard attribute ID within each security group, the tenant’s total number of DOWN ports, the average DOWN-port count across tenants as a benchmark, and the tenant category (HIGH_USER/LOW_USER/AVERAGE_USER). Do not return any rounded answers. Categorize each tenant as 'HIGH_USER' (at least 50% more than average), 'LOW_USER' (at least 50% less than average), or 'AVERAGE_USER'.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH sg_admin_ports AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.tenant_id, p.name AS port_name, COUNT(sgpb.security_group_id) AS security_group_binding_count, SUM(CASE WHEN pd.port_id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) AS dns_record_count FROM `securitygroupportbindings` AS sgpb JOIN `ports` AS p ON sgpb.port_id = p.id LEFT JOIN `portdnses` AS pd ON p.id = pd.port_id WHERE p.admin_state_up = 1 GROUP BY p.id, p.tenant_id, p.name), avg_cte AS (SELECT AVG(security_group_binding_count) AS avg_sg_binding_count FROM inner_cte) SELECT i.port_id, i.tenant_id, i.port_name, i.security_group_binding_count, i.dns_record_count, (i.security_group_binding_count - a.avg_sg_binding_count) AS deviation_from_avg_sg_binding_count FROM inner_cte AS i CROSS JOIN avg_cte AS a), down_ports_by_sg AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT p.ID AS port_id, p.TENANT_ID AS tenant_id, p.MAC_ADDRESS AS mac_address, SUM(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER (PARTITION BY sgpb.SECURITY_GROUP_ID ORDER BY p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) AS window_column FROM `securitygroupportbindings` AS sgpb JOIN `ports` AS p ON sgpb.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN `portsecuritybindings` AS psb ON p.ID = psb.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN'), TenantDownPorts AS (SELECT tenant_id, COUNT(DISTINCT port_id) AS total_down_ports FROM inner_cte GROUP BY tenant_id), AverageDownPorts AS (SELECT AVG(total_down_ports) AS avg_down_ports FROM TenantDownPorts) SELECT i.port_id, i.tenant_id, i.mac_address, i.window_column, tdp.total_down_ports, adp.avg_down_ports AS benchmark, CASE WHEN tdp.total_down_ports > adp.avg_down_ports * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_USER' WHEN tdp.total_down_ports < adp.avg_down_ports * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_USER' ELSE 'AVERAGE_USER' END AS user_category FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN TenantDownPorts AS tdp ON i.tenant_id = tdp.tenant_id CROSS JOIN AverageDownPorts AS adp) SELECT sap.port_id, sap.tenant_id, sap.port_name, sap.security_group_binding_count, sap.dns_record_count, sap.deviation_from_avg_sg_binding_count, dps.mac_address, dps.window_column, dps.total_down_ports, dps.benchmark, dps.user_category FROM sg_admin_ports AS sap JOIN down_ports_by_sg AS dps ON sap.port_id = dps.port_id AND sap.tenant_id = dps.tenant_id

target_disjoint_workload.question: For network ID `0a1d0a27-cffa-4de3-92c5-9d3fd3f2e74d`, summarize (1) how many distinct DOWN port names and distinct bound security group IDs exist, and (2) among ports on that same network that are administratively up, belong to tenant `98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57`, and have at least one IP allocation, report the number of such ports plus their total IP allocation count and total subnet_id row count (joining the two port sets by MAC address). Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH TenantUpPortsWithIPs AS (SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address, COUNT(ia.ip_address) AS ip_allocation_count, SUM(CASE WHEN NOT ia.subnet_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS subnet_id_rows FROM `ports` AS p JOIN `portsecuritybindings` AS psb ON psb.port_id = p.id JOIN `ipallocations` AS ia ON ia.port_id = p.id WHERE p.admin_state_up = 1 AND NOT ia.ip_address IS NULL AND p.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') GROUP BY p.id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address), DownPortsOnNetworkWithSG AS (SELECT p.NAME, p.NETWORK_ID, p.MAC_ADDRESS, p.ADMIN_STATE_UP, p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER, s.SECURITY_GROUP_ID, MIN(p.ADMIN_STATE_UP) OVER (ORDER BY p.ID ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM `ports` AS p JOIN `securitygroupportbindings` AS s ON p.ID = s.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' AND p.NETWORK_ID IN ('0a1d0a27-cffa-4de3-92c5-9d3fd3f2e74d')), TenantUpPortsWithIPsOnNetwork AS (SELECT t.port_id, t.tenant_id, t.mac_address, t.ip_allocation_count, t.subnet_id_rows FROM TenantUpPortsWithIPs AS t JOIN `ports` AS p ON p.ID = t.port_id WHERE p.NETWORK_ID IN ('0a1d0a27-cffa-4de3-92c5-9d3fd3f2e74d')) SELECT d.NETWORK_ID, COUNT(DISTINCT d.NAME) AS down_port_name_count, COUNT(DISTINCT d.SECURITY_GROUP_ID) AS down_port_security_group_count, COUNT(DISTINCT t.port_id) AS tenant_up_port_count_with_ips, SUM(t.ip_allocation_count) AS tenant_up_total_ip_allocations, SUM(t.subnet_id_rows) AS tenant_up_total_subnet_id_rows FROM DownPortsOnNetworkWithSG AS d LEFT JOIN TenantUpPortsWithIPsOnNetwork AS t ON t.mac_address = d.MAC_ADDRESS GROUP BY d.NETWORK_ID

target_disjoint_workload.question: For allowed address pairs on port ID `25d421c1-c76d-4c26-9550-9f871a1d5034`, list each allowed address pair’s MAC address and IP address along with the port ID and its bound security group ID, the running average of the port’s standard attribute ID (partitioned by port and ordered by allowed address pair IP) and its deviation from the overall average running average; also include, for that same security group, the range/variance/standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of allowed-address-pair counts per port (considering only ports with at least one allowed address pair), the security group’s average allowed-address-pair count per port, and that average’s deviation from the overall security-group average. Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH sg_stats AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sgpb.SECURITY_GROUP_ID, MAX(port_pair_count) - MIN(port_pair_count) AS pair_count_range, VARIANCE(port_pair_count) AS pair_count_variance, STDDEV(port_pair_count) AS pair_count_stddev FROM `securitygroupportbindings` AS sgpb JOIN (SELECT p.ID AS port_id, COUNT(*) AS port_pair_count FROM `ports` AS p JOIN `allowedaddresspairs` AS aap ON p.ID = aap.PORT_ID GROUP BY p.ID) AS port_stats ON sgpb.PORT_ID = port_stats.port_id GROUP BY sgpb.SECURITY_GROUP_ID ORDER BY pair_count_range DESC), SecurityGroupAverages AS (SELECT sgpb.SECURITY_GROUP_ID AS security_group_id, AVG(port_stats.port_pair_count) AS avg_pairs_per_port FROM `securitygroupportbindings` AS sgpb JOIN (SELECT p.ID AS port_id, COUNT(*) AS port_pair_count FROM `ports` AS p JOIN `allowedaddresspairs` AS aap ON p.ID = aap.PORT_ID GROUP BY p.ID) AS port_stats ON sgpb.PORT_ID = port_stats.port_id GROUP BY sgpb.SECURITY_GROUP_ID), OverallAverage AS (SELECT AVG(avg_pairs_per_port) AS overall_avg_pairs_per_port FROM SecurityGroupAverages) SELECT i.SECURITY_GROUP_ID, i.pair_count_range, i.pair_count_variance, i.pair_count_stddev, sga.avg_pairs_per_port, (sga.avg_pairs_per_port - target_disjoint_workload.question: List port-status insights by combining (1) a rollup of port counts and earliest standard-attribute update timestamps per port status and device owner for ports whose standard attribute resource type is 'ports' (including subtotals and a grand total) and (2) per-status variance of STANDARD_ATTR_ID for ports that have an IP allocation, including the overall average variance benchmark and a variance category, and label each row with the reason it appears. target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH PortStatusOwnerRollup AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT p.STATUS AS port_status, p.DEVICE_OWNER AS device_owner, COUNT(p.ID) AS port_count, MIN(sa.UPDATED_AT) AS earliest_standard_attr_update FROM `ports` AS p JOIN `standardattributes` AS sa ON sa.ID = p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE sa.RESOURCE_TYPE = 'ports' GROUP BY p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(port_status) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE port_status END AS port_status, CASE WHEN GROUPING(device_owner) = 1 AND GROUPING(port_status) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' ELSE device_owner END AS device_owner, SUM(port_count) AS port_count, MIN(earliest_standard_attr_update) AS earliest_standard_attr_update FROM inner_cte GROUP BY port_status, device_owner WITH ROLLUP), PortStatusVariance AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT p.STATUS, VARIANCE(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) AS standard_attr_id_variance FROM `ports` AS p JOIN `ipallocations` AS ia ON p.ID = ia.PORT_ID WHERE NOT p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID IS NULL GROUP BY p.STATUS ORDER BY standard_attr_id_variance DESC), AverageVariance AS (SELECT AVG(standard_attr_id_variance) AS avg_variance FROM inner_cte) SELECT i.STATUS, i.standard_attr_id_variance, av.avg_variance AS benchmark, CASE WHEN i.standard_attr_id_variance > av.avg_variance * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_VARIANCE' WHEN i.standard_attr_id_variance < av.avg_variance * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_VARIANCE' ELSE 'AVERAGE_VARIANCE' END AS variance_category FROM inner_cte AS i CROSS JOIN AverageVariance AS av), CombinedStatusInsights AS (SELECT psor.port_status AS port_status, psor.device_owner AS device_owner, AS reason FROM PortStatusOwnerRollup AS psor UNION ALL SELECT psv.STATUS AS port_status, NULL AS device_owner, NULL AS port_count, NULL AS earliest_standard_attr_update, psv.standard_attr_id_variance AS standard_attr_id_variance, psv.benchmark AS benchmark, psv.variance_category AS variance_category, 'Standard Attr ID Variance (IP Allocations)' AS reason FROM PortStatusVariance AS psv) SELECT * target_disjoint_workload.question: Return the port status/device-owner rollup for ports whose standard attribute resource type is 'ports' (including the port count and earliest standard-attribute updated timestamp), and alongside it also return overall tenant-level totals for administratively up ports that have at least one IP allocation (total such ports, total IP allocations, total subnet-id rows, and the average number of such ports per tenant across all tenants). target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH port_status_owner_rollup AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT p.STATUS AS port_status, p.DEVICE_OWNER AS device_owner, COUNT(p.ID) AS port_count, MIN(sa.UPDATED_AT) AS earliest_standard_attr_update FROM `ports` AS p JOIN `standardattributes` AS sa ON sa.ID = p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE sa.RESOURCE_TYPE = 'ports' AND NOT p.NETWORK_ID IN (SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM `networkrbacs` WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b')) GROUP BY p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(port_status) OVER (ORDER BY port_status_sort, port_status, device_owner) = port_status THEN NULL ELSE port_status END AS port_status, device_owner, port_count, earliest_standard_attr_update FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.port_status) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE i.port_status END AS port_status_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.port_status) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE i.port_status END AS port_status, CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.device_owner) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' ELSE i.device_owner END AS device_owner, SUM(i.port_count) AS port_count, MIN(i.earliest_standard_attr_update) AS earliest_standard_attr_update FROM inner_cte AS i GROUP BY i.port_status, i.device_owner WITH ROLLUP) AS tbltmp ORDER BY port_status_sort, port_status, device_owner), port_security_binding_stats AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT p.status, MAX(ps.binding_count) - MIN(ps.binding_count) AS binding_count_range, VARIANCE(ps.binding_count) AS binding_count_variance, STDDEV(ps.binding_count) AS binding_count_stddev FROM `ports` AS p JOIN (SELECT p2.id AS port_id, COUNT(*) AS binding_count FROM `ports` AS p2 JOIN `portsecuritybindings` AS b ON p2.id = b.port_id WHERE p2.tenant_id IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') GROUP BY p2.id) AS ps ON p.id = ps.port_id GROUP BY p.status ORDER BY binding_count_range DESC), avg_cte AS (SELECT AVG(binding_count_range) AS avg_binding_count_range FROM inner_cte) SELECT i.status, i.binding_count_range, i.binding_count_variance, i.binding_count_stddev, (i.binding_count_range - a.avg_binding_count_range) AS deviation_from_avg_binding_count_range FROM inner_cte AS i CROSS JOIN avg_cte AS a ORDER BY i.binding_count_range DESC) SELECT r.port_status, r.device_owner, r.port_count, r.earliest_standard_attr_update, s.binding_count_range, s.binding_count_variance, s.binding_count_stddev, s.deviation_from_avg_binding_count_range FROM port_status_owner_rollup AS r LEFT JOIN port_security_binding_stats AS s ON r.port_status = s.status ORDER BY r.port_status, r.device_owner

target_disjoint_workload.question: For each network that contains an IPv4 subnet whose subnet ID is in ('012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48'), show the network ID and the maximum dense-rank-to-max-standard-attribute ratio among those subnets in that network (where the ratio is computed as the dense rank of the subnet’s standard attribute ID ordered by the standard attribute updated-at timestamp using a window of the current row and 2 preceding rows, divided by the maximum subnet standard attribute ID considering the current row and the next 2 rows ordered by subnet ID).
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH SubnetPools AS (SELECT s.NAME, s.TENANT_ID, s.NETWORK_ID, s.IP_VERSION, s.CIDR, s.GATEWAY_IP, s.ENABLE_DHCP, p.FIRST_IP, p.LAST_IP, MAX(s.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER (ORDER BY s.ID ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_standard_attr_id_next2 FROM `subnets` AS s JOIN `ipallocationpools` AS p ON s.ID = p.SUBNET_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4 AND s.ID IN ('012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48')), SubnetAttrDenseRank AS (SELECT s.NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY sa.UPDATED_AT ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column FROM `subnets` AS s JOIN `standardattributes` AS sa ON sa.ID = s.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4 AND s.ID IN ('012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48')) SELECT sp.NAME AS subnet_name, sp.TENANT_ID, sp.NETWORK_ID, sp.IP_VERSION, sp.CIDR, sp.GATEWAY_IP, sp.ENABLE_DHCP, sp.FIRST_IP AS allocation_pool_first_ip, sp.LAST_IP AS allocation_pool_last_ip, sp.max_standard_attr_id_next2, sadr.window_column AS standard_attr_dense_rank_window, ROUND(sadr.window_column / NULLIF(sp.max_standard_attr_id_next2, 0), 4) AS dense_rank_to_max_attr_ratio FROM `subnetpools` AS sp JOIN SubnetAttrDenseRank AS sadr ON sp.NAME = sadr.NAME ORDER BY dense_rank_to_max_attr_ratio DESC) SELECT network_id, MAX(dense_rank_to_max_attr_ratio) AS max_dense_rank_to_max_attr_ratio FROM inner_cte GROUP BY network_id

'AVERAGE_ROUTE_SUBNET' END AS route_category FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN `subnets` AS s ON s.CIDR = i.subnet_cidr AND s.NAME = i.subnet_name JOIN SubnetRouteCounts AS src ON src.subnet_id = s.ID CROSS JOIN AverageRoutes AS ar), ActiveNetworkDetails AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT n.ID AS network_id, n.NAME AS network_name, n.TENANT_ID AS tenant_id, n.ADMIN_STATE_UP AS admin_state_up, n.MTU AS mtu, sa.UPDATED_AT AS standard_attr_updated_at, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.TENANT_ID ORDER BY n.NAME) AS window_column FROM `networks` AS n JOIN `standardattributes` AS sa ON sa.ID = n.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE n.STATUS = 'ACTIVE'), AvgMtu AS (SELECT AVG(mtu) AS avg_mtu FROM inner_cte) SELECT i.network_id, i.network_name, i.tenant_id, i.admin_state_up, i.mtu, i.standard_attr_updated_at, i.window_column, a.avg_mtu AS benchmark_avg_mtu, CASE WHEN i.mtu > a.avg_mtu THEN 'ABOVE_AVG_MTU' WHEN i.mtu < a.avg_mtu THEN 'BELOW_AVG_MTU' ELSE 'AT_AVG_MTU' END AS mtu_category FROM inner_cte AS i CROSS JOIN AvgMtu AS a) SELECT rd.DESTINATION, rd.NEXTHOP, rd.subnet_name, rd.subnet_cidr, rd.FIRST_IP, rd.LAST_IP, rd.window_column AS subnet_dense_rank, rd.total_routes, rd.benchmark AS avg_routes_benchmark, rd.route_category, andt.network_id, andt.network_name, andt.tenant_id, andt.admin_state_up, andt.mtu, andt.standard_attr_updated_at, andt.window_column AS tenant_network_rownum, andt.benchmark_avg_mtu, andt.mtu_category FROM RouteDetails AS rd JOIN `subnets` AS s ON s.CIDR = rd.subnet_cidr AND s.NAME = rd.subnet_name JOIN target_disjoint_workload.question: For IPv4 subnet ID `012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48`, return the (up to) top 10 subnets by number of distinct subnet routes, showing subnet ID, subnet name and CIDR, total distinct routes, whether the subnet has any IP allocation pools, and the dense-rank window value computed from the subnet’s associated standard attribute updated-at timestamp (using a window frame of the current row and the 2 preceding rows). target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH subnet_attr_dense_ranks AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT s.NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY sa.UPDATED_AT ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column FROM `subnets` AS s JOIN `standardattributes` AS sa ON sa.ID = s.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4 AND s.ID IN ('012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48')) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(subnet_name) OVER (ORDER BY subnet_name_sort, subnet_name, window_column) = subnet_name THEN NULL ELSE subnet_name END AS subnet_name, window_column FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.NAME) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE i.NAME END AS subnet_name_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.NAME) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE i.NAME END AS subnet_name, i.window_column FROM inner_cte AS i GROUP BY i.NAME, i.window_column WITH ROLLUP) AS tbltmp ORDER BY subnet_name_sort, subnet_name, window_column), top_subnets_by_routes AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT r.DESTINATION, r.NEXTHOP, s.NAME AS subnet_name, s.CIDR AS subnet_cidr, p.FIRST_IP, p.LAST_IP, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.SUBNET_ID ORDER BY r.SUBNET_ID) AS window_column FROM `subnetroutes` AS r JOIN `subnets` AS s ON r.SUBNET_ID = s.ID JOIN `ipallocationpools` AS p ON s.ID = p.SUBNET_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4 AND s.ID IN ('012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48')) SELECT s.ID AS subnet_id, s.NAME AS subnet_name, s.CIDR AS subnet_cidr, COUNT(DISTINCT r.DESTINATION) AS total_routes, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) > 0 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_allocation_pools FROM `subnets` AS s LEFT JOIN `subnetroutes` AS r ON r.SUBNET_ID = s.ID LEFT JOIN `ipallocationpools` AS p ON p.SUBNET_ID = s.ID JOIN inner_cte AS i ON i.subnet_name = s.NAME AND i.subnet_cidr = s.CIDR WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4 AND s.ID IN ('012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48') GROUP BY s.ID, s.NAME, s.CIDR ORDER BY total_routes DESC LIMIT 10) SELECT ts.subnet_id, ts.subnet_name, ts.subnet_cidr, ts.total_routes, ts.has_allocation_pools, sar.window_column AS standard_attr_dense_rank_window FROM top_subnets_by_routes AS ts JOIN subnet_attr_dense_ranks AS sar ON sar.subnet_name = ts.subnet_name ORDER BY ts.total_routes DESC, ts.subnet_name, sar.window_column

target_disjoint_workload.question: For each subnet name, report the subnet name, the range and variance of the allocation pool starting IP addresses (FIRST_IP) across that subnet’s IP allocation pools, and the number of distinct routes. Consider only routes whose next hop is 10.30.19.197/8 and only subnets with ID 012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48. Include a subtotal row per subnet and a grand total row. Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT s.NAME AS subnet_name, MAX(p.FIRST_IP) - MIN(p.FIRST_IP) AS first_ip_range, VARIANCE(p.FIRST_IP) AS first_ip_variance FROM `subnetroutes` AS r JOIN `subnets` AS s ON r.SUBNET_ID = s.ID JOIN `ipallocationpools` AS p ON s.ID = p.SUBNET_ID WHERE r.NEXTHOP = '10.30.19.197/8' AND s.ID IN ('012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48') GROUP BY s.NAME ORDER BY first_ip_range DESC), RouteCounts AS (SELECT s.NAME AS subnet_name, COUNT(DISTINCT r.DESTINATION) AS distinct_route_destinations FROM `subnetroutes` AS r JOIN `subnets` AS s ON r.SUBNET_ID = s.ID WHERE r.NEXTHOP = '10.30.19.197/8' AND s.ID IN ('012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48') GROUP BY s.NAME) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.subnet_name) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE i.subnet_name END AS subnet_name, CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.subnet_name) = 0 AND GROUPING(i.first_ip_range) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' ELSE CAST(i.first_ip_range AS CHAR) END AS first_ip_range, CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.subnet_name) = 0 AND GROUPING(i.first_ip_variance) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' ELSE CAST(i.first_ip_variance AS CHAR) END AS first_ip_variance, SUM(COALESCE(rc.distinct_route_destinations, 0)) AS distinct_route_destinations FROM inner_cte AS i LEFT JOIN RouteCounts AS rc ON rc.subnet_name = i.subnet_name GROUP BY i.subnet_name, i.first_ip_range, i.first_ip_variance WITH ROLLUP

Also report the total number of routes for that subnet, the average number of routes per subnet across all IPv4 subnets as a benchmark, and categorize the subnet as 'HIGH_ROUTE_SUBNET' (at least 50% more than average), 'LOW_ROUTE_SUBNET' (at least 50% less than average), or 'AVERAGE_ROUTE_SUBNET'. target_disjoint_workload.question: Among the IPv4 subnets whose ID is in ('012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48'), list the top 10 tenants (by total routes across those subnets) and show each tenant's ID, total number of routes, and the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of routes per subnet for that tenant. target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH DnsOrderStats AS (SELECT s.name AS subnet_name, MAX(d.`ORDER`) - MIN(d.`ORDER`) AS order_range, VARIANCE(d.`ORDER`) AS order_variance FROM `subnets` AS s JOIN `dnsnameservers` AS d ON s.id = d.subnet_id WHERE s.ip_version = 4 GROUP BY s.name ORDER BY order_range DESC), SubnetRoutePoolDetails AS (SELECT r.DESTINATION, r.NEXTHOP, s.NAME AS subnet_name, s.CIDR AS subnet_cidr, p.FIRST_IP, p.LAST_IP, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.SUBNET_ID ORDER BY r.SUBNET_ID) AS window_column FROM `subnetroutes` AS r JOIN `subnets` AS s ON r.SUBNET_ID = s.ID JOIN `ipallocationpools` AS p ON s.ID = p.SUBNET_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4) SELECT srpd.subnet_name, srpd.subnet_cidr, srpd.DESTINATION, srpd.NEXTHOP, srpd.FIRST_IP, srpd.LAST_IP, srpd.window_column, dos.order_range, dos.order_variance FROM SubnetRoutePoolDetails AS srpd JOIN DnsOrderStats AS dos ON srpd.subnet_name = dos.subnet_name ORDER BY srpd.subnet_name, srpd.window_column, srpd.DESTINATION), AvgDnsOrderRange AS (SELECT AVG(order_range) AS avg_order_range FROM inner_cte) SELECT i.subnet_name, i.subnet_cidr, i.DESTINATION, i.NEXTHOP, i.FIRST_IP, i.LAST_IP, i.window_column, i.order_range, i.order_variance, (i.order_range - a.avg_order_range) AS deviation_from_avg_order_range FROM inner_cte AS i CROSS JOIN AvgDnsOrderRange AS a ORDER BY i.subnet_name, i.window_column, i.DESTINATION

target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH DnsOrderStats AS (SELECT s.NAME AS subnet_name, AVG(d.`ORDER`) AS avg_dns_order, VARIANCE(d.`ORDER`) AS dns_order_variance FROM `subnets` AS s JOIN `dnsnameservers` AS d ON s.ID = d.SUBNET_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4 GROUP BY s.NAME ORDER BY dns_order_variance DESC), RoutePoolDetails AS (SELECT r.DESTINATION, r.NEXTHOP, s.NAME AS subnet_name, s.CIDR AS subnet_cidr, p.FIRST_IP, p.LAST_IP, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.SUBNET_ID ORDER BY r.SUBNET_ID) AS window_column FROM `subnetroutes` AS r JOIN `subnets` AS s ON r.SUBNET_ID = s.ID JOIN `ipallocationpools` AS p ON s.ID = p.SUBNET_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4) SELECT rpd.subnet_name, rpd.subnet_cidr, rpd.DESTINATION, rpd.NEXTHOP, rpd.FIRST_IP, rpd.LAST_IP, rpd.window_column, dos.avg_dns_order, dos.dns_order_variance FROM RoutePoolDetails AS rpd JOIN DnsOrderStats AS dos ON rpd.subnet_name = dos.subnet_name ORDER BY dos.dns_order_variance DESC, rpd.subnet_name, rpd.window_column), VarianceBenchmark AS (SELECT AVG(dns_order_variance) AS avg_dns_order_variance FROM inner_cte) SELECT i.subnet_name, i.subnet_cidr, i.DESTINATION, i.NEXTHOP, i.FIRST_IP, i.LAST_IP, i.window_column, i.avg_dns_order, i.dns_order_variance, vb.avg_dns_order_variance AS benchmark_dns_order_variance, CASE WHEN i.dns_order_variance > vb.avg_dns_order_variance * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_VARIANCE' WHEN i.dns_order_variance < vb.avg_dns_order_variance * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_VARIANCE' ELSE 'AVERAGE_VARIANCE' END AS variance_category FROM inner_cte AS i CROSS JOIN VarianceBenchmark AS vb ORDER BY i.dns_order_variance DESC, i.subnet_name, i.window_column

target_disjoint_workload.question: For IPv4 subnets whose max_standard_attr_id_next2 (the maximum subnet standard attribute ID over the current subnet row and the next 2 rows when ordered by subnet ID) is greater than the average max_standard_attr_id_next2 for subnets with the same DHCP-enabled flag, list only those subnets that belong to a network that is in the top 3 most-subnetted networks shared via RBAC action 'access_as_shared' and whose subnet count is above the average subnet count of those top 3 networks; return the network ID, tenant ID, subnet name, IP version, CIDR, gateway IP, DHCP enabled flag, allocation pool first/last IP, max_standard_attr_id_next2, the shared network’s subnet count, and the number of distinct target tenants it is shared with. s.IP_VERSION = 4), DhcpAverages AS (SELECT ENABLE_DHCP, AVG(max_standard_attr_id_next2) AS avg_max_next2 FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ENABLE_DHCP) SELECT i.NAME, i.TENANT_ID, i.NETWORK_ID, i.IP_VERSION, i.CIDR, i.GATEWAY_IP, i.ENABLE_DHCP, i.FIRST_IP, i.LAST_IP, i.max_standard_attr_id_next2 FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN DhcpAverages AS d ON i.ENABLE_DHCP = d.ENABLE_DHCP WHERE i.max_standard_attr_id_next2 > d.avg_max_next2), TopSharedNetworks AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT n.OBJECT_ID AS network_id, COUNT(*) AS subnet_count FROM `networkrbacs` AS n JOIN `subnets` AS s ON n.OBJECT_ID = s.NETWORK_ID WHERE n.ACTION = 'access_as_shared' GROUP BY n.OBJECT_ID ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 3), AvgTop3 AS (SELECT AVG(subnet_count) AS avg_subnet_count FROM inner_cte) SELECT i.network_id, i.subnet_count, COUNT(DISTINCT r.TARGET_TENANT) AS distinct_target_tenants FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN `networkrbacs` AS r ON r.OBJECT_ID = i.network_id AND r.ACTION = 'access_as_shared' GROUP BY i.network_id, i.subnet_count HAVING i.subnet_count > (SELECT avg_subnet_count FROM AvgTop3) ORDER BY i.subnet_count DESC), CombinedResults AS (SELECT sd.NETWORK_ID AS network_id, sd.TENANT_ID AS tenant_id, sd.NAME AS subnet_name, sd.IP_VERSION AS ip_version, sd.CIDR AS cidr, sd.GATEWAY_IP AS gateway_ip, sd.ENABLE_DHCP AS enable_dhcp, sd.FIRST_IP AS first_ip, sd.LAST_IP AS last_ip, sd.max_standard_attr_id_next2 AS max_standard_attr_id_next2, tsn.subnet_count AS shared_network_subnet_count, tsn.distinct_target_tenants AS shared_network_distinct_target_tenants FROM SubnetDetails AS sd JOIN TopSharedNetworks AS tsn ON tsn.network_id = sd.NETWORK_ID) SELECT * FROM CombinedResults ORDER BY network_id, subnet_name

target_disjoint_workload.question: For IPv4 subnets, list the subnet name, tenant ID, network ID, IP version, CIDR, gateway IP, DHCP enabled flag, the allocation pool’s first and last IP, and the maximum subnet standard attribute ID considering the current row and the next 2 rows when ordered by subnet ID; only include rows where the allocation pool’s first IP is the minimum first IP for that subnet. Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT s.NAME, s.TENANT_ID, s.NETWORK_ID, s.IP_VERSION, s.CIDR, s.GATEWAY_IP, s.ENABLE_DHCP, p.FIRST_IP, p.LAST_IP, MAX(s.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER (ORDER BY s.ID ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_standard_attr_id_next2 FROM `subnets` AS s JOIN `ipallocationpools` AS p ON s.ID = p.SUBNET_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4) SELECT i.NAME, i.TENANT_ID, i.NETWORK_ID, i.IP_VERSION, i.CIDR, i.GATEWAY_IP, i.ENABLE_DHCP, i.FIRST_IP, i.LAST_IP, i.max_standard_attr_id_next2 FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN `subnets` AS s2 ON s2.TENANT_ID = i.TENANT_ID JOIN `ipallocationpools` AS p2 ON p2.SUBNET_ID = s2.ID WHERE i.FIRST_IP = (SELECT MIN(p3.FIRST_IP) FROM `ipallocationpools` AS p3 WHERE p3.SUBNET_ID = s2.ID)

target_disjoint_workload.question: For each IPv4 subnet, show the subnet name, tenant ID, network ID, IP version, CIDR, gateway IP, DHCP enabled flag, the allocation pool’s first IP and last IP, and the maximum subnet standard attribute ID considering the current row and the next 2 rows when ordered by subnet ID; then return only those rows whose max_standard_attr_id_next2 is greater than the average of max_standard_attr_id_next2 for subnets with the same DHCP enabled flag. Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT s.NAME, s.TENANT_ID, s.NETWORK_ID, s.IP_VERSION, s.CIDR, s.GATEWAY_IP, s.ENABLE_DHCP, p.FIRST_IP, p.LAST_IP, MAX(s.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER (ORDER BY s.ID ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_standard_attr_id_next2 FROM `subnets` AS s JOIN `ipallocationpools` AS p ON s.ID = p.SUBNET_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4), DhcpAverages AS (SELECT ENABLE_DHCP, AVG(max_standard_attr_id_next2) AS avg_max_next2 FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ENABLE_DHCP) SELECT i.NAME, i.TENANT_ID, i.NETWORK_ID, i.IP_VERSION, i.CIDR, i.GATEWAY_IP, i.ENABLE_DHCP, i.FIRST_IP, i.LAST_IP, i.max_standard_attr_id_next2 FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN DhcpAverages AS d ON i.ENABLE_DHCP = d.ENABLE_DHCP WHERE i.max_standard_attr_id_next2 > d.avg_max_next2

target_disjoint_workload.question: For IPv4 subnets that are in the top 10 by DNS nameserver order range and that have DNS nameservers configured, return the subnet name, tenant ID, network ID, IP version, CIDR, gateway IP, DHCP enabled flag, the allocation pool’s first and last IP (only where the first IP is the minimum for that subnet), the maximum subnet standard attribute ID over the current row and next 2 rows by subnet ID, plus the DNS nameserver order range and order variance. Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH DnsOrderRangeTop10 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT s.name AS subnet_name, MAX(d.`ORDER`) - MIN(d.`ORDER`) AS order_range, VARIANCE(d.`ORDER`) AS order_variance FROM `subnets` AS s JOIN `dnsnameservers` AS d ON s.id = d.subnet_id WHERE s.ip_version = 4 GROUP BY s.name ORDER BY order_range DESC) SELECT i.subnet_name, i.order_range, i.order_variance, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT d2.address) > 0 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_dns_nameservers FROM inner_cte AS i LEFT JOIN `subnets` AS s2 ON s2.name = i.subnet_name LEFT JOIN `dnsnameservers` AS d2 ON d2.subnet_id = s2.id GROUP BY i.subnet_name, i.order_range, i.order_variance ORDER BY i.order_range DESC LIMIT 10), SubnetAllocationPoolMinFirstIp AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT s.NAME, s.TENANT_ID, s.NETWORK_ID, s.IP_VERSION, s.CIDR, s.GATEWAY_IP, s.ENABLE_DHCP, p.FIRST_IP, p.LAST_IP, MAX(s.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER (ORDER BY s.ID ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_standard_attr_id_next2 FROM `subnets` AS s JOIN `ipallocationpools` AS p ON s.ID = p.SUBNET_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4) SELECT i.NAME, i.TENANT_ID, i.NETWORK_ID, i.IP_VERSION, i.CIDR, i.GATEWAY_IP, i.ENABLE_DHCP, i.FIRST_IP, i.LAST_IP, i.max_standard_attr_id_next2 FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN `subnets` AS s2 ON s2.TENANT_ID = i.TENANT_ID JOIN `ipallocationpools` AS p2 ON p2.SUBNET_ID = s2.ID WHERE i.FIRST_IP = (SELECT MIN(p3.FIRST_IP) FROM `ipallocationpools` AS p3 WHERE p3.SUBNET_ID = s2.ID)) SELECT sap.NAME AS subnet_name, sap.TENANT_ID, sap.NETWORK_ID, sap.IP_VERSION, sap.CIDR, sap.GATEWAY_IP, sap.ENABLE_DHCP, sap.FIRST_IP AS allocation_pool_first_ip, sap.LAST_IP AS allocation_pool_last_ip, sap.max_standard_attr_id_next2, dor.order_range, dor.order_variance, dor.has_dns_nameservers FROM SubnetAllocationPoolMinFirstIp AS sap JOIN DnsOrderRangeTop10 AS dor ON dor.subnet_name = sap.NAME WHERE dor.has_dns_nameservers = 'Yes' ORDER BY dor.order_range DESC, sap.NAME

target_disjoint_workload.question: For each IPv4 subnet whose subnet ID is in ('012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48'), show the subnet name, tenant ID, network ID, IP version, CIDR, gateway IP, DHCP enabled flag, the allocation pool’s first IP and last IP, and the maximum subnet standard attribute ID considering the current row and the next 2 rows when ordered by subnet ID. Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: SELECT s.NAME, s.TENANT_ID, s.NETWORK_ID, s.IP_VERSION, s.CIDR, s.GATEWAY_IP, s.ENABLE_DHCP, p.FIRST_IP, p.LAST_IP, MAX(s.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER (ORDER BY s.ID ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_standard_attr_id_next2 FROM `subnets` AS s JOIN `ipallocationpools` AS p ON s.ID = p.SUBNET_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4 AND s.ID IN ('012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48')

target_disjoint_workload.question: For each of the top 3 networks with the most IPv4 subnets that are shared via RBAC entries with action = 'access_as_shared', list the network ID and subnet count, and include the IPv4 subnet details (subnet name, tenant ID, IP version, CIDR, gateway IP, DHCP enabled flag, allocation pool first/last IP), plus only those subnet rows whose max subnet standard attribute ID over the current subnet row and the next 2 rows (when ordered by subnet ID) is greater than the average of that same windowed max value across all returned subnets. Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH subnet_details AS (SELECT s.NAME, s.TENANT_ID, s.NETWORK_ID, s.IP_VERSION, s.CIDR, s.GATEWAY_IP, s.ENABLE_DHCP, p.FIRST_IP, p.LAST_IP, MAX(s.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER (ORDER BY s.ID ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_standard_attr_id_next2 FROM `subnets` AS s JOIN `ipallocationpools` AS p ON s.ID = p.SUBNET_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4), top_shared_networks AS (SELECT n.OBJECT_ID AS network_id, COUNT(*) AS subnet_count FROM `networkrbacs` AS n JOIN `subnets` AS s ON n.OBJECT_ID = s.NETWORK_ID WHERE n.ACTION = 'access_as_shared' GROUP BY n.OBJECT_ID ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 3) SELECT tsn.network_id, tsn.subnet_count, sd.NAME AS subnet_name, sd.TENANT_ID AS subnet_tenant_id, sd.IP_VERSION, sd.CIDR, sd.GATEWAY_IP, sd.ENABLE_DHCP, sd.FIRST_IP AS allocation_pool_first_ip, sd.LAST_IP AS allocation_pool_last_ip, sd.max_standard_attr_id_next2 FROM top_shared_networks AS tsn JOIN subnet_details AS sd ON sd.NETWORK_ID = tsn.network_id ORDER BY tsn.subnet_count DESC, tsn.network_id, sd.NAME) SELECT i.network_id, i.subnet_count, i.subnet_name, i.subnet_tenant_id, i.IP_VERSION, i.CIDR, i.GATEWAY_IP, i.ENABLE_DHCP, i.allocation_pool_first_ip, i.allocation_pool_last_ip, i.max_standard_attr_id_next2 FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN (SELECT AVG(max_standard_attr_id_next2) AS avg_max_standard_attr_id_next2 FROM inner_cte) AS a ON 1 = 1 WHERE i.max_standard_attr_id_next2 > a.avg_max_standard_attr_id_next2 ORDER BY i.subnet_count DESC, i.network_id, i.subnet_name

target_disjoint_workload.question: For IPv4 subnets, using the detailed subnet-and-route listing as a base, summarize how many result rows fall under each DHCP enabled flag and route presence category (label as 'Has Routes' when a subnet has at least one associated route row, otherwise 'No Routes'). Include subtotals per DHCP flag and a grand total. Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH SubnetDetails AS (SELECT s.NAME, s.TENANT_ID, s.NETWORK_ID, s.IP_VERSION, s.CIDR, s.GATEWAY_IP, s.ENABLE_DHCP, p.FIRST_IP, p.LAST_IP, MAX(s.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER (ORDER BY s.ID ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_standard_attr_id_next2 FROM `subnets` AS s JOIN `ipallocationpools` AS p ON s.ID = p.SUBNET_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4), SubnetRouteDetails AS (SELECT r.DESTINATION, r.NEXTHOP, s.NAME AS subnet_name, s.CIDR AS subnet_cidr, p.FIRST_IP, p.LAST_IP, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.SUBNET_ID ORDER BY r.SUBNET_ID) AS window_column FROM `subnetroutes` AS r JOIN `subnets` AS s ON r.SUBNET_ID = s.ID JOIN `ipallocationpools` AS p ON s.ID = p.SUBNET_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4) SELECT sd.NAME AS subnet_name, sd.TENANT_ID, sd.NETWORK_ID, sd.IP_VERSION, sd.CIDR, sd.GATEWAY_IP, sd.ENABLE_DHCP, sd.FIRST_IP AS allocation_first_ip, sd.LAST_IP AS allocation_last_ip, sd.max_standard_attr_id_next2, srd.DESTINATION AS route_destination, srd.NEXTHOP AS route_nexthop, srd.window_column AS route_dense_rank_within_subnet FROM SubnetDetails AS sd LEFT JOIN SubnetRouteDetails AS srd ON sd.NAME = srd.subnet_name AND sd.CIDR = srd.subnet_cidr AND sd.FIRST_IP = srd.FIRST_IP AND sd.LAST_IP = srd.LAST_IP ORDER BY sd.NAME, srd.window_column, srd.DESTINATION), RoutePresenceSummary AS (SELECT ic.ENABLE_DHCP, CASE WHEN NOT ic.route_destination IS NULL THEN 'Has Routes' ELSE 'No Routes' END AS route_presence, COUNT(*) AS total_rows FROM inner_cte AS ic GROUP BY ic.ENABLE_DHCP, route_presence) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(ENABLE_DHCP) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE CAST(ENABLE_DHCP AS CHAR) END AS enable_dhcp, CASE WHEN GROUPING(route_presence) = 1 AND GROUPING(ENABLE_DHCP) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' ELSE route_presence END AS route_presence, SUM(total_rows) AS total_rows FROM RoutePresenceSummary GROUP BY ENABLE_DHCP, route_presence WITH ROLLUP

target_disjoint_workload.question: For IPv4 subnets that belong to networks with an RBAC action of 'access_as_shared', group results by the RBAC target tenant and DHCP enabled flag, and list the RBAC target tenant, DHCP flag, the number of distinct subnets, and the average of the per-subnet max-to-running-sum ratio (rounded to 2 decimals). Include subtotals per RBAC target tenant and a grand total.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH Subq1 AS (SELECT s.NAME AS subnet_name, s.CIDR AS subnet_cidr, n.TARGET_TENANT AS rbac_target_tenant, SUM(s.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER (PARTITION BY s.IP_VERSION ORDER BY s.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) AS window_column FROM `subnets` AS s JOIN `networkrbacs` AS n ON n.OBJECT_ID = s.NETWORK_ID WHERE n.ACTION = 'access_as_shared'), Subq2 AS (SELECT s.NAME, s.TENANT_ID, s.NETWORK_ID, s.IP_VERSION, s.CIDR, s.GATEWAY_IP, s.ENABLE_DHCP, p.FIRST_IP, p.LAST_IP, MAX(s.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER (ORDER BY s.ID ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_standard_attr_id_next2 FROM `subnets` AS s JOIN `ipallocationpools` AS p ON s.ID = p.SUBNET_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4) SELECT q2.NAME AS subnet_name, q2.CIDR AS subnet_cidr, q2.TENANT_ID AS subnet_tenant_id, q2.NETWORK_ID AS subnet_network_id, q2.IP_VERSION AS ip_version, q2.GATEWAY_IP AS gateway_ip, q2.ENABLE_DHCP AS enable_dhcp, q2.FIRST_IP AS allocation_pool_first_ip, q2.LAST_IP AS allocation_pool_last_ip, q1.rbac_target_tenant, q1.window_column AS running_sum_standard_attr_id_within_ip_version, q2.max_standard_attr_id_next2, ROUND(q2.max_standard_attr_id_next2 / NULLIF(q1.window_column, 0), 2) AS max_to_running_sum_ratio FROM Subq2 AS q2 JOIN Subq1 AS q1 ON q1.subnet_name = q2.NAME AND q1.subnet_cidr = q2.CIDR ORDER BY max_to_running_sum_ratio DESC), Agg AS (SELECT rbac_target_tenant, enable_dhcp, COUNT(DISTINCT subnet_name) AS distinct_subnets, ROUND(AVG(max_to_running_sum_ratio), 2) AS avg_max_to_running_sum_ratio FROM inner_cte GROUP BY rbac_target_tenant, enable_dhcp) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(rbac_target_tenant) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE rbac_target_tenant END AS rbac_target_tenant, CASE WHEN GROUPING(enable_dhcp) = 1 AND GROUPING(rbac_target_tenant) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(enable_dhcp) = 1 AND GROUPING(rbac_target_tenant) = 1 THEN 'ALL' ELSE CAST(enable_dhcp AS CHAR) END AS enable_dhcp, SUM(distinct_subnets) AS distinct_subnets, ROUND(AVG(avg_max_to_running_sum_ratio), 2) AS avg_max_to_running_sum_ratio FROM Agg GROUP BY rbac_target_tenant, enable_dhcp WITH ROLLUP

target_disjoint_workload.question: For each IPv4 subnet that has at least one DNS nameserver entry, show the subnet name, tenant ID, network ID, IP version, CIDR, gateway IP, DHCP enabled flag, allocation pool first IP and last IP, the maximum subnet standard attribute ID over the current subnet and the next 2 subnets by subnet ID, and also (per network) the maximum pool-count range across subnet names in that network, ordered by that network-level maximum range descending. Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH SubnetPoolStatsByName AS (SELECT s.name AS subnet_name, MAX(pool_count) - MIN(pool_count) AS pool_count_range, VARIANCE(pool_count) AS pool_count_variance, STDDEV(pool_count) AS pool_count_stddev FROM `subnets` AS s JOIN `dnsnameservers` AS d ON d.subnet_id = s.id JOIN (SELECT s2.id AS subnet_id, COUNT(*) AS pool_count FROM `subnets` AS s2 JOIN `ipallocationpools` AS p ON p.subnet_id = s2.id GROUP BY s2.id, p.id) AS pool_stats ON pool_stats.subnet_id = s.id GROUP BY s.name ORDER BY pool_count_range DESC), SubnetDetailsWithWindowMax AS (SELECT s.NAME, s.TENANT_ID, s.NETWORK_ID, s.IP_VERSION, s.CIDR, s.GATEWAY_IP, s.ENABLE_DHCP, p.FIRST_IP, p.LAST_IP, MAX(s.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER (ORDER BY s.ID ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_standard_attr_id_next2 FROM `subnets` AS s JOIN `ipallocationpools` AS p ON s.ID = p.SUBNET_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4), DnsSubnetNames AS (SELECT DISTINCT s.name AS subnet_name FROM `subnets` AS s JOIN `dnsnameservers` AS d ON d.subnet_id = s.id) SELECT sd.NAME AS subnet_name, sd.TENANT_ID, sd.NETWORK_ID, sd.IP_VERSION, sd.CIDR, sd.GATEWAY_IP, sd.ENABLE_DHCP, sd.FIRST_IP, sd.LAST_IP, sd.max_standard_attr_id_next2, sp.pool_count_range, sp.pool_count_variance, sp.pool_count_stddev FROM SubnetDetailsWithWindowMax AS sd JOIN SubnetPoolStatsByName AS sp ON sd.NAME = sp.subnet_name JOIN DnsSubnetNames AS dn ON sd.NAME = dn.subnet_name ORDER BY sp.pool_count_range DESC, sd.NAME), NetworkMaxPoolRange AS (SELECT s.network_id, MAX(ic.pool_count_range) AS max_pool_count_range_in_network FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN `subnets` AS s ON s.name = ic.subnet_name GROUP BY s.network_id) SELECT ic.subnet_name, ic.tenant_id, ic.network_id, ic.ip_version, ic.cidr, ic.gateway_ip, ic.enable_dhcp, ic.first_ip, ic.last_ip, ic.max_standard_attr_id_next2, ic.pool_count_range, ic.pool_count_variance, ic.pool_count_stddev, nmr.max_pool_count_range_in_network FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN NetworkMaxPoolRange AS nmr ON nmr.network_id = ic.network_id ORDER BY nmr.max_pool_count_range_in_network DESC, ic.pool_count_range DESC, ic.subnet_name

target_disjoint_workload.question: For IPv4 subnets that belong to networks with an RBAC action of 'access_as_shared', return only those subnets whose max-to-running-sum ratio (maximum subnet standard attribute ID over the current row and next 2 rows, divided by the running sum of subnet standard attribute IDs within the IP version group, rounded to 2 decimals) is greater than the average of that same ratio across all such subnets; list the subnet’s name and CIDR along with its tenant ID, network ID, gateway IP, DHCP enabled flag, allocation pool first/last IP, the RBAC target tenant, the running sum, the max-over-next-2 value, and the ratio.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH Subq1 AS (SELECT s.NAME AS subnet_name, s.CIDR AS subnet_cidr, n.TARGET_TENANT AS rbac_target_tenant, SUM(s.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER (PARTITION BY s.IP_VERSION ORDER BY s.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) AS window_column FROM `subnets` AS s JOIN `networkrbacs` AS n ON n.OBJECT_ID = s.NETWORK_ID WHERE n.ACTION = 'access_as_shared'), Subq2 AS (SELECT s.NAME, s.TENANT_ID, s.NETWORK_ID, s.IP_VERSION, s.CIDR, s.GATEWAY_IP, s.ENABLE_DHCP, p.FIRST_IP, p.LAST_IP, MAX(s.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER (ORDER BY s.ID ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_standard_attr_id_next2 FROM `subnets` AS s JOIN `ipallocationpools` AS p ON s.ID = p.SUBNET_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4) SELECT q2.NAME AS subnet_name, q2.CIDR AS subnet_cidr, q2.TENANT_ID AS subnet_tenant_id, q2.NETWORK_ID AS subnet_network_id, q2.IP_VERSION AS ip_version, q2.GATEWAY_IP AS gateway_ip, q2.ENABLE_DHCP AS enable_dhcp, q2.FIRST_IP AS allocation_pool_first_ip, q2.LAST_IP AS allocation_pool_last_ip, q1.rbac_target_tenant, q1.window_column AS running_sum_standard_attr_id_within_ip_version, q2.max_standard_attr_id_next2, ROUND(q2.max_standard_attr_id_next2 / NULLIF(q1.window_column, 0), 2) AS max_to_running_sum_ratio FROM Subq2 AS q2 JOIN Subq1 AS q1 ON q1.subnet_name = q2.NAME AND q1.subnet_cidr = q2.CIDR ORDER BY max_to_running_sum_ratio DESC) SELECT subnet_name, subnet_cidr, subnet_tenant_id, subnet_network_id, ip_version, gateway_ip, enable_dhcp, allocation_pool_first_ip, allocation_pool_last_ip, rbac_target_tenant, running_sum_standard_attr_id_within_ip_version, max_standard_attr_id_next2, max_to_running_sum_ratio FROM inner_cte WHERE max_to_running_sum_ratio > (SELECT AVG(max_to_running_sum_ratio) FROM inner_cte) ORDER BY max_to_running_sum_ratio DESC

target_disjoint_workload.question: For the IPv4 subnet with ID '012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48', show the subnet’s name, tenant ID, network ID, IP version, CIDR, gateway IP, DHCP enabled flag, and allocation pool first/last IP, along with each associated subnet route’s destination and next hop. Do not repeat the subnet name if it is the same as the previous row. Also include (1) the maximum subnet standard attribute ID over the current subnet row and the next two rows when ordered by subnet ID, and (2) the dense-rank value for each route within the subnet. Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH q1 AS (SELECT s.NAME, s.TENANT_ID, s.NETWORK_ID, s.IP_VERSION, s.CIDR, s.GATEWAY_IP, s.ENABLE_DHCP, p.FIRST_IP, p.LAST_IP, MAX(s.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER (ORDER BY s.ID ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_standard_attr_id_next2 FROM `subnets` AS s JOIN `ipallocationpools` AS p ON s.ID = p.SUBNET_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4 AND s.ID IN ('012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48')), q2 AS (SELECT r.DESTINATION, r.NEXTHOP, s.NAME AS subnet_name, s.CIDR AS subnet_cidr, p.FIRST_IP, p.LAST_IP, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.SUBNET_ID ORDER BY r.SUBNET_ID) AS window_column FROM `subnetroutes` AS r JOIN `subnets` AS s ON r.SUBNET_ID = s.ID JOIN `ipallocationpools` AS p ON s.ID = p.SUBNET_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4 AND s.ID IN ('012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48')) SELECT q1.NAME AS subnet_name, q1.TENANT_ID, q1.NETWORK_ID, q1.IP_VERSION, q1.CIDR, q1.GATEWAY_IP, q1.ENABLE_DHCP, q1.FIRST_IP AS allocation_first_ip, q1.LAST_IP AS allocation_last_ip, q1.max_standard_attr_id_next2, q2.DESTINATION AS route_destination, q2.NEXTHOP AS route_nexthop, q2.window_column AS route_dense_rank_within_subnet FROM q1 JOIN q2 ON q1.NAME = q2.subnet_name AND q1.CIDR = q2.subnet_cidr AND q1.FIRST_IP = q2.FIRST_IP AND q1.LAST_IP = q2.LAST_IP ORDER BY q1.NAME, q2.window_column, q2.DESTINATION) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(subnet_name) OVER (ORDER BY subnet_name, route_dense_rank_within_subnet, route_destination) = subnet_name THEN NULL ELSE subnet_name END AS subnet_name, tenant_id, network_id, ip_version, cidr, gateway_ip, enable_dhcp, allocation_first_ip, allocation_last_ip, max_standard_attr_id_next2, route_destination, route_nexthop, route_dense_rank_within_subnet FROM inner_cte ORDER BY subnet_name, route_dense_rank_within_subnet, route_destination

target_disjoint_workload.question: How many active networks (excluding shared networks) have a standard attribute tagged as 'ports'? Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS active_networks_with_ports_tag FROM `tags` AS t JOIN `standardattributes` AS sa ON t.STANDARD_ATTR_ID = sa.ID JOIN `networks` AS n ON sa.ID = n.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE n.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND t.TAG = 'ports' AND NOT n.ID IN (SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM `networkrbacs` WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b'))
